In 1936 Belgium started its policy of "Armed Independence", a policy supported by the majority of the Belgian people. As a consequence of the inability of France and Britain to react when Germany re-occupied the Rhine-land and the French refusal to extend the Maginot Line at the Belgian-French border (thus inviting the Germans to attack France through Belgium), Belgium put an end to the mutual defence pacts and decided to rely on its own armed forces to guarantee its independence. As a result at the outbreak of war Belgium had the best prepared army in its history, having spent 25% of the annual national budget on the military.
zh: 1936年，比利时开始推行“武装独立”政策，这一政策得到大多数比利时民众的支持。由于德国重新占领莱茵兰时法国和英国无力作出反应，以及法国拒绝将马奇诺防线延伸至比利时-法国边界（这无异于邀请德国取道比利时进攻法国），比利时终止了共同防御条约，决定依靠自身武装力量来保障独立。因此，战争爆发时比利时拥有其历史上准备最充分的军队，年度国家预算的25%用于军事。

en: In 1939, France and Britain unilaterally guaranteed Belgium independence. Although there was no official coordination of military plans secret contacts were held. France and Britain would march into Belgium and take positions on the Dyle River (plan D) in case of a German attack. Therefore the Belgians had made this river their main defence line although it meant giving up half of their country.
zh: 1939年，法国和英国单方面保证比利时的独立。尽管双方没有官方的军事计划协调，但仍保持着秘密接触。一旦德国发动进攻，法国和英国将开进比利时并在戴尔河一线占领阵地（D计划）。因此比利时人把这条河作为主要防线，尽管这意味着放弃半个国家。

en: When on the 10th of January 1940 German military plans were captured after a German plane crashed, Belgian King Leopold III was prepared to accept allied troops in his country on some conditions (Belgian participation in the peace negotiations, guarantee of Belgium's integrity and of his colonies, and financial support to rebuild Belgium after the war). However, these conditions were unacceptable for Britain and France and their troops did not enter into Belgium until the German attack.
zh: 1940年1月10日，一架德国飞机坠毁后德军军事计划被缴获，比利时国王利奥波德三世准备在一定条件下接受盟军部队进入本国（比利时参与和平谈判、保证比利时及其殖民地的完整、以及战后重建比利时的财政支持）。然而，这些条件对英国和法国来说无法接受，他们的部队直到德国发动进攻才进入比利时。

en: On the day of the Geman invasion, 10th May, King Leopold III said "Belges! pour la second fois en un quart de siècle, la Belgique, loyale et neutre, est attaqué par l'Empire allemande, [...] La lutte sera dure. Les sacrifices et les privations seront considérables, mais nul ne peut douter du succès final" ("Belgians! for the second time in a quarter century, Belgium, fair and neutral, is attacked by the German Empire [...] The fight will be tough. The sacrifices and hardships will be considerable, but no one can doubt the ultimate success".
zh: 在德军入侵当天，即5月10日，国王利奥波德三世说：“比利时人！四分之一世纪内第二次，忠诚而中立的比利时遭到德意志帝国的进攻，[...]战斗将是艰苦的。牺牲和匮乏将是巨大的，但没有人会怀疑最终的胜利”（“比利时人！四分之一世纪内第二次，忠诚而中立的比利时遭到德意志帝国的进攻[...]战斗将是艰苦的。牺牲和匮乏将是巨大的，但没有人会怀疑最终的胜利”。

en: Indeed, the King was right but the victory had to wait five years...
zh: 确实，国王说得没错，但胜利还要再等五年……

en: The campaign represents operation "Fall Gelb" from the Belgian perspective. It reproduces some of the battles held during the 18 days the Belgian army fought against the Germans.
zh: 本次战役从比利时的视角再现了“黄色方案”行动。它重现了比利时军队与德军作战的18天中发生的一些战斗。

The motorisation of the Cavalry Corps ("Corps de Cavalerie") decided in 1935 is now almost completed. This mobile force will complement our main fortified positions and defence lines providing support where needed.

en: This year the manoeuvres of the Belgian army aim to prove that the motorisation of the "Corps de Cavalerie" is value for money. As Commander of the Regiment "2e Lanciers" of the 1st Cavalry Division ("1ère Division de Cavalerie") you must contribute to demonstrate its high mobility by making a spectacular move and quickly take the VH.
zh: 今年比利时军队的演习旨在证明“Corps de Cavalerie”的摩托化是物有所值的。作为第1骑兵师（“1ère Division de Cavalerie”）第2枪骑兵团（“2e Lanciers”）的指挥官，你必须通过一次引人注目的机动来展示其高度机动性，并迅速夺取胜利格。

en: Thanks to your brilliant command you have managed to evacuate the germ of a new Belgian army. The fight can now continue in France, in Congo or wherever is needed to restore the independence and freedom of Belgium.
zh: 由于你出色的指挥，你成功撤出了新比利时军队的种子。战斗如今可以在法国、在刚果，或任何需要的地方继续，以恢复比利时的独立与自由。

en: I am confident you are eager to play a major role in the future operations of our Army. That’s why your new mission will be to prepare our forces in Congo to be ready to fight.
zh: 我相信你渴望在我们军队未来的行动中发挥重要作用。因此你的新任务将是整备我们在刚果的部队，使其做好战斗准备。
……但首先你应该好好休息一下。

en: Le Chef d'Etat-major général de l’armée (EMGA).

When the Dunkirk evacuation started on 27 May the Belgian Army was to the brink of collapse. The Belgians had practically exhausted all available means of resistance. They had no reserves, the Luftwaffe had air supremacy, rail networks were destroyed and roads were blocked by 3 million civilian refugees. Under these circumstances further retreat was not feasible and resistance useless. On the evening of 27 May King Leopold III requested an armistice. Despite the advice of his government, the King decided to stay in Belgium to share the fate of his army and people.
zh: 当5月27日敦刻尔克撤退开始时，比利时军队已濒临崩溃。比利时人几乎耗尽了所有抵抗手段。他们没有预备队，德国空军掌握着制空权，铁路网被摧毁，道路被300万平民难民堵塞。在这种情况下，进一步撤退已不可行，抵抗也毫无意义。5月27日傍晚，国王利奥波德三世请求停战。尽管政府提出建议，国王仍决定留在比利时，与他的军队和人民共命运。

en: The Belgian unconditional surrender came into effect at 04:00 on 28 May. Recriminations abounded with the British and French claiming the Belgians had betrayed the alliance. The reality was that since 25 May the Allies were aware of the critical Belgian situation. In spite of that, the Belgians extended their resistance for almost three days, frequently holding after British unexpected withdrawals, allowing the Allied armies to prepare their evacuation. On the contrary, when it was inquired if any Belgians were to be evacuated, the Chief of General Staff for the British Expeditionary Force replied "We don't care a bugger what happens to the Belgians".
zh: 比利时的无条件投降于5月28日04:00生效。英国和法国指责比利时背叛了联盟，怨言四起。事实是，自5月25日起盟国就已知道比利时的危急处境。尽管如此，比利时人仍把抵抗延长了近三天，常常在英军意外撤退后继续坚守，使盟军得以准备撤离。相反，当有人询问是否要撤出比利时人时，英国远征军总参谋长回答说“我们才不在乎比利时人怎么样”。

en: Although some Belgian soldiers were indeed evacuated it was not the result of an organized operation but of casual or individual circumstances.
zh: 虽然确实有一些比利时士兵被撤离，但这并非有组织行动的结果，而是偶然或个别情况所致。

en: Despite the armistice, the Belgian army continued to fight in different scenarios … but that is another story.
zh: 尽管签订了停战协定，比利时军队仍在不同的战场上继续战斗……但那是另一个故事了。

en: The situation is dramatic. Several German breakthroughs have been reported. The front is about to break and there are no more reserves to restore the line. A new retreat to the Ijzer/Yser River as suggested by General Weygand is not possible: we would simply lose our ammunition depots since we no longer have the capacity to move them once more. In addition, in the current state of fatigue and demoralization a new retreat would mean the total disintegration of the Army (I guess you are aware of the recent mass surrender of several large units in Gand/Gent). Finally, our British allies have decided to evacuate their expeditionary force in Northern France. In view of the situation King Leopold III has requested, and the Germans have accepted, unconditional surrender. The cease-fire will start at 4.00 A.M of the 28th May.
zh: 局势十分严峻。已有多处德军突破的报告。战线即将崩溃，再没有预备队来恢复防线。魏刚将军建议再次撤退到艾泽尔河/伊瑟河已不可能：我们只会失去弹药库，因为我们已没有能力再把它们搬运一次。此外，在当前疲惫和士气低落的状态下，再次撤退将意味着军队的彻底瓦解（我想你已经知道最近在根特有几支大部队集体投降）。最后，我们的英国盟友已决定撤走他们在法国北部的远征军。鉴于这种局势，国王利奥波德三世已请求无条件投降，德军也已接受。停火将于5月28日凌晨4时开始。

en: However, King Leopold III has agreed that our best troops must retreat to Dunkerque to be shipped and continue the battle in the South France.
zh: 然而，国王利奥波德三世同意，我们最精锐的部队必须撤往敦刻尔克登船，在法国南部继续战斗。

en: The BEF and some troops of the French 1st army have created a defensive perimeter around Dunkerque to ensure the evacuation of the greatest number of troops. Our 14 DI, which has been in Yser for some days to cover the rear of the army in case of a German advance from the west, has begun to build bridges to allow you to retreat.
zh: 英国远征军和法国第1集团军的部分部队已在敦刻尔克周围建立防御圈，以确保尽可能多的部队撤离。我们的第14步兵师已在伊瑟河一带驻守数日，以便在德军自西面推进时掩护军队后方，现在它已开始架桥，供你撤退。

en: Your mission is to evacuate the greatest possible number of troops.
zh: 你的任务是撤出尽可能多的部队。

en: Victory conditions: withdraw 50 units for TV (BV and V are not possible).
zh: 胜利条件：撤出50支部队为战术胜利（不可能取得决定性胜利和胜利）。

en: Warning: there is no more coordination between the Allied armies (if ever existed).
zh: 警告：盟军之间已不再有任何协调（如果有过的话）。

en: Despite your brilliant command you have not managed to evacuate the germ of a new Belgian army to continue the fight to restore the independence and freedom of Belgium.
zh: 尽管你出色地指挥，你仍未能撤出新比利时军队的种子，以继续战斗、恢复比利时的独立与自由。

en: I am afraid this is the end of your career in the military. Maybe you should try the cooking businees.
zh: 恐怕你在军中的生涯到此为止了。也许你该试试餐饮业。

en: Your troops are waiting you in the Canal Albert.
zh: 你的部队正在阿尔贝运河等待你。

en: Le Chef d'Etat-major général de l’armée (EMGA).

Thanks to your great performance in the 1938 manouvres, you have been assigned to command the "1ère Divison de Cavalerie" of our army. As you know, this an elite motorized division of the regular army that thanks to its greater mobility can help other units where needed, notably performing reconnaissance and providing protection. We are confident you will honour your tasks.
zh: 由于你在1938年演习中的出色表现，你被任命为我军第1骑兵师（“1ère Divison de Cavalerie”）的指挥官。如你所知，这是正规军中的一支精锐摩托化师，凭借其更强的机动能力可以在需要之处支援其他部队，尤其是执行侦察和提供掩护。我们相信你能够胜任这些任务。

en: You can choose to command the forces at disposal of the Ist Army Corps ("I Corps d'Armée") to provide it support to defend the Canal Albert line and the Eben Emael fort.
zh: 你可以选择指挥第1军（“I Corps d'Armée”）麾下的部队，支援其防守阿尔贝运河一线和埃本-埃马尔要塞。

en: Or you can choose to command the forces being part of the K Group ("Groupement K)" in the Ardennes whose mission is to delay the enemy's advance until our allies come.
zh: 或者你可以选择指挥阿登地区K集群（“Groupement K”）中的部队，其任务是迟滞敌军推进，直到我们的盟友赶到。

en: Despite your excellent job the 3rd and 4th Panzerdivisionen have finally broken through towards the city of Tongres. This has forced our Army to abandon the "Position de Couverture" of the Canal Albert sooner than planned and as a consequence it has undermined the deployment of the 1re armée française in the "Ligne KW" (Dyle position).
zh: 尽管你表现出色，第3和第4装甲师最终还是突破了防线，向通厄伦城推进。这迫使我军比计划更早地放弃阿尔贝运河的“Position de Couverture”，结果也破坏了法国第1集团军在“Ligne KW”（戴尔河阵地）的部署。

en: However, the battle has just started.
Le Chef d'Etat-major général de l’armée (EMGA).

Thanks to the use of glider infantry and elite-pioneer troops Germans succeeded in taking not only two bridges over the Canal Albert (Vroenhoven and Veldwezelt, which were not destroyed on time) but also destroying the strong fortress of Eben-Emael. The capture of Eben-Emael was extremely important as it dominated the whole region and protected all the bridges in this region.
zh: 借助滑翔机步兵和精锐工兵部队，德军不仅成功夺取了阿尔贝运河上的两座桥梁（弗鲁恩霍芬和费尔德韦泽尔特，这两座桥未能及时炸毁），还摧毁了坚固的埃本-埃马尔要塞。夺取埃本-埃马尔极为重要，因为它俯瞰整个地区，并保护该地区所有桥梁。

en: Initial counterattacks by the Belgian 7th division were done late, in a small scale and without arillery support; the Luftwaffe had destroyed communications and prevented all movement of troops.
zh: 比利时第7师最初的反击发动得太晚、规模太小，而且没有炮火支援；德国空军摧毁了通信，并阻止了部队的一切行动。

en: Although the Belgians succeeded in containing the bridgehead no sufficient reserves were available for a large-scale counterattack. On the contrary the Germans were constantly dropping new paratroopers at the bridges and the fortress of Eben-Emael.
zh: 尽管比利时人成功遏制了桥头堡，却没有足够的预备队发动大规模反击。相反，德军不断向桥头和埃本-埃马尔要塞空投新的伞兵。

en: On the 11th May things were getting worse. The arrival of the main German troops, and notably of the 3rd and the 4th Panzerdivision, was too much for the Belgian 7th division. The Germans expanded the bridgeheads and drove the Belgian troops back.
zh: 5月11日，情况进一步恶化。德军主力部队，尤其是第3和第4装甲师的抵达，对比利时第7师来说过于沉重。德军扩大了桥头堡，把比利时军队击退。

en: The Germans managed to give the Belgians a tactical defeat. The 7th division was almost completely destroyed and had to be sent to France for reorganisation. The Belgians could only stop the Germans for one day at the Albert canal instead of the three days initially planned. But worse, the loss of the Eben-Emael fortress was a serious psychological blow.
zh: 德军得以给比利时人一场战术失败。第7师几乎被全歼，不得不被送往法国整编。比利时人在阿尔贝运河只能阻挡德军一天，而不是原计划的三天。但更糟的是，失去埃本-埃马尔要塞是一次严重的心理打击。

en: However, the retreat of the Belgian army to his main line of defence at the Dyle River succeeded, so nothing was lost yet.
zh: 然而，比利时军队撤退到戴尔河主防线的行动取得了成功，所以一切都还没有失去。

en: The expected German attack has started. Early in the morning the Germans have crossed the Dutch border and in few hours they will arrive at our delaying line ("Position de Couverture") situated behind the Canal Albert and the Maas river from Antwerp to Arlon. With the support of the strong fortress of Eben-Emael, you must contain the Germans in the "Position de couverture" for as long as possible in order to allow our troops, as well as that of our French and British allies, to occupy their positions in the "Ligne KW" (Dyle Position for our allies), the main defence line where is foreseen to fight the decisive battle.
zh: 预料中的德军进攻已经开始。清晨德军越过了荷兰边境，几小时内他们就会抵达我们位于阿尔贝运河与马斯河之后、从安特卫普到阿尔隆的迟滞线（“Position de Couverture”）。在坚固的埃本-埃马尔要塞支援下，你必须在“Position de couverture”尽可能久地遏制德军，以便我军以及法国和英国盟军的部队进入“Ligne KW”（我们的盟友称之为戴尔河阵地）的阵地，那是预计将进行决定性会战的主要防线。

en: Some units of the "Corps de Cavalerie" must help the I Corps, and notably its 7th division, to defend the area of Eben-Emael and prevent the bridges over the Albert-canal in the Maastricht area to be taken by the Germans.
zh: “Corps de Cavalerie”的部分部队必须协助第1军，尤其是其第7师，防守埃本-埃马尔地区，并阻止德军夺取马斯特里赫特地区阿尔贝运河上的桥梁。

en: Le Chef d'Etat-major général de l’armée (EMGA)
Victory conditions: keep 6 VH for a BV, 4 VH for a V and 2 VH for a TV.
zh: 胜利条件：守住6个胜利格为决定性胜利，4个胜利格为胜利，2个胜利格为战术胜利。

en: Tip: blow the bridges before the Germans capture them.
zh: 提示：在德军夺取桥梁之前将其炸毁。

en: A new mission is waiting for you. Go to the canteen and let's hope you are able to cook a good "Moules frites".
zh: 新的任务在等着你。去食堂吧，但愿你能做出一份好吃的“Moules frites”。

This has forced our Army to abandon the "Position de Couverture" of the Canal Albert sooner than foreseen and as a consequence has undermined the deployment of the 1re armée française in the "Ligne KW" (Dyle position).

en: Well done! You have succeeded in safely retreating our troops from the Ardennes to be redeployed in the "Ligne KW" (Dyle position).
zh: 干得好！你成功地把我们的部队从阿登安全撤出，以便在“Ligne KW”（戴尔河阵地）重新部署。

en: However, the Germans have managed to quickly cross the Ardennes in spite of the French troops sent to delay this movement.
zh: 然而，尽管法国部队被派去迟滞德军，德军仍然迅速穿过了阿登。

en: We already warned our allies some months ago but the French strategists considered the region impracticable for motorized troops (sic).
zh: 我们几个月前就警告过盟友，但法国战略家们认为该地区不适合摩托化部队通行（原文如此）。

en: A new mission is waiting for you.
Le Chef d'Etat-major général de l’armée (EMGA).
In its advance through the Ardennes German II and XIX Panzercorps had to face fierce resistance from small Belgian detachments of "Chasseusr Ardennaises
zh: 在穿越阿登的推进中，德军第2和第19装甲军在许多地方（马特朗日、博当日、斯特兰尚、沙布雷埃）遭到比利时“Chasseusr Ardennaises

en: Ardense Jagers" in many places (Martelange, Bodange, Strainchamps, Chabrehez) causing important delays. The Germans were so surprised that they lost so much time because of these small units that destroyed all documents so their superiors couldn’t find out what happened. Both Guderain and Rommel would later praise the effective destructions and delaying tactics the Belgian army performed and would call them the "Grey Wolves".
zh: Ardense Jagers”小股部队的顽强抵抗，造成了严重延误。德军十分惊讶，因为这些小部队销毁了所有文件，使他们的上级无法查明发生了什么，从而耽误了如此多的时间。古德里安和隆美尔后来都称赞比利时军队实施的破坏和迟滞战术十分有效，并称他们为“灰狼”。

en: Meanwhile French light troops intervened in the Neufchateau area but were forced to retreat behind the Maas River.
zh: 与此同时，法国轻装部队在讷沙托地区介入，但被迫撤退到马斯河之后。

en: In spite of the delays, Germans reached the Maas river faster than the French 9th and 2nd Army. Therefore the bridges over the river had to be destroyed by Belgian troops.
zh: 尽管有这些延误，德军还是比法国第9和第2集团军更快地抵达马斯河。因此河上的桥梁不得不由比利时部队炸毁。

en: One of the reasons for the rapid German advance was the lack of cooperation between the Belgian and French troops. Both troops executed their plans without looking at what the other was doing, causing many disagreements and incidents.
zh: 德军推进迅速的原因之一是比利时与法国部队之间缺乏配合。两军各自执行自己的计划，不顾对方在做什么，造成许多分歧和事件。

en: The Germans have just entered into Luxembourg and will soon cross the Belgian border and enter into the Belgian Ardennes. You must support the "1ére Division de Chasseurs Ardennais
zh: 德军刚刚进入卢森堡，很快就会越过比利时边界，进入比利时阿登地区。你必须支援“1ére Division de Chasseurs Ardennais

en: Ardense Jagers" in their delaying tactics and demolition works. Once completed, you must retreat northwards to the Maas River and join the main body of the Belgian army at the "Ligne KW" (Dyle Position). It is important that your troops are preserved to continue the battle in the main defensive line, so do not engage in risky combats.
zh: Ardense Jagers”的迟滞战术和破坏作业。完成之后，你必须向北撤退到马斯河，并在“Ligne KW”（戴尔河阵地）与比利时军队主力会合。重要的是保全你的部队以便在主防线上继续作战，因此不要进行冒险的战斗。

en: According to the intelligence service, you will have to fight against several panzerdivisions from the XIX Panzerkorps of Guderain, so be prepared!  We have also been informed that paratroopers may land behind our lines, probably close to Neufchâteau (20,25).
zh: 据情报部门称，你将面对古德里安第19装甲军的数个装甲师，做好准备！我们还获悉，伞兵可能会降落在我们战线后方，很可能在讷沙托(20,25)附近。

en: French light troops are also expected to intervene to delay Germans and give time to their 9th and 2nd Armies to move to their positions in the Meuse River. Be open to cooperate with our French allies but your priority is to execute our retreat plans and remember ... you only receive orders from the Belgian command!
zh: 预计法国轻装部队也会介入，以迟滞德军，并为其第9和第2集团军争取时间进入默兹河一线的阵地。可以与本国的法国盟友合作，但你的首要任务是执行我们的撤退计划，记住……你只接受比利时司令部的命令！

en: Le Chef d'Etat-major général de l’armée (EMGA)
Victory conditions: Only a TV is possible. At the end, you must hold Bouillon (4,31) and Haversin (1,1).
zh: 胜利条件：只可能取得战术胜利。最终你必须守住布永(4,31)和阿韦尔桑(1,1)。

en: In addition, if you lose Bastogne (29,16) before the turn 5 or Neufchâteau (20,25) AND Champion (17,9) before the turn 10 Germans win.
zh: 此外，如果你在第5回合前丢失巴斯托涅(29,16)，或在第10回合前丢失讷沙托(20,25)和香皮翁(17,9)，德军将获胜。
此外，还必须有10支比利时部队存活。

en: You have disappointed us. If you are not able to successfully retreat some elite troops from the Ardennes, less will you able to command troops in a real battle.
zh: 你让我们失望了。如果你连从阿登成功撤出一些精锐部队都做不到，就更不可能在真正的战斗中指挥部队了。

en: A new mission is waiting for you. Go to the canteen and let's hope you are able to cook a good "Filet américain".
zh: 新的任务在等着你。去食堂吧，但愿你能做出一份好吃的“Filet américain”。

zh: 我们几个月前就警告过盟友，但法国战略家们认为该地区不适合摩托化部队通行（原文如此）。

en: A new mission is waiting for you.
Le Chef d'Etat-major général de l’armée (EMGA).
In its advance through the Ardennes German II and XIX Panzercorps had to face fierce resistance from small Belgian detachments of "Chasseusr Ardennaises
zh: 在穿越阿登的推进中，德军第2和第19装甲军在许多地方（马特朗日、博当日、斯特兰尚、沙布雷埃）遭到比利时“Chasseusr Ardennaises

en: Ardense Jagers" in many places (Martelange, Bodange, Strainchamps, Chabrehez) causing important delays. The Germans were so surprised that they lost so much time because of these small units that destroyed all documents so their superiors couldn’t find out what happened. Both Guderain and Rommel would later praise the effective destructions and delaying tactics the Belgian army performed and would call them the "Grey Wolves".
zh: Ardense Jagers”小股部队的顽强抵抗，造成了严重延误。德军十分惊讶，因为这些小部队销毁了所有文件，使他们的上级无法查明发生了什么，从而耽误了如此多的时间。古德里安和隆美尔后来都称赞比利时军队实施的破坏和迟滞战术十分有效，并称他们为“灰狼”。

en: Meanwhile French light troops intervened in the Neufchateau area but were forced to retreat behind the Maas River.
zh: 与此同时，法国轻装部队在讷沙托地区介入，但被迫撤退到马斯河之后。

en: In spite of the delays, Germans reached the Maas river faster than the French 9th and 2nd Army. Therefore the bridges over the river had to be destroyed by Belgian troops.
zh: 尽管有这些延误，德军还是比法国第9和第2集团军更快地抵达马斯河。因此河上的桥梁不得不由比利时部队炸毁。

en: One of the reasons for the rapid German advance was the lack of cooperation between the Belgian and French troops. Both troops executed their plans without looking at what the other was doing, causing many disagreements and incidents.
zh: 德军推进迅速的原因之一是比利时与法国部队之间缺乏配合。两军各自执行自己的计划，不顾对方在做什么，造成许多分歧和事件。

en: Well done! You have succeeded in safely retreating our troops from the Ardennes to be redeployed in the "Ligne KW" (Dyle position).
zh: 干得好！你成功地把我们的部队从阿登安全撤出，以便在“Ligne KW”（戴尔河阵地）重新部署。

en: However, the Germans have managed to quickly cross the Ardennes in spite of the French troops sent to delay this movement.
zh: 然而，尽管法国部队被派去迟滞德军，德军仍然迅速穿过了阿登。

en: Your troops really deserve to be considered as the elite of the Belgian army!
zh: 您的部队确实无愧于比利时军队精锐之称！

en: All German attacks have been repelled and you have retreated the forces under your command in an ordered manner. Your defence has enabled our army to safely take positions on the "Ligne KW" (Dyle line).
zh: 德军的进攻全部被击退，您以有序的方式撤出了麾下部队。您的防御使我军得以安全进入“KW 防线”（迪尔河防线）阵地。

en: A new mission is waiting for you.
Le Chef d'Etat-major général de l’armée (EMGA).

During the 12th and 13th of May the temporary line at the Gete River was heavily attacked by the German infantry at Halen, Geetbets and Goetsenhoeven. All attacks (in total eleven) were repelled and the Belgian cavalry divisions only retreated when they discovered that the French on their left had already retreated. This defence enabled also the BEF to take positions on the "Ligne KW" (Dyle line) without being attacked by the Germans
zh: 5月12日至13日，德军步兵在哈伦、海特贝茨和胡岑霍芬对盖特河临时防线发起猛攻。所有进攻（共十一次）均被击退，比利时骑兵师直到发现左翼的法军已经后撤时才撤退。这次防御也使英国远征军得以在未遭德军攻击的情况下进入“KW 防线”（迪尔河防线）阵地。

en: In most cases the retreat of the Belgian army towards the Dyle River succeeded without too much difficulty but for some divisions it was a very hazardous undertaking (e.g. the evacuation of the 3rd and 2nd division from Liege (Luik) or the encirclement of the 14th division at Lummen).
zh: 大多数情况下，比利时军队向迪尔河的撤退都相当顺利，但对某些师而言却极为凶险（例如第3师和第2师从列日撤出，或第14师在吕门被围）。

en: After the crossing of the Canal Albert by German troops, the Belgian army has received the order to retreat to the "Ligne KW" (Dyle Position). In order to protect the retreat and give time to take the new positions, you will support the "2e Division de Cavalerie" (2 DC) to establish a temporary defensive line in the Gete river, between Diest and Tienen (Tirlemont).
zh: 德军渡过阿尔贝特运河后，比利时军队已奉命撤往“KW 防线”（迪尔河阵地）。为掩护撤退并争取时间进入新阵地，您将支援“第2骑兵师”（2 DC），在迪斯特与蒂嫩（蒂尔勒蒙）之间的盖特河建立一道临时防线。

en: According to Intelligence a sharp attack of German infantry around the locality of Halen is expected. The 4th Panzerdivision has moved further south towards Gembloux (Gembloers) where it would meet the French Cavalry units of Prioux. So luckily it seems you will not have to fight the German tanks again.
zh: 据情报判断，德军步兵将在哈伦附近发起猛烈进攻。第4装甲师已南调至让布卢（Gembloers），将在那里迎战普里乌指挥的法军骑兵部队。因此幸运的是，您这次似乎不必再与德军坦克交手。

en: Your mission is i) to stop the Germans in the river in order to permit the redeployment of the allied armies and ii) to safely retreat your troops, so do not engage them unnecessarily.
zh: 您的任务是：其一，把德军阻止在河中，以便盟军重新部署；其二，安全撤出您的部队，因此不要不必要地与敌交战。

en: Le Chef d'Etat-major général de l’armée (EMGA)
Victory conditions: to retreat 12 units. In addition, you have to keep Halen and Kortenaken until turn 9.
zh: 胜利条件：撤出12个单位。此外，您必须守住哈伦和科特纳肯直到第9回合。

en: You have disappointed us. If you are not able to temporally stop the German infantry, less will you able to fight the panzers.
zh: 您让我们失望了。如果您连暂时挡住德军步兵都做不到，就更不用说与装甲部队交手了。

en: A new mission is waiting for you. Go to the canteen and let's hope you are able to cook a good "Lapin à la gueuze".
zh: 新的任务正等着您。到食堂去吧，希望您能做好一道“啤酒炖兔肉”。

zh: 您的部队作战英勇，使我军得以安全进入“KW 防线”（迪尔河防线）阵地。

zh: 尽管德军不断进攻，您仍成功撤出了麾下部队，但代价是遭受了重大损失。

en: I hope you will do better in in your next mission.

en: The "Ligne KW" (Dyle line) has resisted as we thought. The Germans have suffered heavy losses and have not been able to break through our lines.
zh: “KW 防线”（迪尔河防线）果然如我们所料顶住了。德军损失惨重，未能突破我军防线。

en: You have done an excellent job. Congratulations!!!.

Unfortunately, we have received orders to retire. It seems that the German Army has broken the French defences at Sedan and it is now free to drive for the English Channel. To avoid our southern flanks from being turned by the German forces we have to retire once more. Our new defensive line will be the Escaut/Scheldt river.
zh: 遗憾的是，我们已接到后撤的命令。看来德军已突破法军在色当的防御，现在可以自由地向英吉利海峡推进。为避免我军南翼被德军迂回，我们必须再次后撤。新的防线将是斯海尔德河。

en: I know this means abandoning Brussels and Leuven but I am confident we will check the German advance there.
zh: 我知道这意味着放弃布鲁塞尔和鲁汶，但我相信我们能在那里阻止德军前进。

en: Le Chef d'Etat-major général de l’armée (EMGA).
The troops at the "Ligne KW" (Dyle position) river were not particularly hard pressed and two attempts to cross the Dijle/Dyle River around Leuven/Louvain were fairly easily beaten off.
zh: “KW 防线”（迪尔河阵地）的部队并未受到特别猛烈的压力，两次试图在鲁汶附近强渡迪尔河的行动都被相当轻松地击退。

en: However, as a complete surprise, on 16th May the BEF started to leave their positions at the Dijle/Dyle river. Soon orders came for the Belgian army to retreat. The Germans had broken trough at Sedan and were racing towards the coast threatening to cut of the Armies in Belgium from the main body of the French army.
zh: 然而，完全出乎意料的是，5月16日英国远征军开始撤离其在迪尔河的阵地。不久后，比利时军队也接到了撤退命令。德军已在色当突破，正向海岸疾进，威胁要把在比利时的各集团军与法军主力割裂开来。

en: Our troops have finally taken positions in the "Ligne KW" (Dyle Position) to confront the Germans. The defensive line is well prepared, our Army is ready and this is where we are going to give the decisive battle.
zh: 我军终于进入“KW 防线”（迪尔河阵地）与德军对峙。防线准备充分，我军已就绪，我们将在这里进行决定性会战。

en: The "Corps de Cavalerie" is being reorganized behind the front line but you may be requested to provide some support if the situation requires so. We have been informed that the Germans will try to test our positions around the city of Leuven.
zh: “骑兵军”正在前线后方整编，但如形势需要，可能会要求您提供支援。我们已获悉德军将试探鲁汶城周边的我军阵地。

en: Contrary to our initial plans, Généralissime Gamelin has placed Leuven/Louvain in the area of the II British Corps and its 3 Infantry Division has already taken positions in this city, forcing to move northwards our 5th "Division d'Infanterie". I am afraid we will have to coordinate with its commander, General Montgomery, in order to defend Leuven/Louvain and avoid the Germans to cross the Dijle/Dyle River. The "Ligne KW" has strong fortifications so I am confident you will improve our allies' esteem of the Belgian army.
zh: 与我们的最初计划相反，甘末林总司令把鲁汶划入英国第2军的地段，其第3步兵师已进驻该城，迫使我第5“步兵师”北移。恐怕我们必须与该师师长蒙哥马利将军协调，共同防守鲁汶，阻止德军渡过迪尔河。“KW 防线”工事坚固，因此我相信您会提高盟军对比利时军队的评价。

en: Le Chef d'Etat-major général de l’armée (EMGA)
Victory conditions: keep 3 VH for a BV, 2 VH for a V and 1 VH for a TV
zh: 胜利条件：守住3个胜利格为决定性胜利，2个为胜利，1个为战术胜利

en: Warning: only three core units can be deployed.
zh: 警告：只能部署三个核心单位。

en: You have disappointed us. If you are not able to stop the Germans in well prepared positions, less will you able to command troops in the offensive.
zh: 您让我们失望了。如果在准备充分的阵地上都无法挡住德军，您就更无法在进攻中指挥部队了。

en: A new mission is waiting for you. Go to the canteen and let's hope you are able to cook a good "Carbonnade flamande".
zh: 新的任务正等着您。到食堂去吧，希望您能做好一道“弗拉芒啤酒炖牛肉”。

en: Le Chef d'Etat-major général de l’armée (EMGA).
The troops at the "Ligne KW" (Dyle position) river were not particularly hard pressed and two attempts to cross the Dijle/Dyle River around Leuven/Louvain were fairly easily beaten off.
zh: “KW 防线”（迪尔河阵地）的部队并未受到特别猛烈的压力，两次试图在鲁汶附近强渡迪尔河的行动都被相当轻松地击退。

en: However, as a complete surprise, on 16th May the BEF started to leave their positions at the Dijle/Dyle river. Soon orders came for the Belgian army to retreat. The Germans had broken trough at Sedan and were racing towards the coast threatening to cut of the Armies in Belgium from the main body of the French army.
zh: 然而，完全出乎意料的是，5月16日英国远征军开始撤离其在迪尔河的阵地。不久后，比利时军队也接到了撤退命令。德军已在色当突破，正向海岸疾进，威胁要把在比利时的各集团军与法军主力割裂开来。

en: The "Ligne KW" (Dyle line) has withstood German pressure well. The Germans have suffered important losses and have had a rough time to get some small bridgeheads. They will soon be cleaned up.
zh: “KW 防线”（迪尔河防线）很好地顶住了德军的压力。德军损失重大，费了很大力气才夺得几处小桥头堡。这些桥头堡很快就会被肃清。

en: You have done a good job!!!.

Unfortunately, we have received orders to retire. It seems that the German Army has broken the French defences at Sedan and it is now free to drive for the English Channel. To avoid our southern flanks from being turned by the German forces we have to retire once more. Our new defensive line will be the Escaut/Scheldt River.
zh: 遗憾的是，我们已接到后撤的命令。看来德军已突破法军在色当的防御，现在可以自由地向英吉利海峡推进。为避免我军南翼被德军迂回，我们必须再次后撤。新的防线将是斯海尔德河。

en: I know this means abandoning Brussels and Leuven but I am confident we will check the German advance there.
zh: 我知道这意味着放弃布鲁塞尔和鲁汶，但我相信我们能在那里阻止德军前进。

en: Despite your troops engaged several German divisions, you have managed to offer considerable resistance, to delay the German forces and to withdraw from Antwerpen/Anvers in an ordered manner.
zh: 尽管您的部队与德军数个师交战，您仍成功进行了相当顽强的抵抗，迟滞了德军，并有秩序地从安特卫普撤出。

en: Although Antwerpen/Anvers fell on the 18/19 May, the Belgian Army is now taking position in the Gent/Gand bridgehead, behind the Dender/Dendre and Escaut/Scheldt rivers.
zh: 虽然安特卫普已于5月18日至19日陷落，比利时军队现在正进入根特桥头堡，位于登德尔河和斯海尔德河后方。

en: Let's be confident that our improvised positions behind the Escaut/Scheldt River can stop the German offensive.
zh: 让我们相信，我们在斯海尔德河后方临时构筑的阵地能够挡住德军的攻势。

en: Le Chef d'Etat-major général de l’armée (EMGA).

This new retreat was a serious blow on the morale of the Belgian soldiers, who couldn’t understand why they had to retreat and leave not only the fortified position of the "KW line" but also Antwerpen/Anvers and the capital Bruxelles/Brussel.
zh: 这次新的撤退对比利时士兵的士气是一次沉重打击，他们无法理解为何必须撤退，不仅要放弃“KW 防线”的筑垒阵地，还要放弃安特卫普和首都布鲁塞尔。

en: The operation was a real challenge since the Belgian Army had to retreat in some cases 100 km, transport its ammo depots (a lot being destroyed/fired as it was not possible to transport it), use secondary roads (the main ones being used by French and British) packed with compatriot refugees, and all this under the constant presence of the Luftwaffe.
zh: 这次行动是真正的挑战，因为比利时军队有时必须后撤100公里，运送弹药库（由于无法运输，许多弹药被销毁或引爆），走满是同胞难民的次要道路（主要道路被法军和英军占用），而这一切都是在德国空军不断出现的情况下进行的。

en: In the Antwerpen/Anvers sector all Belgian divisions (12th, 13th and 15th infantry divisions) were attacked during their retreat by the German Army, in some cases suffering serious casualties, but eventually managed to retreat over the Escaut/Scheldt River.
zh: 在安特卫普地段，比利时各师（第12、第13和第15步兵师）在撤退途中都遭到德军攻击，有些部队伤亡惨重，但最终都成功撤过了斯海尔德河。

en: As a result of the German breakthrough at Sedan, General Billote, French commander of the Groupe d'Armées n° 1 and coordinator of the Northern front, has decided to retreat from the fortified "Ligne KW" (Dyle position). towards the Escaut/Scheldt river and the Terneuzen-Gent canal.
zh: 由于德军在色当突破，法军第1集团军群司令、北方战线协调人比约特将军决定从筑垒的“KW 防线”（迪尔河阵地）撤往斯海尔德河和泰尔讷曾-根特运河。

en: I know this decision is difficult to understand since its means losing both Antwerpen/Anvers and Bruxelles/Brussel and leaving our strong positions at the "KW line" (Dyle position), but we have to be confident in our allies. The retreat will start in the night of the 17th/18th of May. You must ensure the IV and V Corps retreat to the new positions behind the Escaut/Scheldt river and stop the Germans over it to give time for the redeployment. Our army depots have also to be moved.
zh: 我知道这一决定难以理解，因为它意味着既要放弃安特卫普和布鲁塞尔，又要放弃我们在“KW 防线”（迪尔河阵地）的坚固阵地，但我们必须信任盟友。撤退将于5月17日至18日夜间开始。您必须确保第4军和第5军撤往斯海尔德河后方的新阵地，并把德军阻止在河对岸，以便争取重新部署的时间。我军仓库也必须转移。

en: Some of your units will protect the retreat.
zh: 您的一些部队将负责掩护撤退。

en: Le Chef d'Etat-major général de l’armée (EMGA)
Victory conditions: retreat 24 units, hold the two VH and ensure that the army depot survive.
zh: 胜利条件：撤出24个单位，守住两个胜利格，并确保陆军仓库存活。

en: Warning: you can deploy only 3 units.
You have disappointed us. If you are not able to retreat fresh troops, less will you able to command troops in the offensive.
zh: 您让我们失望了。如果连未受重创的部队都撤不出来，您就更无法在进攻中指挥部队了。

en: A new mission is waiting for you. Go to the canteen and let's hope you are able to cook a good "Waterzooi".
zh: 新的任务正等着您。到食堂去吧，希望您能做好一道“瓦特佐伊炖菜”。

en: Le combat de la Tête de Flandre

The General Staff is proud of your commendable manouvre. You have not only protected the retreat of the "17 Division d'Infanterie" but you have reconquered Zwijndrecht and stopped the German advance, forcing them to cross the Escaut river back. You must now join the rest of the Army for continuing the battle.
zh: 总参谋部为您值得称赞的机动感到自豪。您不仅掩护了“第17步兵师”的撤退，还夺回了兹韦恩德雷赫特，阻止了德军前进，迫使他们退回斯海尔德河对岸。现在您必须与主力会合，继续作战。

en: Le Chef d'Etat-major général de l’armée (EMGA).

On the night of the 18th/19th of May the retreat of the Belgian Army to its new positions behind the Gent-Terneuzen Canal was protected by the cavalry divisions and the 1st "Chausseurs Ardennaises"/"Ardense Jager" division. When the Germans crossed the Escaut/Scheldt river by using a tunnel not completely destroyed in the Antwerpen/Anvers region fierce battles occurred around Zwijndrecht between the German 208th infantry division and units of the Belgian cavalry. The German infantry was not able to advance further due to the attacks performed by Belgian tanks and AFV's (T13). At the end of the day the Belgian units retreated as ordered behind the Gent-Terneuzen canal.
zh: 5月18日至19日夜间，比利时军队撤往根特-泰尔讷曾运河后方新阵地的行动由各骑兵师和第1“阿登猎兵”师掩护。当德军利用安特卫普地区一条未被彻底炸毁的隧道渡过斯海尔德河时，德军第208步兵师与比利时骑兵部队在兹韦恩德雷赫特周边爆发激战。由于比利时坦克和装甲车辆（T13）的攻击，德军步兵未能继续推进。当日结束时，比利时部队奉命撤往根特-泰尔讷曾运河后方。

en: Le combat de la Tête de Flandre
Our troops are taking their new positions behind the Terneuzen canal and the Escaut/Scheldt River. The "Corps de Cavalerie" has to secure this movement.
zh: 我军正在进入泰尔讷曾运河和斯海尔德河后方的新阵地。“骑兵军”必须保障这一行动。

en: We have been informed that some German troops of the 208 Infantry Division have crossed the Escaut/Scheldt river through one of the tunnels in Antwerpen/Anvers that, due once more to the absence of coordination with our allies, has not been completely destroyed.
zh: 我们已获悉，德军第208步兵师的一些部队已通过安特卫普的一条隧道渡过斯海尔德河——这条隧道又一次因为与盟军缺乏协调而未被彻底炸毁。

en: Given that the 17 DI, which is defending the area, is withdrawing to their new positions, you have to help the "2 Division de Cavalerie" to re-establish the situation.
zh: 鉴于防守该地区的第17步兵师正在撤往新阵地，您必须协助“第2骑兵师”恢复局势。

en: Le Chef d'Etat-major général de l’armée (EMGA)
Warning: the 17 DI will retreat in the first turns. You can only deploy 5 units.
zh: 警告：第17步兵师将在最初几个回合撤退。您只能部署5个单位。

en: Victory conditions: to hold 4 VH for a BV, 3 VH for a V and 2 VH for a TV.
zh: 胜利条件：守住4个胜利格为决定性胜利，3个为胜利，2个为战术胜利。

en: You have disappointed us. You were not able to protect the retreat of the "17 Division d'Infanterie" and now not only the unit has been overran and does not longer exit but the German army is just behind us.
zh: 您让我们失望了。您未能掩护“第17步兵师”的撤退，如今该师不仅已被击溃、不复存在，德军还紧追在我们身后。

en: A new mission is waiting for you. Go to the canteen and let's hope you are able to cook a good "Stoemp".
zh: 新的任务正等着您。到食堂去吧，希望您能做好一道“土豆泥”。

zh: 总参谋部对您的机动感到满意。您掩护了“第17步兵师”的撤退，但德军并未停下，已经在向我军新阵地施压。您必须迅速与主力会合，继续作战。

en: Congratulations! Thanks to your stubborn defence and your brave counterattack the German attack has been repelled and all terrain previously lost has been regained.
zh: 祝贺！由于您的顽强防御和英勇反击，德军的进攻已被击退，先前失去的全部土地均已夺回。

en: Unfortunately, the Anglo-French offensives against the German defensive line on the Ardennes/Calais axis have failed and our Army, under pressure, has retreated further, leaving the Germans to capture Terneuzen and Gent/Gand on the 23 May.
zh: 遗憾的是，英法军队对阿登-加来轴线上德军防线的攻势失败了，我军在压力下继续后撤，德军得以在5月23日攻占泰尔讷曾和根特。

en: Le Chef d'Etat-major général de l’armée (EMGA).

On the 20th of May three German divisions went over on the attack at Zelzate, Kwatrecht and Zingem. After some initial success, Belgians immediately started several counterattacks regaining most of the ground previously lost. All German attacks were repelled on the Belgian front and the Germans weren’t able to create bridgeheads over the Escaut and the Terneuzen Canal. Belgian command was confident that the Germans could be stopped at the Schelde/Escaut.
zh: 5月20日，德军三个师在泽尔扎特、夸特雷赫特和津海姆转入进攻。在取得初步胜利后，比利时人立即发起数次反击，夺回了先前失去的大部分土地。德军在比利时战线上的所有进攻均被击退，未能在斯海尔德河和泰尔讷曾运河上建立桥头堡。比利时指挥部相信，德军能够在斯海尔德河被挡住。

en: However, when the Germans shifted its attention towards the British in the south they created in the sector of the 44th Infantry division a bridgehead o over the Schelde/ Escaut, which could be used as a base for future actions.
zh: 然而，当德军把注意力转向南面的英军时，他们在第44步兵师的地段建立了斯海尔德河上的一处桥头堡，可作为日后行动的基地。

en: It seems the Germans have reached the North Sea at Abbeville cutting the Allied armies in two. We are now isolated from our supply lines. The battle of the North has started.
zh: 看来德军已抵达阿布维尔的北海之滨，把盟军一分为二。我们现在与补给线隔绝。北方之战已经开始。

en: The Belgian Army has taken positions on the Terneuzen canal, Gent/Gand bridgehead and the Escaut/Scheldt River. Most of our divisions are under strength and have already lost 1/3 of their material after ten days of continuous fight and several retreats. Some units are close to collapse but the Army in general can still fight.
zh: 比利时军队已在泰尔讷曾运河、根特桥头堡和斯海尔德河上占领阵地。经过十天连续作战和数次撤退，我们大多数师都不满编，且已损失三分之一的装备。有些部队濒临崩溃，但全军总体上仍能战斗。

en: The "Corps de Cavalerie" has to protect the north flank of the deployment replacing the French troops which are moving back to France.
zh: “骑兵军”必须掩护部署的北翼，接替正撤回法国的法军部队。

en: The German 18th Army is tempting to cross our lines in several places. Your mission is to hold the line and avoid the Germans creating any bridgehead.
zh: 德军第18集团军正试图在多处突破我军防线。您的任务是守住防线，不让德军建立任何桥头堡。

en: Le Chef d'Etat-major général de l’armée (EMGA)
Warning: some units may collapse and stop fighting.
zh: 警告：有些部队可能会崩溃并停止战斗。

en: Victory conditions: to hold 4 VH for a BV, 3 VH for a V and 2 VH for a TV.
zh: 胜利条件：守住4个胜利格为决定性胜利，3个为胜利，2个为战术胜利。

en: Due to your ineptitude the Germans have managed to create several bridgeheads over the Escaut and the Terneuzen Canal and are ready to penetrate our defensive line.
zh: 由于您的无能，德军得以在斯海尔德河和泰尔讷曾运河上建立数处桥头堡，并随时可以突入我军防线。

en: A new mission is waiting for you. Go to the canteen and let's hope you are able to cook a good "Gegratineerd witloof".
zh: 新的任务正等着您。到食堂去吧，希望您能做好一道“焗菊苣”。

zh: 赫尔曼·盖尔将军司令部

en: You deserve a promotion! You have managed to completely stop the German advance and eliminate the created bridgehead in a fast and brilliant counterattack. The German 56th Division has suffered heavy casualties.
zh: 您应该得到晋升！您以迅速而出色的反击彻底阻止了德军前进，并消除了其建立的桥头堡。德军第56师伤亡惨重。

en: Le Chef d'Etat-major général de l’armée (EMGA).

In reality, and contrary to other German bridgeheads (e.g. Ronsele), Belgians were not able to recover the lost ground and could only temporary stop the German Army. Other attacks were repelled in the area and indeed heavy losses were inflicted to the Germans.
zh: 实际上，与德军在其他地方（例如龙瑟勒）的桥头堡不同，比利时人未能夺回失去的土地，只能暂时阻止德军。该地区的其他进攻均被击退，德军确实付出了惨重伤亡。

en: La tête de pont de Meigem

The German army has launched a general offensive against our lines. Their main effort seems to be on the Leie/Lys river but our positions at the "Canal Dérivation de la Lys" are also being attacked simultaneously on several places.
zh: 德军已对我军防线发起总攻。其主攻方向似在利斯河，但我们在“利斯河分洪运河”上的阵地也在多处同时遭到攻击。

en: The German 56th Infantry Division has crossed the Canal de Dérivation defended by the 4 "Division d'Infaterie" and has established a bridgehead around the village of Meigem.
zh: 德军第56步兵师已渡过由第4“步兵师”防守的分洪运河，并在梅海姆村周围建立了桥头堡。

en: The "1re Division de Chassesurs Ardennaises" has already been sent to the town of Vinkt to reinforce the front.
zh: “第1阿登猎兵师”已奉命前往芬克特镇增援前线。

en: Send some additional reinforcements to help the 4 "Division d'Infaterie" to repel the Germans and send them back to the other side of the Canal.
zh: 请派出一些额外增援，协助第4“步兵师”击退德军，把他们赶回运河对岸。

en: Le Chef d'Etat-major général de l’armée (EMGA)
Warning: only four units can be deployed and there is no airfiled available (in case you still have some airforce left).
zh: 警告：只能部署四个单位，且没有可用机场（如果您还有空军的话）。

en: In addition, supply has become extremely difficult due to the supremacy of the German Luftwaffe.
zh: 此外，由于德国空军掌握制空权，补给已变得极其困难。

en: Victory conditions: take all VH by turn 8 for a BV, turn 9 for a V and turn 10 for a TV.
zh: 胜利条件：第8回合前夺取全部胜利格为决定性胜利，第9回合为胜利，第10回合为战术胜利。

zh: 我知道德军给了您沉重一击，但您得到了我们的精锐部队作为增援，本应表现得更好。恐怕您该去找新的挑战了。

en: Please read the readme first for installation instructions
You take command from the civil war in Spain, to the "lightning" victories of early World War II - and beyond!
zh: 您将从西班牙内战一路指挥到二战初期那些“闪电”胜利——并走向更远！

en: This campaign will test your abilities as a leader in both Blitzkrieg scenarios and defensive scenarios.
zh: 本战役将在闪击战场景和防御场景中考验您的指挥才能。

en: If you are skillful, you will fight in Afrika, Russia, and even England!
zh: 如果您足够娴熟，您将转战非洲、俄国，甚至英格兰！

en: This campaign features two extensively modified versions of Craig Miller's original campaigns "Blitzkrieg!" and "Greater Europe". At the choice scenario following Dunkirk you can choose which campaign to play.  If you choose to do the "Greater Europe" campaign path please be aware that you will need a moderate air force (3-4 fighters) in order to win the scenario Invasion!.
zh: 本战役包含 Craig Miller 原版战役“闪击战！”和“大欧洲”的两个经大幅修改的版本。在敦刻尔克之后的抉择场景中，您可以选择游玩哪条战役线。如果您选择“大欧洲”战役路线，请注意您需要一支中等规模的空军（3-4架战斗机）才能赢下“入侵！”场景。

en: Veteran players should play this campaign at 25-50, experienced players at 75, newbies at 100-150.
zh: 老手玩家应以25-50难度游玩本战役，有经验的玩家以75，新手以100-150。
装备：LatinGeneral 的 efile（使用7.57版测试）
战役转换者：Jan Hedstrom（又称 PzManiac）

en: Please read the readme first for installation instructions, particularly if you are unfamiliar with user-made campaigns.
zh: 安装前请先阅读 readme，尤其是当您不熟悉玩家自制战役时。

en: November 1942 was a turning point in the war. The Germans made some grave strategic errors. In this campaign OKW decides to send three divisions originally meant to be send to Paulus to send instead to bolster part of the Romanian front line north of Stalingrad.
zh: 1942年11月是战争的转折点。德军犯下了一些严重的战略错误。在本战役中，国防军最高统帅部决定把原本要派给保卢斯的三个师改派去加强斯大林格勒以北罗马尼亚战线的一段。

en: Version 3.0 This is a conversion of Maarten's original campaign that used the BP efile.
zh: 3.0版 这是对 Maarten 原战役（使用 BP efile）的转换。

en: Version 3.1 This campaign version is an updated version of Maarten's original campaign where the late war scenarios have been redesigned and move to other maps.
zh: 3.1版 本战役版本是 Maarten 原战役的更新版，后期战争场景经过重新设计并移到了其他地图上。

en: Thanks to Maarten for letting me convert his campaign..
zh: 感谢 Maarten 允许我转换他的战役。

en: After the first success against the British (and against the orders of Hitler), the situation is turning positive for us. The British are withdrawing thier troops, Mersa el Brega has fallen into our hands, and now we must continue the offensive on towards Benghazi, then later to Mechilli. In this way, Cyrenaica will be secured, and the front lines restored for the moment.
zh: 在对英军取得首次胜利之后（此举也违背了希特勒的命令），形势正朝着有利于我们的方向转变。英军正在撤走其部队，梅尔萨布赖加已落入我们手中，现在我们必须继续向班加西、随后向梅基利进攻。这样，昔兰尼加就能得到确保，战线也可暂时恢复。

en: This is a disaster!, the British have recaptured Agedabia and Mersa el Brega, and are now driving to Tripoli!!!. Obviously, you are dimissed.
zh: 这是一场灾难！英军已夺回艾季达比耶和梅尔萨布赖加，如今正向的黎波里推进！！！显然，您被解职了。

en: Kongratulieren!, the High Command is grateful for your actions. We hoped to preserve the front lines, however you have completed the conquest of Cyrenaica.
zh: 恭喜！最高统帅部对您的行动表示感谢。我们本只希望守住战线，而您却完成了对昔兰尼加的征服。
哈勒法亚隘口与塞卢姆之战
第1营/75炮兵团/5轻装师/[非洲军]

en: Well done!, The British have fought hard to kick us out from Fort Capuzzo, but it's still in our hands.
zh: 干得好！英军拼命想把我们赶出卡普佐堡，但堡垒仍在我们手中。

en: A lot of armoured units have been spotted in our forward positions. Surely, the enemy is trying to stop our assault on Tobruk, which is completely besiged now. Unfortunately we must halt the attack on Tobruk, to stop the British attack!. On the other hand, beware the enemy units from Tobruk, if you don't take care, they will be able to attack us from behind.
zh: 我军前沿阵地发现大量装甲部队。敌人肯定是在设法阻止我们对托布鲁克的进攻，而托布鲁克现在已被彻底包围。遗憾的是，我们必须停止对托布鲁克的攻击，以阻止英军的进攻！另一方面，要提防托布鲁克的敌军部队，一不留神，他们就会从背后袭击我们。

en: Historically, at this time the DAK was composed of the 15th Panzer Division, the 21st Panzer Division (formerly 5 Leichte Division, 5 LD) plus 6 Italian Divisions (many of them with outdated equipment). Operation Crusader was finally a stalemate, but the DAK withdrew from its positions, and on December the 24th, Benghazi fell again into the Allies hands.
zh: 从历史上看，此时非洲军由第15装甲师、第21装甲师（原第5轻装师，5 LD）以及6个意大利师（其中许多装备陈旧）组成。十字军行动最终打成僵局，但非洲军撤出了阵地，12月24日，班加西再次落入盟军之手。

en: Fortunately the British offensive has been stopped. However we must withdraw our units to safer positions.
zh: 幸运的是，英军的攻势已被阻止。不过我们必须把部队撤到更安全的位置。

en: The time for the counteroffensive has arrived. After the first victories in the past year, the British have again recaptured Cyrenaica.  Now we are in a good position to attack Mersa el Brega, and maybe then, Agedabia. If we can retake these points we will be able to siege Benghazi again and maybe recapture Cyrenaica, restoring the front lines of the past year.
zh: 反攻的时刻到了。在去年取得最初的胜利之后，英军再次夺回了昔兰尼加。现在我们处于有利位置，可以进攻布赖加港，或许接着进攻阿杰达比亚。如果我们能夺回这些要点，就能再次围困班加西，或许还能收复昔兰尼加，恢复去年的战线。

en: Kongratulieren!, the past year's frontlines have been restored here.
zh: 祝贺！去年的战线已在此地恢复。

en: After our success in the retaking of Mersa el Brega and Agedabia, the counteroffensive must continue. The British are now trying to regroup some units in the Beda Fomm - Bengazhi - Mechilli area. These units are surely the remnants of the enemy 1st Armored Division, and the 4th Indian division, which intelligence reports indicate is deployed around Bengazhi.
zh: 在成功夺回布赖加港和阿杰达比亚之后，反攻必须继续下去。英军目前正试图在贝达富姆——班加西——梅基利一带重整部分部队。这些部队肯定是敌军第1装甲师和第4印度师的残部，情报显示后者部署在班加西周边。

en: The mission is to re-establish the 1941 lines here, capturing Bengazhi, and then, reaching Mechilli.
zh: 任务是在此重建 1941年的战线，夺取班加西，随后进抵梅基利。

en: Well done. We have recaptured the important port of Benghazi, and now, onwards to Tobruk!.
zh: 干得好。我们夺回了重要的班加西港，现在，向托布鲁克前进！
加扎拉防线 [忒修斯行动]

en: The whole Cyrenaica area is now under our control, however we know that the enemy have established a defensive line between the villages of Gazalla and Bir Hacheim. Aufklarung reports shows that the British are using anti-personnel, as well as anti-tank mine fields in that line to stop our advance on towards Egypt.
zh: 整个昔兰尼加地区现在都在我们控制之下，但我们知道敌人已在加扎拉和比尔哈凯姆两村之间建立了一道防线。侦察报告显示，英军在这道防线上布设了反步兵和反坦克雷场，以阻止我们向埃及推进。

en: Your task is to accomplish the codenamed ,,Operation Theseus''. This operation means to break the enemy lines in the Bir Hacheim area using the best of the DAK armored forces, and make a fast advance behind the front lines, surrounding the enemy. Finally, you should assault the Tobruk fortress, and take all the other mission objetives.
zh: 你的任务是执行代号“忒修斯行动”的作战。此行动意在动用非洲军最精锐的装甲部队突破比尔哈凯姆地区的敌军防线，迅速向敌后推进，包围敌人。最后，你应当突击托布鲁克要塞，并夺取所有其他任务目标。

en: This is a really important victory!, the British have been completely surprised by your Southern "hook". The Gazala Line is destroyed, and also Tobruk has fallen in our hands. Kongratulieren.
zh: 这是一场极其重要的胜利！英军被你从南面的“迂回”完全打了个措手不及。加扎拉防线已被摧毁，托布鲁克也落入我们手中。祝贺。

en: Mersa Matruh is taken!, the High Command wants to tell you that Operation Hercules will be launched in the next few hours to take the island of Malta, as a reward for your outstanding actions.
zh: 马特鲁港已被拿下！最高统帅部要告诉您，作为对您杰出表现的奖赏，赫拉克勒斯行动将在未来数小时内发起，以夺取马耳他岛。

en: Congratulations Herr Feldmarshal!!, High Command have prommoted you due to your good actions in the past. Now, the next aim should be the Mersa Matruh area. The enemy is trying to build up another defensive line in this place. The reports are indicating that this time the enemy lines are weaker than in Gazala. On the other hand, the enemy forces are bigger, and surely will outnumber our troops again. The mission objetive is to make a fast assault from the South, like at Gazala, surprising the enemy with our fastest units, and finally assaulting the fortified point of Mersa Matruh.
zh: 祝贺您，元帅！鉴于您过去的出色表现，最高统帅部已提升您的军衔。现在，下一个目标应当是马特鲁港地区。敌人正试图在此地再建一道防线。报告显示，这次敌军防线比加扎拉要薄弱。另一方面，敌军兵力更多，肯定又会超过我军。任务目标是从南面发起快速突击，如同在加扎拉那样，用我们最快的部队打敌人一个措手不及，最后突击马特鲁港要塞。

en: Mersa Matruh is taken!, now, we must continue our drive on to Egypt.
zh: 马特鲁港已被拿下！现在，我们必须继续向埃及推进。
卡雷特艾尔希梅斯纳特

en: The enemy has been completely surprised and destroyed by your actions!, now the way to Egypt is clear. Your next mission is to assault the historical port of Alexandria.
zh: 在你的行动下，敌人被彻底打了个措手不及并被歼灭！通往埃及的道路已经打开。你的下一个任务是突击历史名城亚历山大港。

en: The enemy have stopped our units. We must dig in and await the next British strikes, this won't be easy General...
zh: 敌人挡住了我军。我们必须构筑工事，等待英军的下一次打击，这不会轻松，将军……

en: The enemy has been surprised, however we could not get the complete victory, some units have escaped, and surely the British will launch a counteroffensive...
zh: 敌人被打了个措手不及，但我们未能取得全胜，部分敌军逃脱了，英军肯定会发动反攻……
卡雷特艾尔希梅斯纳特

en: The enemy has been completely surprised and destroyed by your actions!, now, the way to Egypt is clear. Your next mission is to assault the historical port of Alexandria.
zh: 在你的行动下，敌人被彻底打了个措手不及并被歼灭！通往埃及的道路已经打开。你的下一个任务是突击历史名城亚历山大港。

en: The situation is becoming really dangerous, we have an important lack of fuel and tanks, and the enemy has air superiority. Also the minefileds, are inflicting big losses on our units... We will launch a last hit to the British, hoping to surprise them like in the past - otherwise you must fight at any cost, until the last man!.
zh: 局势正变得极为危险，我们严重缺乏燃料和坦克，而敌人握有制空权。此外，雷场也让我们的部队损失惨重……我们将对英军发动最后一击，希望能像过去那样打他们一个措手不及——否则你就必须不惜一切代价战斗到底，直到最后一人！

en: Historically, the British had decoded the German ''Enigma'' codes and knew all the German plans, Montgomery was able to make special plans to force out the Germans from El Alamein. Marshall Rommel didn't follow the order to fight at any cost and in November the 12th, he started the retreat of the DAK.
zh: 从历史上看，英军已破译了德军的“恩尼格玛”密码，掌握了德军的所有计划，蒙哥马利因而得以制订特别方案，把德军逐出阿拉曼。隆美尔元帅没有执行战斗到底的命令，11月12日，他开始了非洲军的撤退。

en: This is a disaster, now we must make a retreat to Tunis to avoid the complete destruction of the Deutsches Afrikakorps...
zh: 这是一场灾难，现在我们只能撤往突尼斯，以免德意志非洲军全军覆没……

en: In 1941 the Italian Army was unable to face up to the British in Africa. After a year of disasters, they called for help from their German allies. Germany couldn't spare many resources to fight the British in Africa, so on February 12th 1941 they sent General Rommel plus the first German equipment and men to Tripoli.
zh: 1941年，意大利军队在非洲无力对抗英军。经历了一年的惨败之后，他们向德国盟友求援。德国抽不出多少资源在非洲与英军作战，于是在 1941年2月12日把隆美尔将军以及第一批德国装备和人员派往的黎波里。

en: Can you manage the Deutsches Afrika-Korps to victory, and better Rommel's achievements in Africa?.
zh: 你能率领德意志非洲军走向胜利，并超越隆美尔在非洲的战绩吗？

en: Campaign Creators: Santiago Fuertes & Pablo Schlegel
zh: 战役作者：Santiago Fuertes & Pablo Schlegel

en: Obviously you need to take a rest. Another General will replace you now as C-in-C of the DAK. (You are dimised).
zh: 看来你需要休息一下了。另一位将军将接替你出任非洲军总司令。（你被解职了。）
第104装甲步兵团//第21装甲师/非洲军

en: Excellent, you've captured the oil reserves found in Tebessa.
zh: 好极了，你已夺取泰贝萨的石油储备。

en: Your next operation will be to try and enclose the Anglo-American Armies in Bone.
zh: 你的下一次作战将是设法把英美军队合围于博讷。

en: Anglo-American forces have disembarked in French territory, moving at full speed toward Tunisia. After your recent victory in Alexandria, we cannot affort a counterattack from behind. Due to your inexperienced rivals, their positions are very weak, but they are greater in number and better supplied.
zh: 英美军队已在法国领土登陆，正全速向突尼斯推进。你在亚历山大取得最近的胜利之后，我们绝不能容忍背后遭到反击。由于你的对手缺乏经验，他们的阵地十分薄弱，但他们人数更多，补给也更充足。

en: Your mission:- Advance at full speed and take Tebessa.
zh: 你的任务：——全速推进并夺取泰贝萨。

en: Note: In Tebessa the Allies have a great oil reserve, that if you capture, will allow you to perform future offensive operations.
zh: 注：盟军在泰贝萨存有大量石油储备，若你将其夺取，便可在此后实施进攻作战。

en: You couldn't force the Allies back into Tunisia, so it's impossible to defend Alexandria and Tunisia with the few units we have.
zh: 你未能迫使盟军退入突尼斯，因此仅凭我们手中这点部队，既守不住亚历山大，也守不住突尼斯。

en: From now on, you will be on the defensive.
zh: 从现在起，你将转入防御。

en: The Anglo-American attempt to surprise us from behind was a total failure, from now on we can concentrate on thinking about our next offensive target.
zh: 英美军队从背后突袭我们的企图彻底失败，从现在起，我们可以专心考虑下一个进攻目标了。

en: Thanks to your great successes, we now have the possibility of surrounding the rookie armies going towards the Tunisian coast, more exactly, the city of Bone.
zh: 多亏你取得的巨大胜利，我们现在有机会合围正在向突尼斯海岸推进的新手部队，更确切地说，是博讷城。

en: If you are successful, they won't have any choice but to surrender.
zh: 若你成功，他们将别无选择，只能投降。

en: You have failed to make Allies to retreat in Tunisia, so it's impossible to defend Alexandria and Tunisia with the few units we have.
zh: 你未能迫使盟军在突尼斯撤退，因此仅凭我们手中这点部队，既守不住亚历山大，也守不住突尼斯。

en: From now on, you will be on the defensive.
zh: 从现在起，你将转入防御。

en: Ja Wolfgang, I was as surprised as you that they chose Normandy.... Ah, Herr General, come in. Allow me to explain the present situation. We have a chance to drive the Allies back into the sea, here, near Caen. I will not pretend that this will be an easy task, but you have shown yourself to be a most resourceful fellow time and time again, ja? You will need all your skill to wrest a victory here. Our thoughts are with you. Ja, As I was saying, Wolfgang....
zh: 是啊，沃尔夫冈，他们竟选择了诺曼底，我和你一样吃惊……啊，将军阁下，请进。请允许我说明当前局势。我们有机会把盟军赶下海，就在这里，卡昂附近。我不会假装这是一件轻松的事，但你已经一次又一次证明自己足智多谋，是吧？你需要用上全部本领才能在此赢得胜利。我们与你同在。是啊，就像我刚才说的，沃尔夫冈……

en: Herr General, I know that you and your men have not had time even to catch a breath, but the situation here is critical. Buda-Pest is besieged by the Bolsheviks. Your troops must force their way into the city. It is doubtful that our Hungarian allies will continue to fight if Buda-Pest falls. If you can drive the Reds into the Danube, we may stop the Russian Bear from consuming us.
zh: 将军阁下，我知道你和你的部下连喘口气的时间都没有，但此地局势十分危急。布达佩斯正被布尔什维克围困。你的部队必须强行突入城内。如果布达佩斯陷落，我们的匈牙利盟友是否还会继续作战就很值得怀疑了。如果你能把赤色分子赶进多瑙河，我们或许还能阻止那头俄国熊把我们吞掉。

en: Herr General, we have underestimated the Bolsheviks' powers of resistance. They have crossed the Don and completely encircled Sixth Army. You must drive on Kletskaya and Serafimov to reestablish contact. We will never, never surrender to the Red Army, but in order for us to hold our position, you must prevail. Good Luck.
zh: 将军阁下，我们低估了布尔什维克的抵抗能力。他们已渡过顿河，彻底包围了第六集团军。你必须向克列茨卡亚和谢拉菲莫维奇推进，以恢复联系。我们绝不会，绝不会向红军投降，但为了守住阵地，你必须取胜。祝好运。

en: Crusade in Spain: North in Flames
zh: 西班牙十字军：北方烽火

en: In Mola's plan the main goal  was the capture of Madrid.  The North of Spain was a secondary problem at the beginning of the subdivision.  It was soon obvious that Madrid would not fall by a frontal assault. General Mola has selected you as his most trusted officer to spearhead the attacks on the non-loyal northern  provinces of the rebellion.  Then, who knows?
zh: 在莫拉的方案中，首要目标是夺取马德里。在作战划分之初，西班牙北部只是次要问题。但很快就清楚，马德里不会因正面强攻而陷落。莫拉将军已选定你为他最信任的军官，去带头攻击那些不忠于叛军的北方省份。此后会怎样，谁知道呢？

en: Irun - Closing the Spanish - French border
zh: 伊伦——封锁西班牙-法国边境
志愿兵/传统主义西班牙长枪党/[迪亚斯·杜纳韦蒂亚]

en: AIRFIELD: OUT OF THE MAP LIMITS

Well done!  You gave the Reds got a good licking at Guipuzcoa.  Now they will be unable to receive more supplies or weapons from France.  It's only a matter of time until the north is in our hands.  I'm sorry but you are not going to have time to enjoy the summer in San Sebastian.  I have another important task for you and it must be done quickly!
zh: 干得好！你在吉普斯夸狠狠教训了赤色分子。现在他们再也无法从法国获得补给或武器了。北方落入我们手中只是时间问题。很抱歉，你没时间在圣塞瓦斯蒂安享受夏天了。我另有一项重要任务交给你，必须尽快完成！

en: Irun - Closing the Spanish - French border
zh: 伊伦——封锁西班牙-法国边境
命令发自：潘普洛纳（纳瓦拉）1936年8月

en: Buenos dias Sr.General!  Our glorious patriotic movement to save Spain is progressing well.  However, we need to do some operations in the northern provinces.  Our attack on Asturias, Santander, Vizcaya and Guipuzcoa (where our garrison has been defeated) have failed miserably.  That ridiculous northern strip of land it's still loyal to the Madrid government!  We can't tolerate this.  While our brave men are battling the enemy at the republic's capital, you will take command of some units and attack at Guipuzcoa.  Some reinforcements will arrive following the southwest axis of Urnieta - Hernani - San Sebastian.  Also some naval units are sailing up from the El Ferrol naval base to support your offensive with their heavy fire power.
zh: 早上好，将军阁下！我们拯救西班牙的光荣爱国运动进展顺利。不过，我们还需在北方各省采取一些行动。我们对阿斯图里亚斯、桑坦德、比斯开和吉普斯夸（我军驻军已在此被击败）的进攻都惨遭失败。那条可笑的北方狭长地带仍然效忠于马德里政府！我们不能容忍这种情况。趁我们英勇的将士在共和国首都与敌交战之际，你将指挥一些部队进攻吉普斯夸。部分增援将沿乌尔涅塔——埃尔纳尼——圣塞瓦斯蒂安的西南轴线抵达。此外，一些海军舰艇正从费罗尔海军基地上驶，以重炮火力支援你的攻势。

en: This province is extremely important.  Intelligence shows that the French have been supplying weapons to the Republicans here.  We must close the border with France and stop any kind of aid to the People's Front in the North.  One more thing: be aware that we must not shoot over the French border.  We don't want to supply the French an excuse to give their full support to the Republicans.
zh: 这个省极其重要。情报显示，法国人一直在向此地的共和派提供武器。我们必须封锁与法国的边境，制止对北方人民阵线的一切援助。还有一件事：注意我们不得越界射击法国境内。我们不想给法国人借口，让他们全力支持共和派。

en: Espero los mejores resultados de sus acciones, General.
zh: 期待你行动的最佳结果，将军。

en: Esto es un desastre!. Our attack has been crushed and our units destroyed.  The enemies have consolidated their positions around San Sebastian and now the north is a dangerous knife aiming at Navarra and Castilla, the backbone of our advance on to Madrid...
zh: 这是一场灾难！我们的进攻被粉碎，部队被歼灭。敌军已在圣塞瓦斯蒂安周边巩固阵地，如今北方成了一把危险的尖刀，直指纳瓦拉和卡斯蒂利亚——我们向马德里推进的支柱……

en: Esta usted citado para un consejo de guerra!
zh: 你已被传唤接受军事法庭审判！

en: A major problem was the rough terrain, but you have established excellent positions near the Nalon river.  The Reds quarters at both Simancas and Zapadores have fallen and we are now at the gates of Oviedo.  We must press on to save our brave fellows from the Red onslaught and show the world that we are not going to surrender without a fight.
zh: 崎岖地形曾是个大问题，但你已在纳隆河附近建立了极佳的阵地。赤色分子在锡曼卡斯和萨帕多雷斯的营地均已陷落，我们现在已兵临奥维耶多城下。我们必须继续推进，把勇敢的弟兄们从赤色分子的猛攻中解救出来，并向世界表明我们不会不战而降。
命令发自：潘普洛纳（纳瓦拉），1936年8月

en: Me alegra verle de nuevo, Sr. General.  Well, after securing a victory at Guipuzcoa, we must turn our attention to Asturias.  Since July our brave comrades have been suffering under siege from the Reds.  In Gijon, our quarters have been surrounded and our men trapped.  They are rapidly running out of supplies and can barely continue resisting.   So in the future we can only anticipate more bad news from Gijon.  In Oviedo Colonel Aranda has secured the city.   However, the Asturian capital is also under siege and about to fall.
zh: 很高兴再次见到您，将军阁下。我们在吉普斯夸取得胜利之后，必须把注意力转向阿斯图里亚斯。自7月以来，我们勇敢的同志一直遭受赤色分子的围攻。在希洪，我们的营地被包围，弟兄们被困其中。他们的补给正迅速耗尽，几乎无法继续抵抗。因此今后我们只能预料从希洪传来更多坏消息。在奥维耶多，阿兰达上校已控制该城。然而，这座阿斯图里亚斯首府同样被围，即将陷落。

en: Your main task is to advance your troops to the center of Asturian and to give further assistance to Gijon and Oviedo.  You may recruit troops for a column under your command.
zh: 你的主要任务是率部推进到阿斯图里亚斯中部，向希洪和奥维耶多提供进一步支援。你可以招募部队，组成一支由你指挥的纵队。

en: Nuestros camaradas esperan su ayuda, dese prisa.
zh: 我们的同志期盼你的援助，请从速。

en: Su incompetencia ha resultado funesta para la causa nacional!   The quarters at Gijon have fallen along with the whole city of Oviedo.   I have received reports that the execution of Colonel Aranda will be tomorrow.  Yours may soon follow.
zh: 你的无能给民族事业带来了灾难性后果！希洪的营地已经陷落，奥维耶多全城也随之失守。我收到报告说，阿兰达上校将于明天被处决。你的死期或许也不远了。

en: Oh thank God!, you have saved us General.  We ran out of ammunition and supplies.  Me and my staff were fearing the worst as the Reds were over running the city.  Now, we can continue to protect Oviedo.
zh: 哦，谢天谢地！你救了我们，将军。我们的弹药和补给都已耗尽。赤色分子占领全城时，我和我的参谋都料想最坏的结果。现在，我们可以继续保卫奥维耶多了。

en: Your HQ at: Salas, Asturias, October 1936
zh: 你的司令部设于：阿斯图里亚斯，萨拉斯，1936年10月

en: Mi General!  We have received an urgent telegram from Burgos:
zh: 将军阁下！我们收到布尔戈斯发来的紧急电报：

en: HQ - Army of the North - Burgos
zh: 北方集团军司令部——布尔戈斯

en: Dramatic situation at Oviedo STOP Colonel Aranda is desperately resisting against the Red offensive at the capital STOP Our men at Oviedo are running out of ammunition STOP Loyal columns on the Nalon river line should break the siege ASAP STOP Suggested direction towards Grado and across the Nalon then to Oviedo STOP Must act immediately END
zh: 奥维耶多局势危急 停止 阿兰达上校正在首都拼死抵抗赤色分子的攻势 停止 我们在奥维耶多的部队弹药即将耗尽 停止 纳隆河一线的效忠派纵队应尽快打破包围 停止 建议方向为经格拉多渡过纳隆河再前往奥维耶多 停止 必须立即行动 完

zh: 机场 地图范围之外
比利亚雷亚尔德阿拉瓦

en: Excelente, excelente!  The enemy offensive was ill conceived and the Republicans have been stopped.    This forced them to discontinue their ''advance'' on Vitoria.  General, we will soon initiate future operations in the North.
zh: 好极了，好极了！敌人的攻势考虑不周，共和派已被挡住。这迫使他们中止了对维多利亚的“推进”。将军，我们很快将在北方发起新的作战。
命令发自：潘普洛纳（纳瓦拉），1936年12月

en: Mi general, debo de comunicarle que.  The Republicans have begun attacking our positions at Alava and northwards to Vitoria.  Their main goal is to cut our lines and then attack Vitoria.  This will be very serious if don't take care of it now.
zh: 将军阁下，我必须向您报告。共和派已开始进攻我们在阿拉瓦的阵地，并向北进攻维多利亚。他们的主要目标是切断我们的交通线，然后进攻维多利亚。如果我们现在不处理，这将非常严重。

en: Most of the attacking units are composed of Basque battalions.  We expected this attack from the East via the Mondragon Valley.  Headquarters doesn't think the Basque troops will be able to hold the lines they have established.  Unfortunately at that location we are not prepared to stop their offensive.  So you are ordered to deploy your troops in Alava and stop the enemy offensive as soon as possible.  One more thing, we have numerical air superiority thanks to our German friends, but as you have seen the Republican flown soviet planes are superior to the German planes.  Use your air power carefully.
zh: 进攻部队大多由巴斯克营组成。我们预料到这次进攻会经蒙德拉贡谷地从东面而来。司令部认为巴斯克部队无力守住他们建立的战线。遗憾的是，在那一带我们并未做好阻止他们攻势的准备。因此，你受命在阿拉瓦部署部队，尽快阻止敌军攻势。还有一点，多亏我们的德国朋友，我们在航空兵力上占有数量优势，但如你所见，共和派驾驶的苏联飞机优于德国飞机。请谨慎使用你的空中力量。

en: Como?... Al parecer, the Basque troops are now in Vitoria.  Our operations in the center of Spain have been discontinued in order to gather some reserves from our southern columns to repair your ''problems'' at Alava.
zh: 什么？……看来巴斯克部队现已进入维多利亚。我们在西班牙中部的作战已经中止，以便从南方各纵队抽调一些预备队来收拾你在阿拉瓦的“麻烦”。

en: BREAKING NEWS:  While flying to a meeting with Generalisimo Franco General Mola’s plane crashed near Burgos.  There were no survivors.
zh: 突发新闻：在飞往与佛朗哥大元帅会晤的途中，莫拉将军的座机在布尔戈斯附近坠毁。无人生还。

en: Telegram from Burgos, Generalisimo HQ:  Well done my General - stop - The entire Euzkadi is in our hands now - stop  All the industries and factories are now producing for  National Spain - stop  From now on you will receive orders exclusively from this HQ - stop.
zh: 布尔戈斯，大元帅司令部电报：干得好，我的将军 - 停止 - 整个欧斯卡迪现在都在我们手中 - 停止 所有工业和工厂现在都在为民族西班牙生产 - 停止 从现在起，你只接受本司令部的命令 - 停止。
命令发自：潘普洛纳（纳瓦拉）1936年5月

en: Buenos dias General.  It is my pleasure to put you in command of the offensive at Bilbao. The newly created Brigadas Navarras are now under your direct command as well as the 2nd Italian Division that was deployed in Spain to defeat the Marxists.  A large number of artillery pieces and air recourses will support your storming the enemy lines.  I suggest you use the close support tactics of the Germans to eliminate the Republican battalions.
zh: 早上好，将军。我很高兴任命你指挥毕尔巴鄂攻势。新组建的纳瓦拉旅以及为击败马克思主义者而部署到西班牙的第2意大利师，现在都由你直接指挥。大量火炮和航空资源将支援你强击敌军防线。我建议你采用德国人的近距支援战术来消灭共和派各营。

en: It's imperative you take Bilbao as soon as possible.  I know if the Vizcayan capital falls the Basque nationalist battalions will surrender.  The Republicans think they are safe behind those bunkers around Bilbao, the ''Cinturon de Hierro'', but that's just a myth!  The engineer who designed the fortified line, Alejandro Goicoechea, is now on our side. Thanks to him, we have all the blueprints of the bunkers.  Only about 40 percent of the lines were completed and the most important thing is we know where the weak points are.
zh: 你必须尽快夺取毕尔巴鄂，这一点至关重要。我知道，一旦比斯开首府陷落，巴斯克民族主义各营就会投降。共和派以为他们躲在毕尔巴鄂周边那些掩体后面很安全，那道“铁环防线”，但那只是个神话！设计这条筑垒线的工程师亚历杭德罗·戈伊科埃切亚现在站在我们这边。多亏了他，我们掌握了这些掩体的全部图纸。整条防线只完成了约百分之四十，而最重要的是我们知道薄弱点在哪里。

en: Deploy your forces and begin the attack.  One more thing my General, In the near future I'm planning a personal meeting with General Franco.  We will discuss my role in the new government, so I will be gone for a couple of days.  Oh, one last thing.  Thanks to our Italian friends you can add some Italian units to your army.
zh: 部署你的部队并开始进攻。还有一件事，我的将军，不久的将来我打算与佛朗哥将军私下会晤。我们将讨论我在新政府中的角色，所以我会离开几天。哦，最后一件事。多亏我们的意大利朋友，你可以给你的军队增添一些意大利部队。

en: Su incompetencia ha resultado funesta para la causa nacional!  Bilbao is a new Madrid and it is rumored that the French are planning to re-open the frontier and send supplies to the Republicans.
zh: 你的无能给民族事业带来了灾难性后果！毕尔巴鄂成了新的马德里，而且有传言说法国人正打算重新开放边境，向共和派运送补给。

en: Muy bien... The Republicans have been kicked out of Teruel and now they are in total retreat.   They are scrambling for good positions to protect their new capital, Valencia.
zh: 非常好……共和派已被逐出特鲁埃尔，现在他们全线撤退。他们正争相抢占有利阵地，以保卫他们的新首都巴伦西亚。
命令发自：布尔戈斯，1938年1月

en: Esto es urgente!  The Reds have defeated the 4th Brigade deployed at Teruel. Many prisoners were captured including the garrison commander Colonel Rey D'Harcourt.  The extreme cold and snow prevents us from deploying our air power to help smash the enemy advance.  This will be maybe problematic, but the Generalisimo's staff thinks your troops can retake Teruel.  This would allow us to continue our march to the Mediterranean.
zh: 此事紧急！赤色分子击败了部署在特鲁埃尔的第4旅。许多人员被俘，其中包括守备司令雷·迪亚尔库尔上校。严寒和大雪使我们无法动用航空兵力协助粉碎敌军攻势。这或许会有些麻烦，但大元帅的参谋部认为你的部队能够夺回特鲁埃尔。这将使我们得以继续向地中海进军。

en: Esto es un desastre!  Your attack has best crushed and our units destroyed. The enemy has consolidated their positions around Teruel and now we have suspended our attack on the Mediterranean.
zh: 这是一场灾难！你的进攻被粉碎，我们的部队被歼灭。敌军已在特鲁埃尔周边巩固阵地，现在我们已中止向地中海的进攻。

en: Esta usted citado para un consejo de guerra!
zh: 你已被传唤接受军事法庭审判！

en: Muy bien... The Republicans have been kicked out of Teruel and now they are in total retreat.   They are scrambling for good positions to protect their new capital, Valencia.
zh: 非常好……共和派已被逐出特鲁埃尔，现在他们全线撤退。他们正争相抢占有利阵地，以保卫他们的新首都巴伦西亚。

en: Excelente! Excelente!  All of  north Spain is now into our hands. We can now turn our attention to the center front.  Your next destination will be Aragon.   We are formulating a special operation to reach the Mediterranean and take Valencia, the new Republican capital.
zh: 好极了！好极了！整个西班牙北方现在都在我们手中。我们现在可以把注意力转向中部前线。你的下一个目标是阿拉贡。我们正在制订一项特别行动，以进抵地中海并夺取共和派的新首都巴伦西亚。

en: Soon you and your men will be deployed as reserves in Aragon and await further orders.
zh: 不久你和你的部下将被部署到阿拉贡作为预备队，等候进一步命令。
阿斯图里亚斯的最后阶段
命令发自：布尔戈斯，1937年9月

en: The Red army at Santander has been completely destroyed.  Only a few remnants have escaped to Asturias where they are now joined with the Asturian forces.  The enemy knows where to stop us in the mountains, but it's isolated.  The Republican government at Valencia can't send any kind of aid to the Asturians and it's just a matter of time until they are defeated.  However we must not allow the enemy to stage a heroic defense.  The winter in the mountains of Asturias is very hard and it will be the best ally for the Republicans.  Your task, mi General, is to get a quick and smashing victory.  Then, we will be able to turn our attention to the Aragon front.
zh: 桑坦德的红军已被彻底消灭。只有少数残部逃入阿斯图里亚斯，现在与阿斯图里亚斯部队会合。敌人知道在哪里能阻挡我们，但那是块与世隔绝的地方。巴伦西亚的共和派政府无法向阿斯图里亚斯人提供任何援助，他们被击败只是时间问题。然而我们绝不能容许敌人上演一场英雄式的防御。阿斯图里亚斯山区的冬天十分严酷，它将成为共和派最好的盟友。你的任务，将军阁下，是取得一场迅速而彻底的胜利。此后，我们就能把注意力转向阿拉贡前线。

en: Como? This situation is absolutely unacceptable. The Republicans have prevailed and now their murderous units are marching into the Asturian Mountains, where they will put many civilians at risk.  You'll soon have a meeting with a court martial General.
zh: 什么？这种局面绝对不可接受。共和派占了上风，如今他们那些嗜杀成性的部队正开进阿斯图里亚斯山区，那里会有许多平民陷入危险。你很快就会去见军事法庭的将军。

zh: 致命一击：粉碎埃布罗河集团军
比利亚尔瓦德洛斯阿尔科斯
阿尔胡塞马斯第10塔博尔

en: Mis felicitaciones General.  The best troops of the Red army have been destroyed at Ebro.  We do not expect any further offensive operations from the Reds and we can soon begin to think of a victorious end to this war.
zh: 向您祝贺，将军。红军最精锐的部队已在埃布罗河被消灭。我们预计赤色分子不会再有进一步的进攻行动，我们很快就可以开始考虑如何胜利结束这场战争了。

en: Coup de Grace: Smashing the Ebro's Army
zh: 致命一击：粉碎埃布罗河集团军
命令发自：布尔戈斯，1938年9月

en: You are aware that after we split the Republic into two territories the Reds launched a powerful strike across the Ebro River in August.  Although they took us by surprise and inflicted some losses; the brave National Army reacted quickly stopping the enemy at the gates of Gandesa.  Your orders are to deploy your troops and ruthlessly crush the Reds in the Ebro pocket.
zh: 你清楚，在我们把共和国切成两块领土之后，赤色分子于8月跨过埃布罗河发动了一次强大突击。尽管他们打了我们一个措手不及并造成了一些损失，但英勇的国民军迅速反应，在甘德萨城下挡住了敌人。你的命令是部署部队，在埃布罗河袋形阵地无情地粉碎赤色分子。

en: No siente usted verguenza?. The Republicans are still resisting at the Ebro pocket and are hoping to receive help from France.  We are sure they are going to get it.  Your future is dark, my General.
zh: 你难道不觉得羞耻吗？共和派仍在埃布罗河袋形阵地抵抗，并指望得到法国的援助。我们确信他们会得到援助。你的前途黯淡，我的将军。

en: Mis felicitaciones General.  The best troops of the Red army have been destroyed at Ebro.  We do not expect any further offensive operations from the Reds and we can soon begin to think of a victorious end to this war.
zh: 向您祝贺，将军。红军最精锐的部队已在埃布罗河被消灭。我们预计赤色分子不会再有进一步的进攻行动，我们很快就可以开始考虑如何胜利结束这场战争了。
