en: S.E. el Generalisimo wants to thank you for your quick and decisive defeat of the Republican resistance at Catalonia.  You have been awarded the army's highest decoration.
zh: 大元帅阁下谨此感谢你迅速而果断地粉碎了共和派在加泰罗尼亚的抵抗。你已被授予陆军的最高勋章。

en: Some members of the government expect to end the war in the next month and maybe we will have a new Crusade in the future.
zh: 政府中一些成员预计下个月就能结束战争，也许将来我们还会有一场新的十字军远征。
命令发自：布尔戈斯，1938年12月

en: Sientese por favor, y atienda mis ordenes.  As you may know General the war is about to end.  We need  to inflict one more blow to the badly wounded enemy forces the so-called ''People's Army''.  The very best of the remaining enemy forces are located at Catalonia.   It is the last Republican stronghold in direct contact with a foreign border.  We know the French are debating on whether to intervene and send the Republicans some Soviet weapons that have been blocked at the French boarder.  This is unacceptable as it will allow them to prolong the war.  This would be disastrous for the National cause if a new World War finally exploded.
zh: 请坐，听取我的命令。将军，你大概知道，战争即将结束。我们需要再给重伤的敌军——所谓的“人民军”——一次打击。敌军残存部队中最精锐的部分位于加泰罗尼亚。那是共和派最后一个与外国边境直接接壤的据点。我们知道法国人正在辩论是否干预，把被阻在法国边境的苏联武器送给共和派。这是不可接受的，因为那会让他们把战争拖长。如果新的世界大战最终爆发，这对民族事业将是灾难性的。

en: The main objective is to take Barcelona.  It is the last important Republican city as their government is located there.  By taking Barcelona we may be able to put an end to this bloody war.  The Republicans are trying to build fortified lines in Catalonia so we are going to need to use the German tactics of troop concentration, close air and artillery support to quickly overwhelm them.
zh: 主要目标是夺取巴塞罗那。那是共和派最后一座重要城市，因为他们的政府就设在那里。夺取巴塞罗那，我们或许就能结束这场血腥的战争。共和派正试图在加泰罗尼亚修筑筑垒防线，因此我们需要运用德军的战术——集中兵力、近距空中和炮兵支援——迅速压垮他们。

en: The French are resupplying the Republicans with weapons and ammunition. Thanks to your delay in taking Barcelona, the war will be prolonged.  The Republicans will now resist at the Franco-Spanish border and who knows if Paris will finally launch their army to support the government of Madrid.
zh: 法国人正在向共和派补给武器和弹药。由于你迟迟未能夺取巴塞罗那，战争将被延长。共和派现在将在法西边境抵抗，谁知道巴黎最终会不会出动他们的军队来支持马德里政府。

en: The French are resupplying the Republicans with weapons and ammunition. Thanks to your delay in taking Barcelona, the war will be prolonged.  The Republicans will now resist at the Franco-Spanish border and who knows if Paris will finally launch their army to support the government of Madrid.
zh: 法国人正在向共和派补给武器和弹药。由于你迟迟未能夺取巴塞罗那，战争将被延长。共和派现在将在法西边境抵抗，谁知道巴黎最终会不会出动他们的军队来支持马德里政府。

en: S.E. el Generalisimo wants to thank you for your quick and decisive defeat of the Republican resistance at Catalonia.  You have been awarded the army's highest decoration.
zh: 大元帅阁下谨此感谢你迅速而果断地粉碎了共和派在加泰罗尼亚的抵抗。你已被授予陆军的最高勋章。

en: Some members of the government expect to end the war in the next month and maybe we will have a new Crusade in the future.
zh: 政府中一些成员预计下个月就能结束战争，也许将来我们还会有一场新的十字军远征。

en: Ah, Good day, Herr General!  Please sit down  and allow me to explain the present situation.  The Spanish Nationalists have requested the help of Germany to wrest control of Spain from their enemies. In leading this expedition, you will have the opportunity to sharpen your skills in the art of war. You will test the General Staff's new ideas regarding tank use, concentration of force, and combined arms operations.  Your expertise can then be put to work towards the real objective:  the return of Germany to its proper place,  the leader of Europe.
zh: 啊，你好，将军阁下！请坐，容我说明当前局势。西班牙国民军已请求德国出手，帮助他们从敌人手中夺回西班牙的控制权。率领这支远征军，你将有机会磨炼自己的战争技艺。你将检验总参谋部关于坦克运用、集中兵力和合成兵种作战的新构想。此后，你的专长便可投入到真正的目标上：让德国恢复其应有的地位，成为欧洲的领袖。

en: Well, following your success at Sedan, your brave men must now capture the port of Dunkirk on the Channel.  Allied forces in Belgium will be trapped if we can secure this harbor.  With the British Army as prisoners, we can dictate peace on our terms.  Of course, the English are aware of this possibility and will fight  furiously to protect their lines of retreat.  Good luck to you.
zh: 好，继色当的胜利之后，你的勇士们现在必须夺取英吉利海峡上的敦刻尔克港。如果我们能拿下这个港口，在比利时的盟军部队就将陷入包围。把英国军队变成俘虏，我们就能按我们的条件决定和平。当然，英国人明白这种可能，他们会拼死保卫自己的撤退路线。祝你好运。

en: The General Staff has decided that you should lead the attack against the British in North Africa.  Their will to fight has by no means been broken.  If we can push the English out of North Africa, we will gain access to the Suez Canal and the oil-rich Middle East.
zh: 总参谋部已决定由你领导对北非英军的进攻。他们的战斗意志丝毫没有瓦解。如果我们能把英国人赶出北非，就能打开通往苏伊士运河和石油资源丰富的中东的道路。

en: Herr General, you must quickly crush the defenses of Tobruk and finish what you have so successfully begun.  If Tobruk falls into our hands, the British will never recover.  Now is our chance to drive them into the sea.
zh: 将军阁下，你必须迅速粉碎托布鲁克的防御，把你如此成功地开始的事业进行到底。如果托布鲁克落入我们手中，英国人将永远无法恢复。现在正是我们把他们赶下海的机会。

en: Herr General, as you know, Germany has declared war on the Soviet Union.  You have been chosen to play a key role in our drive into southern Russia. You will assist our Romanian Allies in their attempt to reclaim their lost province of Moldavia. The key city in this province is Kishinev, and it is also your primary objective.  Not only is this assignment strategically important, it is politically critical.  The world is watching, Herr General, do not disappoint.
zh: 将军阁下，如你所知，德国已对苏联宣战。你被选中在我们向俄国南部的进军中发挥关键作用。你将协助我们的罗马尼亚盟友，设法收复他们失去的摩尔达维亚省。这个省的关键城市是基什尼奥夫，它也是你的首要目标。这项任务不仅在战略上重要，在政治上同样至关重要。全世界都在注视，将军阁下，不要让我们失望。

en: Herr General, you must break through and encircle the enemy along the Polish frontier, exploiting their lack of mobility.  We will send pre-emptive strikes to destroy the Polish air force, therefore no aircraft will impede your advance.  Speed is essential; a successful advance here will allow us to threaten Warsaw from the north and east simultaneously.  In addition, we can welcome our Soviet friends to the key city of Brest-Litovsk on the new German-Soviet border.  The General Staff will not be pleased if it is the Soviets who welcome us instead.
zh: 将军阁下，您必须沿波兰边境实施突破并包围敌军，充分利用其机动性不足的弱点。我们将发动先发制人的打击摧毁波兰空军，因此不会有敌机阻碍您的推进。速度至关重要；此处的成功推进将使我们得以从北面和东面同时威胁华沙。此外，我们还能够在德苏新边界上的重镇布列斯特-立托夫斯克迎接我们的苏联友军。倘若反过来是苏联人迎接我们，总参谋部绝不会高兴。

en: Herr General,  it is your privilege to lead our attack here, south of Novgorod, in the Russian heartland.  A successful offensive here will sever communications between Moscow and Leningrad and trap several Soviet armies. It is, of course, imperative to take your objectives quickly.  Our thoughts are with you.
zh: 将军阁下，能在俄国腹地的诺夫哥罗德以南率领此次进攻，是您的殊荣。此处攻势若成，将切断莫斯科与列宁格勒之间的交通，并围困数个苏军集团军。当然，迅速夺取目标势在必行。我们挂念着您。

en: Herr General, our drive on Moscow has been quite successful, but enemy resistance continues to stiffen.  You must break through along the Volokolamsk Highway.   There is no doubt; the enemy will commit his toughest units to defend the capital, but we will persevere.
zh: 将军阁下，我们对莫斯科的推进相当顺利，但敌军抵抗日益顽强。您必须沿沃洛科拉姆斯克公路实施突破。毫无疑问，敌人必将投入其最精锐的部队保卫首都，但我们定能坚持到底。

en: Well,  Herr General, a bold stroke from the city of Klin to Fedoroloka will close the ring on Moscow. If we can drive through to this point, the enemy capital will surely be ours.  Good luck!
zh: 将军阁下，由克林向费多罗夫卡发起一次大胆突击，即可合拢对莫斯科的包围。若能推进至此，敌国首都必归我有。祝您好运！

en: The Soviet Union has invaded Finland, Herr General, and our Finnish friends have trapped a Soviet division in the town of Suomussalmi. Unfortunately, an even greater Soviet relief force is moving to aid their comrades, and the Finns are outnumbered. It is your task to destroy the isolated enemy and prevent the relief force from reaching him. Of course, due to our non-aggression pact with the Soviet Union, you and your troops will be considered volunteers.  If you are defeated, the General Staff will deny any knowledge of your participation, and you may expect the worst if captured.
zh: 苏联已入侵芬兰，将军阁下，我们的芬兰友军已将一支苏军师围困在苏奥穆萨尔米镇。不幸的是，一支规模更大的苏军救援部队正前去接应他们的同志，而芬兰人兵力处于劣势。您的任务是歼灭这支被孤立的敌军，并阻止救援部队与之会合。当然，鉴于我们与苏联签有互不侵犯条约，您和您的部队将被视为志愿者。倘若您战败，总参谋部将否认知悉您的参与，而您一旦被俘，就别指望有什么好下场。

en: Herr General, as you know the Allies landed in Northwest Afrika in November and have been been driving east ever since.  It is imperative not only that their drive be stopped, but that they be thrown out of Tunesia!  We thought to assign this task to Feldmarschall Rommel, but Feldmarschalls Kesselring and Manstein have argued that he is needed to continue the drive on the Suez Kanel.  We have therefore given you this critical assigment.  Herr General, do not disappoint.
zh: 将军阁下，如您所知，盟军已于11月在西北非登陆，此后一路向东推进。不仅必须阻止他们的推进，还必须把他们逐出突尼斯！我们本想把这项任务交给隆美尔元帅，但凯塞林元帅和曼施坦因元帅认为他需要继续向苏伊士运河推进。因此我们把这项关键任务交给了您。将军阁下，请勿让我们失望。

en: Herr Feldmarschall, due to your unprecedented advance, we will soon see the triumphant finish of our English campaign.  Feldmarschall von Manstein's Army Group North is within 100 kilometers of Glasgow, and .....  excuse me, Herr Feldmarschall .....
zh: 元帅阁下，由于您前所未有的推进，我们即将迎来英格兰战役的胜利终局。曼施坦因元帅的北方集团军群距格拉斯哥已不足100公里，而且……请原谅，元帅阁下……

en: Herr Feldmarschall, I have just received information of the most critical importance.  Intelligence reports indicate that the Americans are building a weapon of terrifying explosive power, which  will be finished by August 1!  It is imperative that we act decisively and conquer England before this weapon is ready.  With England in our hands we can negotiate a reasonable peace with the Americans.
zh: 元帅阁下，我刚刚收到一份极其重要的情报。情报显示，美国人正在制造一种具有可怕爆炸威力的武器，它将在8月1日前完成！我们必须果断行动，在这一武器准备就绪之前征服英格兰。只要英格兰落入我们手中，我们就能与美国人体面地议和。

en: The Allies have been thrown out of Tunesia and are reeling in disarray from the bold strokes you and your brave men have delivered.  Now you must continue this drive and force them to evacuate their bases in Morocco, thus removing this threat to Feldmarschall Rommel's campaign to capture Egypt and the Suez Kanal.
zh: 盟军已被逐出突尼斯，并在您和您勇敢部下的大胆打击下仓皇溃退。现在您必须继续推进，迫使他们撤出摩洛哥的基地，从而消除对隆美尔元帅夺取埃及和苏伊士运河作战的这一威胁。

en: The Allies have been thrown off the continent. Bravo!  But while you were driving the Allies into the sea the Bolsheviks treacherously broke our peace treaty and invaded our allied territories in Eastern Europe.  With the bulk of our forces involved on the Western Front and in Afrika they have been able to pollute the sacred soil of the Fatherland and penetrate almost to Berlin!  You MUST stop them.
zh: 盟军已被赶出欧洲大陆。太好了！但就在您把盟军赶下海的时候，布尔什维克背信弃义地撕毁和约，入侵了我们在东欧的盟国领土。由于我军主力深陷西线和非洲，他们得以践踏祖国神圣的土地，几乎突入柏林！您必须阻止他们。

en: Ah, Herr General.  Excuse me, Herr Feldmarschall.  A bold stroke to invade England is necessary.  We must force the Allies to the bargaining table so we may have the peace needed to develop the Fatherland to its full glory.  You have been given command of one section of the invasion.
zh: 啊，将军阁下。失敬，是元帅阁下。对英格兰发动一次大胆入侵势在必行。我们必须迫使盟军回到谈判桌前，以便获得让祖国充分发展其全部荣光所需的和平。您已被授予此次入侵一个方向上的指挥权。

en: Well, our forces have stormed ashore on England's beaches only to meet ferocious resistance.  Our drive to capture London has been stalled.  Now, your services are needed to capture Windsor, a vital communications center.  With this rail junction in our hands, London will be cut off from their industrial centers and be forced to surrender.  Good luck, Herr Feldmarschall.
zh: 我们的部队已冲上英格兰海滩，却遭遇了凶猛抵抗。我们夺取伦敦的推进已经停滞。现在需要您出力夺取温莎——一处至关重要的通信中心。只要这个铁路枢纽落入我们手中，伦敦就将与其工业中心被切断联系，被迫投降。祝您好运，元帅阁下。

en: Herr General.  Our goal is to seize Stalingrad as a base which will allow us to turn either north towards Moscow or south towards the Caucasian oil fields.  You have been chosen to lead our initial drive towards Stalingrad.
zh: 将军阁下。我们的目标是夺取斯大林格勒作为基地，以便此后或北上莫斯科，或南下高加索油田。您被选中率领我们向斯大林格勒发起的最初攻势。

en: Herr General.  Now that Leningrad has fallen it only remains to capture Moscow and force the Bolsheviks to make peace on our terms.  You have been chosen to lead this critical attack.
zh: 将军阁下。既然列宁格勒已经陷落，剩下的只是攻取莫斯科，迫使布尔什维克按我们的条件媾和。您被选中率领这次关键进攻。

en: Herr Feldmarshall, I am at a loss for words.  Your failure is...  incomprehensible. This debacle will be remembered as one of the worst military disasters of our nation.  It is better for you that you will never return to the fatherland.  Much better.
zh: 元帅阁下，我已无言以对。您的失败……令人无法理解。这场溃败将被记为我国最惨重的军事灾难之一。对您来说，最好永远不要回到祖国。最好如此。

en: General, welcome to the East. Let me brief you. The government in Berlin has finally decided that it is time to destroy our sworn enemies - the Bolsheviks. Your attack here at Brest-Litowsk will be the opening hour of Operation Barbarossa. Along a front line 3000km long, guns will open fire. The enemy should be completely surprised and you'll be able to cross the Bug river with almost no resistance. Good luck all the same!
zh: 将军，欢迎来到东方。我来为您做简报。柏林政府终于决定，是时候消灭我们誓不两立的敌人——布尔什维克了。您在此地对布列斯特-立托夫斯克的进攻，将是巴巴罗萨行动的开场时刻。在长达3000公里的战线上，火炮将同时开火。敌人应当会完全措手不及，您将几乎不会遇到抵抗就能渡过布格河。还是祝您好运！

en: Well done General! You captured your objectives quickly. Our advance into southern Russia and the Ukraine is going as planned. We can now help our Romanian allies deal with the Soviet occupation force in Moldavia.  The General staff has decided that you will lead the drive to capture Kishinev.
zh: 干得好，将军！您迅速夺取了目标。我们向南俄和乌克兰的推进正按计划进行。现在我们能够帮助罗马尼亚盟友对付苏联在摩尔达维亚的占领军了。总参谋部已决定由您率部夺取基什尼奥夫。

en: Herr General, though able to achieve some success, you did not show the initiative demanded of German field commanders.  You were expected to do more than merely follow orders. The Bolsheviks still defy us and we need to regroup our forces.
zh: 将军阁下，您虽然取得了一些战果，却没有展现出德国野战指挥官应有的主动精神。人们对您的期望不止是循规蹈矩地执行命令。布尔什维克仍在顽抗，我们需要重新集结部队。

en: Herr General, thanks to your efforts we've achieved a vital breakthrough and it is my pleasure to inform you that your request for leave has been granted. Enjoy your leave!
zh: 将军阁下，多亏您的努力，我们实现了至关重要的突破，我很荣幸地通知您，您的休假申请已获批准。祝您休假愉快！

en: Ah, Herr General, I hope you have enjoyed your leave.  As you know, British and Commonwealth  troops have occupied the historic pass at Thermopylae.  You must secure this pass and prevent the escape of the enemy.  The terrain is rugged and difficult for maneuver.   You must act decisively. These troops were bypassed in our initial Grecian campaign, but now is the time to eliminate this threat to our control of the area.
zh: 啊，将军阁下，希望您休假愉快。如您所知，英国和英联邦军队已占领了温泉关这一历史名隘。您必须夺取该隘口，阻止敌人逃脱。当地地形崎岖，难以机动。您必须果断行动。这些部队在我军最初的希腊战役中被绕过了，现在是消除他们对本地区控制权威胁的时候了。

en: The English have surrendered, and Greek resistance has collapsed.  This was primarily due to the brilliant tactics of General Cundarian.  Your performance was mediocre, far below your past record. You will be given another chance.  After some rest and recuperation you and your men will be returned to the Russian front to play a key role in our 1942 spring campaign.
zh: 英国人已经投降，希腊抵抗也已崩溃。这主要归功于昆达里安将军的卓越战术。您的表现平平，远低于您以往的水准。我们会再给您一次机会。经过一段休整之后，您和您的部下将被调回俄国前线，在我们1942年春季攻势中扮演关键角色。

en: The English have surrendered, and Greek resistance has collapsed.  Your performance has been excellent, and we will continue to rely on your expertise.  Well done!  After some well-earned rest and recuperation you and your men will be returned to the Russian front to play a key role in our 1942 spring campaign.
zh: 英国人已经投降，希腊抵抗也已崩溃。您的表现极为出色，我们将继续倚重您的专长。干得好！经过一段应得的休整之后，您和您的部下将被调回俄国前线，在我们1942年春季攻势中扮演关键角色。

en: We cannot leave Sevastopol on our flank while we advance on Stalingrad and the Caucaus, therefore it must be taken. Sevastopol is the most heavily fortified area in the world, stronger than the Maginot line or even Gibraltar!  This will not be an easy task, Herr General, but the General Staff has confidence in your leadership and resourcefulness.
zh: 在我们向斯大林格勒和高加索推进时，不能把塞瓦斯托波尔留在我们的侧翼，因此必须拿下它。塞瓦斯托波尔是世界上防御最坚固的地区，比马其诺防线甚至直布罗陀还要坚固！将军阁下，这不会是轻松的任务，但总参谋部对您的领导力和足智多谋充满信心。

en: Credits: This is an original scenario made by Dennis Felling for his 22 Infanterie Division campaign - Sevastopol 2, adapted for this Blitz by myself.
zh: 致谢：本场景由 Dennis Felling 为其第22步兵师战役——塞瓦斯托波尔2——原创制作，由本人改编用于本次闪电战。

en: Excellent work, Herr General.  With Sevastopol in our hands our advances on Stalingrad and the Caucaus can proceed.  Your success here has led the General Staff to give you the critical assignment of taking Stalingrad, while Feldmarschall Manstein will conquer the Caucaus.
zh: 干得漂亮，将军阁下。塞瓦斯托波尔已在我们手中，我们向斯大林格勒和高加索的推进可以继续了。您在此处的成功使总参谋部决定，把夺取斯大林格勒这一关键任务交给您，而曼施坦因元帅将征服高加索。

en: Now that Sevastopol has fallen our next objective is Stalingrad.  This is an important road and railroad nexus.  Also capture of a city named after the Bolshevik dictator will hurt their morale.  This is a critical assignment, Herr General, you must take Stalingrad quickly.
zh: 既然塞瓦斯托波尔已经陷落，我们的下一个目标就是斯大林格勒。这是一处重要的公路与铁路枢纽。此外，夺取这座以布尔什维克独裁者命名的城市，将打击他们的士气。将军阁下，这是一项关键任务，您必须迅速拿下斯大林格勒。

en: Good work, Herr General.  With Stalingrad in our hands we can now choose our next move.  Intelligence indicates that the Western Allies are planning a landing in Northwest Afrika.  The General Staff has decided to send significant reinforcements to the Afrika Corps, so you and your men are to transfer to Afrika after a thorough rest and refitting.  Meanwhile Feldmarschall von Paulus's Sixth Army will take your place in Stalingrad.
zh: 干得好，将军阁下。斯大林格勒已在我们手中，现在我们能选择下一步行动了。情报显示，西方盟军正计划在西北非登陆。总参谋部已决定向非洲军派出大量增援，因此您和您的部下将在充分休整和补充装备后调往非洲。与此同时，冯·保卢斯元帅的第6集团军将接替您在斯大林格勒的防务。

en: Very well done, Herr General.  The Allied drive into Tunesia has been stopped.  Your counterattack has thrown them out of Tunesia and sent them reeling in disarray.  This gives us the opportunity to drive the Allies completely out of Northwest Afrika.  Because of your excellent record the General Staff has decided that this critical assigment is yours!
zh: 干得十分出色，将军阁下。盟军向突尼斯的推进已被阻止。您的反击把他们逐出突尼斯，使其仓皇溃退。这给了我们把盟军彻底赶出西北非的机会。鉴于您的优异战绩，总参谋部决定把这项关键任务交给您！

en: Now that we have stopped the Allied assault on Tunis, it's time for us to move westwards. Our next objective is El Alamein - the gateway to  Egypt. The British are present in great strength, but your past performance indicates that you should be able to overcome them.  Again, you must achieve your objectives quickly so we that may maintain our pressure on the British.  You are Feldmarschall Rommel's lead commander in this attack!
zh: 既然我们已经阻止了盟军对突尼斯的进攻，现在该向西行动了。我们的下一个目标是阿拉曼——通往埃及的门户。英军兵力雄厚，但您以往的表现表明您应当能够战胜他们。同样，您必须迅速达成目标，以便我们保持对英军的压力。您是隆美尔元帅此次进攻的先锋指挥官！

en: A barely acceptable performance, Herr General.  Only the brilliant maneuvers of Fieldmarschall Rommel saved the situation.  He will now continue with the conquest of Egypt and the Suez Kanal. You and your men are to be transferred back to the Russian front, where things have not gone well. Fieldmarschall Paulus has been unable to break out of Stalingrad.  Worse, intelligence indicates that the Bolsheviks are planning a great offensive in the Kursk region.  The General Staff hopes that your failure at El Alamein was but a temporary departure from your previous excellent conduct and thus is giving you one more chance to prove yourself.
zh: 勉强可以接受的表现，将军阁下。全靠隆美尔元帅的卓越机动才挽回了局势。他将继续征服埃及和苏伊士运河。您和您的部下将被调回俄国前线，那里的情况不太顺利。保卢斯元帅未能从斯大林格勒突围。更糟的是，情报显示布尔什维克正计划在库尔斯克地区发动一场大规模攻势。总参谋部希望您在阿拉曼的失利只是暂时偏离了您以往出色的表现，因此再给您一次证明自己的机会。

en: Our objective is Alexandria, the great port of Egypt.  With Alexandria in our possession supply will cease to be a problem.  The British are present in great strength and strongly entrenched, but your past performance indicates that you should be able to overcome them.  They will be supported by the remnants of the British armor, and resupplied British aviation.  The Russians have begun a major offensive in the Kursk region so you must achieve your objectives quickly.
zh: 我们的目标是亚历山大——埃及的大港。亚历山大一旦落入我们手中，补给将不再是问题。英军兵力雄厚且工事坚固，但您以往的表现表明您应当能够战胜他们。他们将得到英军残余装甲部队的支援，并得到重建补充的英国航空兵的补给。俄军已在库尔斯克地区发起大规模攻势，因此您必须迅速达成目标。

en: Excellent performance, Herr General.  The conquest of Cairo and the Suez Kanal should now be easy, especially for Feldmarschall Rommel.  Since the Bolsheviks have begun a great offensive in the Kursk region, while Feldmarschall Paulus is still unable to break out of Stalingrad, the General Staff has decided that you and your men are to be transferred back to the Russian front where you have performed so well in the past.
zh: 出色的表现，将军阁下。现在征服开罗和苏伊士运河应当轻而易举，尤其是对隆美尔元帅而言。由于布尔什维克已在库尔斯克地区发起大规模攻势，而保卢斯元帅仍未能从斯大林格勒突围，总参谋部已决定将您和您的部下调回俄国前线——您过去在那里表现出色。

en: Excellent performance, Herr General.  Leningrad is ours!  Now we must strike quickly towards Moscow while we have the initiative over the Bolsheviks.
zh: 出色的表现，将军阁下。列宁格勒属于我们了！现在我们必须趁掌握对布尔什维克的先手之机，迅速向莫斯科发起进攻。

en: Herr General.  Your brilliant leadership has brought us once again to Moscow.  This time we must capture the enemy capital and principal city and force the Bolsheviks to make peace on our terms.  The General Staff has given you this critical task, do not fail!
zh: 将军阁下。您卓越的指挥再次把我们带到了莫斯科城下。这一次我们必须夺取敌国首都和首要城市，迫使布尔什维克按我们的条件媾和。总参谋部把这一关键任务交给了您，切勿失败！

en: Herr General.  Your capture of Moscow once again showed your mastery of tactics.  The Bolsheviks still refuse to surrender but have offered us an armistice.  Our intelligence indicates that the Allies are planning an invasion of Europe early this summer.  Therefore the High Command signed the armistice with the Bolsheviks so we can prepare for the pending invasion.  You are to be transferred to the Western Front, where you will help defend Fortress Europe against an Allied invasion.
zh: 将军阁下。您攻占莫斯科再次展现了您的战术造诣。布尔什维克仍拒绝投降，但已向我们提出停战。我们的情报显示，盟军正计划在今年初夏入侵欧洲。因此最高统帅部与布尔什维克签署了停战协定，以便为即将到来的入侵做准备。您将被调往西线，协助保卫欧洲堡垒，抵御盟军入侵。

en: Herr General, as you know, the Allies are pushing inland from St. Lo in an attempt to break out from their beachhead in Normandy.  Your assignment is to stop this assault, then counterattack and force them back on Cherbourgh.  Success here is critical, as an Allied breakout could threaten the Reich!
zh: 将军阁下，如您所知，盟军正从圣洛向内陆推进，试图从他们在诺曼底的登陆场突围。您的任务是阻止这次进攻，然后实施反击，把他们压回瑟堡。此处的成功至关重要，因为盟军一旦突围，就可能威胁到帝国！

en: Herr General, this victory is worthy of great praise. The Allies's attempted breakout has been stopped and now the only part of France they still hold is the area north of Avranches.  We must now take Avranches and expel the Allies from Europe!
zh: 将军阁下，这场胜利值得高度赞扬。盟军试图突围的行动已被阻止，如今他们在法国仅剩的占领区就是阿夫朗什以北地区。现在我们必须夺取阿夫朗什，把盟军赶出欧洲！

en: Herr General, the enemy is making a final attempt to break out of the encirclement in Normandy around the key city of Avranches. Your orders are to move swiftly and prevent this outbreak and force the Allies out of Europe. With Fortress Europe secure, and the Luftwaffe's success in dealing with Allied bombing raids, we will be able to build up our forces to invade England next year.
zh: 将军阁下，敌人正做最后努力，试图从诺曼底包围圈中、围绕重镇阿夫朗什突围。您的命令是迅速行动，阻止这次突围，并把盟军赶出欧洲。欧洲堡垒一旦稳固，加上德国空军在应对盟军轰炸行动中取得的成功，我们就能积蓄力量，于明年入侵英格兰。

en: Brilliant work. You have fulfilled the General Staff's hopes!  Your drive to Avranches has forced the last of the American and British forces from Europe.  Now we can concentrate on building up our forces to invade England next year.  You and your men will rest and refit for a key role in our invasion.  I am happy to inform you that you are promoted to Feldmarschall!
zh: 漂亮的工作。您实现了总参谋部的期望！您向阿夫朗什的推进迫使最后的美军和英军部队撤离欧洲。现在我们可以集中力量积蓄部队，准备明年入侵英格兰。您和您的部下将休整并补充装备，在我们的入侵行动中承担关键角色。我很高兴地通知您，您已被晋升为元帅！

en: Ah, Herr General.  Excuse me, Herr Feldmarschall.  A bold stroke to invade England is necessary.  We must force the Allies to the bargaining table so that we may have the peace needed to develop the Fatherland to its full glory.  You have been given command of the initial phase of the invasion.
zh: 啊，将军阁下。失敬，是元帅阁下。对英格兰发动一次大胆入侵势在必行。我们必须迫使盟军回到谈判桌前，以便获得让祖国充分发展其全部荣光所需的和平。您已被授予此次入侵第一阶段行动的指挥权。

en: Superb performance, Herr Feldmarschall! Our troops are safely ashore in England.  You have helped accomplish what Napoleon could not - the invasion of England!
zh: 卓越的表现，元帅阁下！我军已安全登陆英格兰。您帮助完成了拿破仑未能做到的事——入侵英格兰！

en: Herr Feldmarschall.  We have obtained an armistice with England and the United States.  Bravo!  But while we were conquering England the Bolsheviks treacherously broke our armistice with them and invaded our allied territories in Eastern Europe.  With the bulk of our forces in England and Afrika the situation is critical. Your forces are the only units standing between them and Berlin. You MUST stop them.
zh: 元帅阁下。我们已与英国和美国达成停战。太好了！但就在我们征服英格兰之际，布尔什维克背信弃义地撕毁与我们之间的停战协定，入侵了我们在东欧的盟国领土。由于我军主力都在英格兰和非洲，形势十分危急。您的部队是挡在他们与柏林之间的唯一力量。您必须阻止他们。

en: Herr Feldmarschall, thank God you are here.  Our situation is critical. Buda-Pest is besieged by the Bolsheviks. Your troops must force their way into the city. It is doubtful that our Hungarian allies will continue to fight if Buda-Pest falls. If you can drive the Reds into the Danube, we may stop the Russian Bear from consuming us.
zh: 元帅阁下，谢天谢地您来了。我们的形势十分危急。布达佩斯已被布尔什维克围困。您的部队必须强行突入城中。布达佩斯一旦陷落，我们的匈牙利盟友是否还会继续作战就很难说了。如果您能把红军赶进多瑙河，我们或许能阻止俄国熊吞掉我们。

en: The Russians are dazed and reeling from the blows you and your brave men have delivered! Not only did you succeed in relieving Buda-Pest, you drove the Reds back across the Danube. The General Staff is amazed at your performance, Herr Feldmarschall.  Now we must continue to pursue the Bolsheviks.  This time we will not settle for an armistice.
zh: 俄军被您和您勇敢部下的打击弄得晕头转向、溃不成军！您不仅成功为布达佩斯解围，还把红军赶回了多瑙河对岸。总参谋部对您的表现惊叹不已，元帅阁下。现在我们必须继续追击布尔什维克。这一次我们不会满足于停战了。

en: Herr Feldmarschall, the Bosheviks are retreating everywhere! Feldmarschall Guderian has retaken the Baku oil fields, while Feldmarschall Manstein has surrounded Moscow.  As part of our campaign to keep the Bolsheviks on the run, you are to cross the Don river.
zh: 元帅阁下，布尔什维克正在全线退却！古德里安元帅已夺回巴库油田，曼施坦因元帅则包围了莫斯科。作为我们让布尔什维克持续溃逃的作战的一部分，您要渡过顿河。

en: Very well done, Herr Feldmarschall!  The Bolsheviks are dazed and reeling from the blows you and your brave men have delivered.  You must continue to pursue them.
zh: 干得十分出色，元帅阁下！布尔什维克被您和您勇敢部下的打击弄得晕头转向、溃不成军。您必须继续追击他们。

en: Herr General, as you know the Allies landed in Northwest Afrika in November and have been been driving east ever since.  It is imperative not only that their drive be stopped, but that they be thrown out of Tunisia!  We thought to assign this task to Feldmarschall Rommel, but Feldmarschalls Kesselring and Manstein have argued that he is needed to continue the drive on the Suez Kanel.  We have therefore given you this critical assigment.  Herr General, do not disappoint.
zh: 将军阁下，如您所知，盟军已于11月在西北非登陆，此后一路向东推进。不仅必须阻止他们的推进，还必须把他们逐出突尼斯！我们本想把这项任务交给隆美尔元帅，但凯塞林元帅和曼施坦因元帅认为他需要继续向苏伊士运河推进。因此我们把这项关键任务交给了您。将军阁下，请勿让我们失望。

en: Please note that hex 20,37 does not have to be held in order to win the scenario
zh: 请注意，无需守住20,37格即可赢得本场景

en: Our intelligence reports that the Bolshevik leader Stalin has fled Moscow and is reportedly barricaded in the city of Kazan.  Most of the remaining high-grade Bolshevik troops are also in the Kazan region.  Meanwhile Bolshevik troops elsewhere are beginning to surrender.  Herr Feldmarschall, a quick victory here, especially if you capture Stalin, should lead to the Bolshevik's surrender and end this war!
zh: 我们的情报显示，布尔什维克领袖斯大林已逃离莫斯科，据报正困守喀山城。布尔什维克剩余的大部分精锐部队也都在喀山地区。与此同时，其他地方的布尔什维克部队开始投降。元帅阁下，此处的一场速胜——尤其是如果您能俘获斯大林——应当会促成布尔什维克投降，结束这场战争！

en: A glorious victory, Herr Feldmarschall!  The Bolsheviks have surrendered unconditionally!  We will require the independence of Bylorussia and the Ukraine under German protection, which will stabilize our Eastern borders.  We are about to sign a peace treaty with the English and Americans which will involve our withdrawal from England and France (we keep Alsace-Lorraine).  Now we will have the peace necessary to develop the Fatherland to its full potential.
zh: 光荣的胜利，元帅阁下！布尔什维克已无条件投降！我们将要求白俄罗斯和乌克兰在德国保护下独立，这将稳定我们的东部边界。我们即将与英国人和美国人签署和约，内容包括我们从英格兰和法国撤军（我们保留阿尔萨斯-洛林）。现在我们将获得必要的和平，来充分开发祖国的全部潜力。

en: You are to return home to a grateful nation!
zh: 您将回到家园，受到感恩的国民迎接！

en: Herr General, as you know the Kursk Salient poses a serious threat to us. The enemy is counterattacking and our only hope to seal the break in the lines is your Kampfgruppe. You must stop the Soviet counterattack immediately. Good Luck.
zh: 将军阁下，如您所知，库尔斯克突出部对我们构成严重威胁。敌人正在反攻，我们堵住战线缺口的唯一希望就是您的战斗群。您必须立即阻止苏军反攻。祝好运。

en: You have dealt the Red Army a severe blow. With our line shortened, we will be able to transfer some troops to Feldmarschall von Paulus at Stalingrad. Good work, Herr General.  Meanwhile the Finns are opening a drive to recover the land they lost to the Bolsheviks in 1940.  Remembering your help in 1939 the Finns have specifically asked for you to lead their drive.  The General Staff has agreed to their request, so you and your men are to transfer North after a short period for rest and refitting.
zh: 您给了红军沉重一击。随着我们的战线缩短，我们将能把部分部队转交给斯大林格勒的冯·保卢斯元帅。干得好，将军阁下。与此同时，芬兰人正发起攻势，要夺回他们1940年失去给布尔什维克的土地。鉴于您1939年的援助，芬兰人特意请求由您来指挥他们的攻势。总参谋部已同意他们的请求，因此您和您的部下将在短暂休整和补充装备后调往北方。
巴巴罗萨 (布列斯特-立托夫斯克)
库亚维地区亚历山德鲁夫
第聂伯罗彼得罗夫斯克
巴尔托洛梅奥·科莱奥尼号

en: Ah, Herr General, I hope you have enjoyed your leave.  As you know, the British fortress of Gibraltar is a serious threat to our operations in the Mediterranean region.  With the conquest of France, and your victory in Norway, now is the time to eliminate this threat to our control of the Mediterranean.  We have persuaded Spain to join us and our ally Italy in our attack on Gibraltar.
zh: 啊，将军阁下，希望您休假愉快。如您所知，英国人的直布罗陀要塞对我们在地中海地区的作战构成严重威胁。随着法国被征服，加上您在挪威的胜利，现在是消除这一对我们地中海控制权威胁的时候了。我们已说服西班牙加入我们和我们的盟友意大利，共同进攻直布罗陀。
拉利内亚德拉孔塞普西翁
乔瓦尼·德尔莱·班德·内雷号

en: Gibraltar is ours, thanks mainly to the skill of Feldmarschall Kesselring in breaking through the defenses on the Spanish side.  Of course, our ally Spain will be given nominal soverignty over Gibraltar, but it will serve us as our base.  Herr General, you did not handle this difficult assignment with the skill you have shown in previous battles.  However, you will be given another chance.  After some rest and recuperation you and your men will probably be called upon to play a role in our 1941 spring campaign.
zh: 直布罗陀属于我们了，这主要归功于凯塞林元帅突破西班牙一侧防御的技艺。当然，我们的盟友西班牙将被授予对直布罗陀的名义主权，但它将作为我们的基地供我们使用。将军阁下，您并未以在以往战役中展现的技艺来完成这项艰巨任务。不过，我们会再给您一次机会。经过一段休整之后，您和您的部下很可能会被召去在我们1941年春季攻势中发挥作用。

en: Herr General, I must congratulate you on this brilliant success. Gibraltar is ours.  Of course, our ally Spain will be given nominal soverignty over Gibraltar, but it will serve us as our base.  You handled this difficult assignment well.  After some well-earned rest and recuperation you and your men will undoubtedly be called upon to play a key role in our 1941 spring campaign.
zh: 将军阁下，我必须祝贺您取得这一辉煌成功。直布罗陀属于我们了。当然，我们的盟友西班牙将被授予对直布罗陀的名义主权，但它将作为我们的基地供我们使用。您出色地完成了这项艰巨任务。经过一段应得的休整之后，您和您的部下无疑将被召去在我们1941年春季攻势中发挥关键作用。
梅利尼察-波多尔斯卡亚
切尔尼亚霍夫斯克 (因斯特堡)
哈尔马什哈塔尔（308米）（丘陵）
泰特尼台地（268米）（崎岖地形）
包科尼圣基拉伊-切斯内克
舒里加兹达克林地（森林）
伊尔塔什弗尔德克（丘陵）
维斯普雷姆-尤塔什机场
切里林通往艾卡之路（森林）
泰泰尔哈洛姆（113米）（崎岖地形）
费尔绍梅尼奥迪林（森林）
奥尔绍梅尼奥迪林（森林）
圣彼得里葡萄山（崎岖地形）
托尔纳内梅迪（通往考波什堡之路）
埃马努埃莱·菲利贝托·阿奥斯塔公爵
安东尼奥托·乌索迪马雷
列宁格勒（彼得罗夫斯基岛）
列宁格勒（瓦西里耶夫岛）
列宁格勒（波罗的海车站）
列宁格勒（维捷布斯克车站）

en: Very well done!  You have exceeded the General Staff's hopes!  Your drive through the Herangsfjord has broken enemy resistance. And, because of your bold attack, the Norwegian government has sued for peace.  Congratulations!
zh: 干得漂亮！您超出了总参谋部的期望！您穿越海尔扬斯峡湾的推进已粉碎敌军抵抗。而且，由于您的果敢进攻，挪威政府已请求和平。祝贺您！
海尔扬斯峡湾防御阵地

en: To prevent a British naval blockade we will seize the Norwegian coast before the Allies can. The invasion of Denmark and Norway will consist of several task forces heading for specific ports. Your task force, Gruppe 1, will head for the northern Norwegian port of Narvik.
zh: 为阻止英国海军封锁，我们将在盟军之前夺取挪威海岸。对丹麦和挪威的入侵将由数支特遣舰队组成，分别驶向指定港口。您的特遣舰队——第1集群——将前往挪威北部的纳尔维克港。

en: The Norwegian Navy will not be much of a problem. However an British flotilla has been sighted and will likely engage your units, so speed is of highest importance.
zh: 挪威海军不会构成太大问题。不过已发现一支英国分舰队，很可能会与您的部队交战，因此速度至关重要。

en: Credits: This is an original scenario made by Dennis Felling for his Marinenkorps campaign - Narvik 1, adapted for this Blitz by myself.
zh: 致谢：本场景为丹尼斯·费林为其海军陆战队战役——纳尔维克1——原创，经本人改编用于本次闪电战。

en: Capture this hex for playing the Greater Europe campaign path!
zh: 夺取此格以游玩大欧洲战役路线！

en: Capture this hex for the classic Blitzkrieg! campaign path!
zh: 夺取此格以游玩经典闪电战战役路线！

en: You have chosen to play the Greater Europe campaign path!
zh: 您已选择游玩大欧洲战役路线！

en: General, you have been given the choice of command
zh: 将军，指挥权已交由您选择

en: You, the player, can determine which campaign you want to play by moving your unit either south to Gibraltar or southeast towards Tobruk. If you want to play the classical Blitzkrieg! scenario path you should choose Tobruk. If you want to play the campaign called Greater Europe (also originally by H. Craig Miller) you should capture Gibraltar.
zh: 您——玩家——可以通过将部队向南移动至直布罗陀或向东南移动至托布鲁克来决定游玩哪场战役。如果您想游玩经典的闪电战场景路线，应选择托布鲁克。如果您想游玩名为"大欧洲"的战役（同样原由 H. Craig Miller 设计），则应夺取直布罗陀。

en: PLEASE NOTE: Go directly to your choice, otherwise you will be sent back to this scenario!
zh: 请注意：请直接前往您的选择，否则您将被送回本场景！

en: Obviously you have problems choosing which way to go..
zh: 看来您在选择前进方向上遇到了困难……

en: You have chosen to play the traditional Blitzkrieg! campaign path!
zh: 您已选择游玩传统闪电战战役路线！

en: Herr General, your victory at Narvik allows us an opportunity to crush our old enemy, France.  Their army is said to be the world's finest.  We shall see!  Now, we believe the Allies plan to push into Belgium in response to our offensive.  Your task is to lead your forces through the Ardennes and emerge behind the enemy.  Our victory at Sedan in 1870 made Germany a Great Power.  Your victory at Sedan will return us to that status.
zh: 将军阁下，您在纳尔维克取得的胜利为我们创造了粉碎宿敌法国的机会。据说他们的陆军是世界上最优秀的。我们走着瞧！如今我们认为，盟军计划针对我们的攻势向比利时推进。您的任务是率领部队穿越阿登，出现在敌军背后。1870年我们在色当的胜利使德国成为列强。您在色当的胜利将让我们重返那一地位。
塞瓦斯托波尔海岸防御工事
塞瓦斯托波尔海岸防御工事
塞瓦斯托波尔防空部队
塞拉特角 : 崎岖地形
加尔梅拉赫湖 : 海洋
阿布鲁齐公爵路易吉·萨伏亚
巴尔托洛梅奥·科莱奥尼
科尔孙-舍甫琴科夫斯基

en: Wan Shan!  Did you see how the capitalists are escaping from us??   Pyongyang is again a communist stronghold, and we must continue to pursue and annihilate the UN forces.
zh: 万岁！你看到资本主义者是怎样从我们面前逃跑的吗？？平壤再次成为共产主义据点，我们必须继续追击并歼灭联合国军。

en: 25-11-1950 Chongchon River, near the Chinese border.
zh: 1950年11月25日 清川江，中国边境附近。

en: Nice to see you again commander. Your next mission is highly secret and will take you to the Sino-Korean border.  The dirty North American invaders and their South Korean allies have smashed the North Koreans.  Kim-Il-Sung was close to a total victory during the past summer, but he didn't protect his rearguard and as you know, the capitalist operation at Inch'on and Seoul has completely defeated the North Korean advance on Pusan.
zh: 很高兴再次见到你，指挥官。你的下一项任务高度机密，将把你带到中朝边境。肮脏的北美侵略者及其韩国盟友已击溃了朝鲜人。金日成在去年夏天曾接近全面胜利，但他没有保护好自己的后方，如你所知，资本主义者的仁川与汉城行动已彻底击溃了朝鲜人民军对釜山的进攻。

en: We can't allow this situation; the capitalist unification of Korea must not be completed.  A capitalist state in Korea would be like a gun aimed at the People's Republic of China, and we know that the puny North American general McArthur has maintained some conversations with Chaing-Kai-Shek about a possible continuation of the war against us.
zh: 我们不能容许这种局面；资本主义统一朝鲜绝不能完成。朝鲜若出现一个资本主义国家，就像一支枪对准中华人民共和国，而且我们知道，那个微不足道的北美将军麦克阿瑟已与蒋介石就继续对我们作战的可能性进行过一些会谈。

en: Build your army, and cross the Yalu River to help the North Koreans and strike the UN forces.  Liberate Pyongyang to allow further advances to the 38 parallel and beyond.  We will have help from the air from our recently created People's Liberation Army Air Force. Remember all the principles of the People's War doctrine on your way.
zh: 建立你的部队，跨过鸭绿江去援助朝鲜人，打击联合国军。解放平壤，以便进一步向三八线及其以南推进。我们将得到我们新近组建的中国人民解放军空军的空中支援。一路上牢记人民战争学说的全部原则。

en: I can't understand your failure commander.  It seems our estimation of your skills were wrong... the central ChCP commission has demoted you to a private for the remainder of the fighting.  This should erase any capitalist bad manners that you may have acquired.
zh: 我无法理解你的失败，指挥官。看来我们对你的能力评估错了...中共中央委员会已把你降为列兵，直到战斗结束。这应当能洗掉你可能沾染上的资本主义坏习气。

en: Wan Shan!  Did you see how the capitalists are escaping from us??   Pyongyang is again a communist stronghold, and we must continue to pursue and annihilate the UN forces.
zh: 万岁！你看到资本主义者是怎样从我们面前逃跑的吗？？平壤再次成为共产主义据点，我们必须继续追击并歼灭联合国军。

en: Wan Shan!  Did you see how the capitalists are escaping from us??   Pyongyang is again a communist stronghold, and we must continue to pursue and annihilate the UN forces.
zh: 万岁！你看到资本主义者是怎样从我们面前逃跑的吗？？平壤再次成为共产主义据点，我们必须继续追击并歼灭联合国军。

en: Congratulations, the way to the South is open.  The North Americans have received a stinging lesson on the power of the People's War.
zh: 祝贺你，南下的大门已经打开。北美人在人民战争的力量面前受到了惨痛的教训。

en: 27-11-1950 Chosin Reservoir, N of North Korea.
zh: 1950年11月27日 长津湖，朝鲜北部。

en: Your quick advance has created a salient in the enemy lines, like the one at the Chosin Reservoir.  This sector is protected by a North American division.  Your task is to make a surprise attack from two different directions and destroy the entire enemy division.  Be careful, our spies report that it's a crack division and they have air support from an improvised airstrip near the reservoir.  Air reinforcements are on the way.
zh: 你的快速推进在敌军战线上形成了一个突出部，就像长津湖这里的这个。这一地段由一个北美师掩护。你的任务是从两个不同方向发起奇袭，全歼该敌师。小心，我们的间谍报告说那是一个精锐师，而且他们从水库附近的一座临时机场获得空中支援。空中增援正在赶来。

en: I can't understand your failure commander.  It seems our estimation of your skills were wrong... the central ChCP commission has demoted you to a private for the remainder of the fighting.  This should erase any capitalist bad manners that you may have acquired.
zh: 我无法理解你的失败，指挥官。看来我们对你的能力评估错了...中共中央委员会已把你降为列兵，直到战斗结束。这应当能洗掉你可能沾染上的资本主义坏习气。

en: Congratulations, the way to the South is open.  The North Americans have received a stinging lesson on the power of the People's War.
zh: 祝贺你，南下的大门已经打开。北美人在人民战争的力量面前受到了惨痛的教训。

en: Congratulations, the way to the South is open.  The North Americans have received a stinging lesson on the power of the People's War.
zh: 祝贺你，南下的大门已经打开。北美人在人民战争的力量面前受到了惨痛的教训。
联合国军反击 [朝鲜战争]

en: The enemy offensive has been completely defeated.  Seoul is now securely in our hands, Kim-Il-Sung is really happy with your actions.  Now, let's complete the communist victory in Korea.
zh: 敌人的进攻已被彻底击败。汉城现在牢牢掌握在我们手中，金日成对你的行动非常满意。现在，让我们完成朝鲜的共产主义胜利。

en: Seoul, beyond the 38th Paralell, near to the former DMZ.
zh: 汉城，三八线以南，靠近旧非军事区。

en: The lightning advances of December and early January provide us with the opportunity to easily retake Seoul for the North Koreans.  However, the situation is becoming dangerous.  Our supply lines to China are long and are constantly being bombed and strafed by the UN air force.  Because of this they are preparing a counterattack to again liberate Seoul.  Our Korean spies have told us that a great number of troops are concentrating South of Suwon, including modern tanks and heavy artillery.
zh: 12月和1月初的闪电推进，为我们提供了轻松为朝鲜人夺回汉城的机会。然而，局势正变得危险。我们通往中国的补给线漫长，并不断遭到联合国空军的轰炸和扫射。因此，他们正准备发动一次反击，以再次解放汉城。我们的朝鲜间谍告诉我们，大量部队正在水原以南集结，包括现代化的坦克和重炮。

en: Be careful, our troops are nearly exhausted due to the quick advances in the past months. Your mission is to protect Seoul at all costs and if possible defeat the capitalist advance.
zh: 小心，由于过去几个月的快速推进，我们的部队几乎已精疲力竭。你的任务是不惜一切代价保卫汉城，如有可能，击退资本主义者的进攻。

en: I can't understand your failure commander.  It seems our estimation of your skills were wrong... the central ChCP commission has demoted you to a private for the remainder of the fighting.  This should erase any capitalist bad manners that you may have acquired.
zh: 我无法理解你的失败，指挥官。看来我们对你的能力评估错了...中共中央委员会已把你降为列兵，直到战斗结束。这应当能洗掉你可能沾染上的资本主义坏习气。

en: We have stopped the offensive, but our casualities have been too high.  You have permission to retreat your armies behind the Han river to avoid future losses.
zh: 我们挡住了这次进攻，但我们的伤亡太大了。允许你把部队后撤到汉江以北，以避免今后的损失。

en: The enemy offensive has been completely defeated.  Seoul is now securely in our hands, Kim-Il-Sung is really happy with your actions.  Now, let's complete the communist victory in Korea.
zh: 敌人的进攻已被彻底击败。汉城现在牢牢掌握在我们手中，金日成对你的行动非常满意。现在，让我们完成朝鲜的共产主义胜利。

en: You have crushed the UN forces with a smashing victory!  Now, we can continue with our advance towards Seoul.
zh: 你以一场猛烈的胜利粉碎了联合国军！现在，我们可以继续向汉城推进了。

en: Again, your smashing attack has left the enemy forces on the ground isolated.  This is the situation at Hungnam.  The UN forces are surrounded from the North and South by us while the North Korean units will attack from the East.  However, the Hungnam port continues to be their main lifeline, supported by their overwhelming naval power.
zh: 又一次，你的猛烈进攻使敌军地面部队陷入孤立。兴南的局势就是这样。联合国军被我们从北面和南面包围，而朝鲜人民军部队将从东面发起进攻。不过，兴南港仍是他们的主要生命线，并得到其压倒性海军力量的支持。

en: Your mission is to reach the port of Hungnam while destroying all enemy forces along your way.  You must stop any UN evacuation as soon as possible.  A successful evacuation will be a victory for them.  The 2nd, 6th and 10th North Korean divisions (the 2nd Korean People's Army) will be under your direct command and the 20th PLA will arrive from the South as reinforcements.
zh: 你的任务是推进到兴南港，同时消灭沿途所有敌军。你必须尽快阻止联合国军任何撤离行动。撤离成功对他们来说就是一场胜利。朝鲜人民军第2、第6和第10师（朝鲜人民军第2军）将归你直接指挥，解放军第20军将从南面赶来作为增援。

en: I can't understand your failure commander.  It seems our estimation of your skills were wrong... the central ChCP commission has demoted you to a private for the remainder of the fighting.  This should erase any capitalist bad manners that you may have acquired.
zh: 我无法理解你的失败，指挥官。看来我们对你的能力评估错了...中共中央委员会已把你降为列兵，直到战斗结束。这应当能洗掉你可能沾染上的资本主义坏习气。

en: Most of the UN forces have escaped and you have suffered heavy causalities.  You, commander, will meet a People's Court to determine if you are a capitalist sympathizer.
zh: 大部分联合国军部队已经逃走，而你遭受了惨重伤亡。指挥官，你将面对人民法庭，以判定你是否是资本主义同情者。

en: Some UN forces have escaped from Hungnam, but at least we can now continue with our advance towards Seoul.
zh: 一些联合国军部队已从兴南逃走，但至少我们现在可以继续向汉城推进了。
第1阿盖尔-萨瑟兰高地营
第1阿盖尔-萨瑟兰高地营

en: Congratulations comrade!  Korea is now entirely unified under the communist flag, and Kim-Il-Sung has been proclaimed chairman of the People's Republic of Korea at Seoul. This is an enormous victory for the communist world, there have also been celebrations at other communist capitals like Moscow, East-Berlin, and of course Beijing.
zh: 祝贺你，同志！朝鲜现在已完全统一在共产主义旗帜之下，金日成已在汉城宣告就任朝鲜人民共和国主席。这是共产主义世界的巨大胜利，莫斯科、东柏林，当然还有北京等其他共产主义国家首都也举行了庆祝活动。

en: Now you are a hero for the People's Republic of China and for all the workers around the world.
zh: 现在你是中华人民共和国和全世界工人的英雄。

en: Just like last year, the UN forces are again encircled on the ''Pusan Perimeter''.  Now, with the bulk of the North Korean forces are guarding the rear, we can assault the enemy positions without the fear of an assault on our back like last years landings at Inch'on.
zh: 就像去年一样，联合国军再次被围困在"釜山环形防御圈"中。现在，由于朝鲜人民军主力正守卫后方，我们可以进攻敌军阵地，而不必担心像去年仁川登陆那样背后遭到袭击。

en: You have one mission; destroy the remnants of the capitalist forces.  Otherwise, they will receive more reinforcements and support from their stronghold at Pusan.  Quick drive them into the sea and Korea will become the unified Korean People's Republic.
zh: 你只有一个任务；消灭资本主义势力的残余。否则，他们将从其釜山据点获得更多增援和支持。迅速把他们赶下海，朝鲜将成为统一的朝鲜人民共和国。

en: This was a disaster!  The arguments formerly proposed by General McArthur have finally been accepted by Washington.  A nuclear attack was carried out over the city of Nanjing, killing millions of Chinese people.  The soviets have declined to give us any nuclear help and now we must accept the peace imposed by the West.
zh: 这是一场灾难！麦克阿瑟将军先前提出的主张终于被华盛顿接受了。一次核打击落在南京城上空，杀死了数百万中国人民。苏联人拒绝给我们任何核援助，现在我们只能接受西方强加的和平。

en: Now you are a hero for the People's Republic of China and for all the workers around the world.
zh: 现在你是中华人民共和国和全世界工人的英雄。

en: Perfect!  The North Korean flag again flies over the city of Seoul.  Kim-Il-Sung is really pleased with you.   You have become a hero for the Korean people.
zh: 完美！朝鲜的旗帜再次飘扬在汉城上空。金日成对你非常满意。你已成为朝鲜人民的英雄。
1951年4月22日 汉城，三八线附近。

en: It's time to go back to Seoul.  We have deployed a large number of PLA and KPA units Northwards toward Seoul and with your armies nothing will stop us in our drive.  The South Korean capital must be in our hands again.
zh: 是时候重返汉城了。我们已把大量解放军和朝鲜人民军部队向北部署，直指汉城，有你的部队，我们的推进将无可阻挡。韩国首都必须再次回到我们手中。

en: The UN forces have massed their units to protect their silly so-called ''No-Named line''.  Anyway, this situation fits perfectly with our People's War doctrine.  Launch your armies and over run the dirty capitalist's invaders on your way to recapture Seoul.
zh: 联合国军已集结部队来保卫他们那愚蠢的所谓"无名线"。无论如何，这种局面完全符合我们的人民战争学说。发动你的部队，在重夺汉城的路上碾碎肮脏的资本主义侵略者。

en: I can't understand your failure commander.  It seems our estimation of your skills were wrong... the central ChCP commission has demoted you to a private for the remainder of the fighting.  This should erase any capitalist bad manners that you may have acquired.
zh: 我无法理解你的失败，指挥官。看来我们对你的能力评估错了...中共中央委员会已把你降为列兵，直到战斗结束。这应当能洗掉你可能沾染上的资本主义坏习气。

en: Perfect!  The North Korean flag again flies over the city of Seoul.  Kim-Il-Sung is really pleased with you.   You have become a hero for the Korean people.   Anyway we are shortly going to open the negotiations with the UN forces to terminate this conflict.
zh: 完美！朝鲜的旗帜再次飘扬在汉城上空。金日成对你非常满意。你已成为朝鲜人民的英雄。不管怎样，我们很快就会与联合国军开始谈判，以结束这场冲突。

en: Perfect!  The North Korean flag again flies over the city of Seoul.  Kim-Il-Sung is really pleased with you.   You have become a hero for the Korean people.   Anyway we are shortly going to open the negotiations with the UN forces to terminate this conflict.
zh: 完美！朝鲜的旗帜再次飘扬在汉城上空。金日成对你非常满意。你已成为朝鲜人民的英雄。不管怎样，我们很快就会与联合国军开始谈判，以结束这场冲突。
联合国特遣部队指挥部
中国人民武装警察部队晋江

en: Chiang Kai Shek has escaped from Taipei thanks to his American friends, but the whole Taiwanese island plus other minor islands are now part of the PRC.  The Civil War is over and all the Chinese territories are now unified under the red stars flag!  Comrade Mao is pleased with you, the hero of the PRC.
zh: 蒋介石已在他的美国朋友帮助下从台北逃走，但整个台湾岛以及其他一些小岛现在都是中华人民共和国的一部分。内战结束了，所有中国领土现在都统一在红星旗帜之下！毛泽东同志对你很满意，中华人民共和国的英雄。

en: I hope you had enough rest from your participation on the Korean War.  As one of the heroes of the PRC the High Command of the PLA has a new mission for you.  The new North American government has retired the fleet that was guarding the Taiwan Strait.  This is the opportunity we have been waiting for; the assault on the rebel province of Taiwan.  You must end the existence of the KMT and its leader, Chiang-Kai-Shek.
zh: 希望你参加朝鲜战争之后已经休息够了。作为中华人民共和国的英雄之一，解放军最高统帅部给你一项新任务。新的北美政府已撤走守卫台湾海峡的舰队。这正是我们一直在等待的机会；进攻叛乱省份台湾。你必须终结国民党的存在及其领袖蒋介石。

en: Embark your units in Tianjing and reach the Taiwanese coast as soon as possible.  Beijing is sure the UN will take part in operations like in Korea, this time supporting the KMT in Taiwan.  Your highest priority is the conquest of Taipei.  With this city we will complete the unification of all the Chinese territories.
zh: 把你的部队从天津登船，尽快抵达台湾海岸。北京确信联合国会像在朝鲜那样介入行动，这次是支持台湾的国民党。你的最高优先目标是攻占台北。有了这座城市，我们就能完成所有中国领土的统一。

en: This was a disaster... the arguments formerly proposed by General McArthur have finally been accepted by Washington.  A nuclear attack has been carried out over the city of Nanjing, killing millions of Chinese people... The soviets have declined to give us any nuclear help and now we must accept the imposed Western peace.
zh: 这是一场灾难...麦克阿瑟将军先前提出的主张终于被华盛顿接受了。一次核打击落在南京城上空，杀死了数百万中国人民...苏联人拒绝给我们任何核援助，现在我们只能接受西方强加的和平。

A nuclear attack was carried out over the city of Nanjing, killing millions of Chinese people.  The soviets have declined to give us any nuclear help and now we must accept the peace imposed by the West.

zh: 蒋介石已在他的美国朋友帮助下从台北逃走，但整个台湾岛以及其他一些小岛现在都是中华人民共和国的一部分。内战结束了，所有中国领土现在都统一在红星旗帜之下！毛泽东同志对你很满意，中华人民共和国的英雄。
歼击轰炸航空兵第7大队
歼击轰炸航空兵第7大队

en: Ahh, comrade Commander!  Do you like Khabarovsk?  It's a pretty city, isn't it?   I know you are the greatest hero of the PRC and the KRC and I have a mission for you from the Kremlin.  I have to give you a letter from Moscow but... well anyway this is a good situation to do it.  Err... yes, but first, let's negotiate the surrender of my forces in this sector.
zh: 啊，指挥员同志！你喜欢哈巴罗夫斯克吗？这是座漂亮的城市，不是吗？我知道你是中华人民共和国和朝鲜人民共和国最伟大的英雄，克里姆林宫交给你一项任务。我得转交给你一封莫斯科的来信，不过...好吧，反正现在正是转交的好时机。呃...对，不过首先，让我们商谈一下我这个地段部队的投降事宜。

en: 1-10-1955, Amur river, Sino-Soviet border, near Khabarovsk, Far Eastern Siberia.
zh: 1955年10月1日，黑龙江，中苏边境，靠近远东西伯利亚的哈巴罗夫斯克。

en: A chain of unfortunate incidents with the Soviets along the Chinese - Soviet border has opened the way for the outbreak of full scale military operations.  As you know, the relationship with our former Soviet allies has badly deteriorated.  Moscow doesn't like our own interpretation of Marxism and wants to take us back to the ''correct'' communist system.  To punish us, they have launched an invasion across the Amur River, the natural border between the PRC and the USSR.  They have captured a many square kilometers of Chinese territory, including some villages.
zh: 中苏边境沿线一连串不幸事件，为全面军事行动的爆发打开了道路。如你所知，我们与从前的苏联盟友的关系已严重恶化。莫斯科不喜欢我们对马克思主义自己的解释，想让我们回到"正确"的共产主义制度。为了惩罚我们，他们越过黑龙江——中华人民共和国与苏联之间的天然边界——发动了入侵。他们已夺取了许多平方公里的中国领土，包括一些村庄。

en: You are the commander of the best units in the whole PLA, and your mission is to counter-strike the Soviet invaders.  If we want to continue with our own interpretation of the Marxism, we must defeat the Soviets.  Also Mao would be most pleased, if your men capture the important city of Khabarovsk.  He says that these territories are historically Chinese and no soviets must remain on Chinese lands!
zh: 你是整个解放军中最精锐部队的指挥员，你的任务是反击苏联入侵者。如果我们想继续走自己对马克思主义的解释，就必须击败苏联人。而且，如果你的部队夺取重镇哈巴罗夫斯克，毛泽东将会极为满意。他说这些领土历史上属于中国，中国土地上不得留下一名苏联人！

en: I can't understand your failure commander.  It seems our estimation of your skills were wrong... the central ChCP commission has demoted you to a private for the remainder of the fighting.  This should erase any capitalist bad manners that you may have acquired.
zh: 我无法理解你的失败，指挥官。看来我们对你的能力评估错了...中共中央委员会已把你降为列兵，直到战斗结束。这应当能洗掉你可能沾染上的资本主义坏习气。

I have to give you a letter from Moscow but... well anyway this is a good situation to do it.  Err... yes, but first, let's negotiate the surrender of my forces in this sector.
zh: 啊，指挥员同志！你喜欢哈巴罗夫斯克吗？这是座漂亮的城市，不是吗？我知道你是中华人民共和国和朝鲜人民共和国最伟大的英雄，克里姆林宫交给你一项任务。我得转交给你一封莫斯科的来信，不过...好吧，反正现在正是转交的好时机。呃...对，不过首先，让我们商谈一下我这个地段部队的投降事宜。

en: Congratulations comrade!  You are the new Premier of the People's Republic of China. Mao has disappeared and we know he won't be back, hahaha!  I hope your understanding of the communist doctrine will be the correct one.  That would be the best for the communist world.
zh: 祝贺你，同志！你是中华人民共和国的新总理。毛已经消失，我们知道他不会再回来了，哈哈哈！我希望你对共产主义学说的理解会是正确的那一种。那对共产主义世界来说是最好的。

en: Private Tovarich!  Nice to see you again.  It has been a while since our last meeting at Khabarovsk.  It was a shame to lose the battle against you, but now we can re-negotiate the conditions of the peace treaty.  This is Top Secret and I hope you have told no one of our plans.  As our men from the KGB have told you, we are ready to support you, if you finally decide to undertake a coup against Mao Zedong and his reformed communism.  It is literally destroying China.  We need to take China back to the right and true communist way.  We think you and your so-called ''Gang of Four'' are the perfect team to take down the Maoist system and that destructive plan named ''Great Leap Forward''.  That woman of your gang, ''Madame Mao'' can be very useful in the near future, when you will need to destroy the political image of Mao.
zh: 列兵达瓦里希！很高兴再次见到你。自上次在哈巴罗夫斯克会面以来已过了些时日。输给你那场战斗真是遗憾，但现在我们可以重新谈判和约条件了。这是最高机密，我希望你没有把我们计划的事告诉任何人。正如我们克格勃的人告诉你的，我们准备支持你，如果你最终决定对毛泽东及其改良共产主义发动政变的话。它正在实实在在地毁掉中国。我们需要把中国拉回正确而真正的共产主义道路。我们认为你和你那所谓的"四人帮"是推翻毛主义体制以及那个名为"大跃进"的破坏性计划的完美组合。你们团伙中的那个女人，"毛夫人"，在不久的将来会非常有用，那时你需要摧毁毛的政治形象。

en: This is the plan we suggest; in the past month the units under your direct management have been deployed on the coast of the Sea of China in preparation for the Coup.   We are ready to support you by sea.  The Chinese navy will remain loyal to Mao, but it is not powerful enough to deal with a minor Soviet submarine unit.  After we secure the entire coast by taking Tanggu, you must launch the counterattack against the government loyalist units which surely will be sent to defeat our plans.  Take the Tanggu airfield as soon as possible as this will allow us to send you reinforcements by air.  Our planes will be painted with the PRC symbols.  You must avoid the Americans as we don't need any problems with them now.  The incident should be only between Chinese forces.
zh: 这是我们建议的计划；过去一个月里，你直接管辖的部队已部署在中国海沿岸，为政变做准备。我们准备从海上支援你。中国海军将继续效忠毛，但它不足以对付一支小规模的苏联潜艇部队。在我们通过夺取塘沽控制整条海岸线之后，你必须对政府忠诚派部队发起反击，他们必定会被派来挫败我们的计划。尽快夺取塘沽机场，这将使我们能通过空运给你送来增援。我们的飞机会涂上中华人民共和国的标志。你必须避开美国人，因为我们现在不需要与他们发生任何麻烦。这次事件应仅限于中国部队之间。

en: The last stand will be Beijing, this won't be easy, as you know, the best PLA units are deployed there.  The price maybe high, but it deserves a try.  You can become the new premier of the People's Republic of China!
zh: 最后的决战将是北京，这不会容易，如你所知，解放军最好的部队都部署在那里。代价也许很高，但值得一试。你可以成为中华人民共和国的新总理！

en: AH!  You dirty rebel and traitor!.  You, the former hero of the People's Republic of China are now a coward capitalist traitor.  Your execution will be soon be celebrated in Tiananmen Square.
zh: 啊！你这个肮脏的叛贼和卖国贼！你，前中华人民共和国的英雄，如今是个懦弱的资本主义叛徒。你的处决不久将在天安门广场上被庆祝。

en: I was completely wrong about you and maybe also with your friend Zhou, hmmm or maybe not.  I think China deserves a return to the true Revolution to avoid the capitalist deformation that you have suffered.
zh: 我看错你了，也许也看错了你的朋友周，嗯，也许没有。我认为中国应当回归真正的革命，以避免你所沾染上的资本主义蜕变。

en: Congratulations comrade!  You are the new Premier of the People's Republic of China. Mao has disappeared and we know he won't be back, hahaha!  I hope your understanding of the communist doctrine will be the correct one.  That would be the best for the communist world.
zh: 祝贺你，同志！你是中华人民共和国的新总理。毛已经消失，我们知道他不会再回来了，哈哈哈！我希望你对共产主义学说的理解会是正确的那一种。那对共产主义世界来说是最好的。

en: Congratulations comrade!  You are the new Premier of the People's Republic of China. Mao has disappeared and we know he won't be back, hahaha!  I hope your understanding of the communist doctrine will be the correct one.  That would be the best for the communist world.
zh: 祝贺你，同志！你是中华人民共和国的新总理。毛已经消失，我们知道他不会再回来了，哈哈哈！我希望你对共产主义学说的理解会是正确的那一种。那对共产主义世界来说是最好的。

en: The uprising was successful and Nanchang is ours!  This has become the first major stronghold of Marxism in China.  Now it is time to create a Revolutionary Committee in this city to manage our goals.  We must get Soviet aid by sea with another uprising in Guangzhou.  Our comrades there will receive our support from Nanchang.
zh: 起义成功了，南昌是我们的了！这里已成为马克思主义在中国第一个主要据点。现在该在这座城市建立革命委员会来管理我们的目标。我们必须通过在广州的另一场起义来获得苏联的海上援助。那里的同志将得到我们自南昌的支援。

en: Brave soldiers under my command!  The so-called ''united front'' with the Kuomingtan is over.  Today we will join the revolution against the ancient oppressors of the Chinese people and against the likes of Chiang-Kai-Shek.  Some of our comrades in other army units will also join us in our glorious uprising against the enemies of the people.  They are just now coming here to help us in the assault on the old city of Nanchang!  The end of the oppression, the capitalism, and the humiliations begins here on the West bank of the Gan River!  We are surrounded by the local warlords KMT troops, but our comrades will attack them from different directions, and the victory will be ours!
zh: 我指挥下的英勇士兵们！与国民党的所谓"统一战线"已经结束。今天我们投身革命，反抗压迫中国人民的古老压迫者，反抗蒋介石之流。我们在其他部队的一些同志也将加入我们这场反抗人民之敌的光荣起义。他们此刻正赶来协助我们攻打南昌老城！压迫、资本主义与屈辱的终结，就从赣江西岸开始！我们被地方军阀的国民党军队包围，但我们的同志将从不同方向进攻他们，胜利必将属于我们！

en: Our battle against the ancient landlords of oppression has been suddenly stopped... now we must again dress ourselves as peasants to avoid being captured by the enemy.
zh: 我们对古老压迫地主的战斗突然被制止了...现在我们只得再次装扮成农民，以免被敌人俘获。

en: The uprising was successful and Nanchang is ours!  This has become the first major stronghold of Marxism in China.  Now it is time to create a Revolutionary Committee in this city to manage our goals.  We must get Soviet aid by sea with another uprising in Guangzhou.  Our comrades there will receive our support from Nanchang.
zh: 起义成功了，南昌是我们的了！这里已成为马克思主义在中国第一个主要据点。现在该在这座城市建立革命委员会来管理我们的目标。我们必须通过在广州的另一场起义来获得苏联的海上援助。那里的同志将得到我们自南昌的支援。

en: Xion wei!   The uprising was very successfull here in Changsha... Mao isn't as popular as he wanted... but his prestige continues to grow anyway.   We are going to join his troops for now.
zh: 雄威！长沙这里的起义非常成功...毛并不像他自己希望的那样受欢迎...但他的声望仍在不断增长。我们暂时先加入他的部队。
1927年9月7日，中国中南部湖南长沙。

en: The uprising at Guangzhou against the local warlords was successful and access by sea for Soviet aid was secured.  Now, comrade Mao from Hunan is planning an assault on the city fortress of Changsha against the local warlords and KMT troops placed at that city. The central Chinese Communist Party director dislikes this operation, but we are going to dispatch your troops there to help our comrades in the offensive.  Personally, I don't want the prestige of Mao Zedong to overly influence the ChCP.  He seems to gain more power each day.
zh: 广州反抗地方军阀的起义取得了成功，苏联援助的海上通道已得到保障。现在，来自湖南的毛泽东同志正计划进攻长沙城防，打击当地军阀和驻守该城的国民党军队。中共中央的负责人不喜欢这次行动，但我们还是要把你的部队派去协助我们同志进攻。就我个人而言，我不愿毛泽东的声望过分影响中国共产党。他似乎一天比一天更有权势。

en: Our battle against the ancient landlords of oppression has been suddenly stopped... now we must again dress ourselves as peasants to avoid being captured by the enemy.
zh: 我们对古老压迫地主的战斗突然被制止了...现在我们只得再次装扮成农民，以免被敌人俘获。

en: Xion wei!   The uprising was successfull here in Changsha... Mao isn't as popular as he wanted... but his prestige continues to grow anyway.   We are going to join his troops for now.
zh: 雄威！长沙这里的起义成功了...毛并不像他自己希望的那样受欢迎...但他的声望仍在不断增长。我们暂时先加入他的部队。

en: Xion wei!   The uprising was very successfull here in Changsha... Mao isn't as popular as he wanted... but his prestige continues to grow anyway.   We are going to join his troops for now.
zh: 雄威！长沙这里的起义非常成功...毛并不像他自己希望的那样受欢迎...但他的声望仍在不断增长。我们暂时先加入他的部队。

en: Congratulations on your victory.   Myself, together with Mao and our Komintern advisor Li-De (Otto Braun) are planning the evacuation of Jinggangshan.  We will do it quickly while the KMT troops are busy dealing with the Japanese in Manchuria.
zh: 祝贺你的胜利。我本人将同毛以及我们的共产国际顾问李德（奥托·布劳恩）一起筹划井冈山的撤离。我们会在国民党军队忙于在满洲对付日本人时迅速行动。
1930年10月11日，中国东南江西井冈山山区。

en: Comrade Mao has established a "Soviet Commune'' here in the Jinggangshan Mountains.  It is well protected and hidden from our enemies by a heavy wilderness and bamboo trees.  All the access points to our base are under continuous servalance and our Soviet GRU spies report that the Kuomingtan enemies and the Warlords are planning to eradicate us at once.  They are supported by German advisors who think the best way to eliminate us from here is the so-called strategy ''ferocious walls''.  They are blocking our exits by constructing blockhouses.  We will resist their attacks as long as possible.  Mao thinks we will leave here soon and go North which is much closer to the Soviet border.
zh: 毛泽东同志已在井冈山建立了一个"苏维埃公社"。这里被茂密的荒野和竹林掩护，很好地保护着我们，不被敌人发现。我们基地的所有通道都在持续监视之下，我们苏维埃的格鲁乌间谍报告说，国民党敌人和军阀正打算一举消灭我们。他们有德国顾问支持，这些顾问认为把我们赶出这里最好的办法就是所谓的"铁壁"战略。他们正修筑碉堡封锁我们的出路。我们将尽可能长久地抵抗他们的进攻。毛泽东认为我们很快就会离开这里北上，那里离苏联边境近得多。

en: Our Soviet advisors suggest that we let the enemy troops pass through the mountains and then annihilate them on a familiar battlefield.
zh: 我们的苏联顾问建议，让敌军穿过山区，然后在熟悉的战场上歼灭他们。

zh: 我们对古老压迫地主的战斗突然被制止了...现在我们只得再次装扮成农民，以免被敌人俘获。

zh: 祝贺你的胜利。我本人将同毛以及我们的共产国际顾问李德（奥托·布劳恩）一起筹划井冈山的撤离。我们会在国民党军队忙于在满洲对付日本人时迅速行动。

zh: 祝贺你的胜利。我本人将同毛以及我们的共产国际顾问李德（奥托·布劳恩）一起筹划井冈山的撤离。我们会在国民党军队忙于在满洲对付日本人时迅速行动。

en: Victory!   We have crossed that damned bridge and many comrades have died, but their lives were not lost, they have contributed to the success of our retreat to save the Revolution.  Congratulations for your actions.
zh: 胜利！我们已跨过那座该死的桥，许多同志牺牲了，但他们的生命没有白费，他们为我们撤退以挽救革命的胜利作出了贡献。祝贺你的行动。

en: Welcome again commander.  We have escaped from Jingghanshan in our long march to the North.  Today the Dadu River lies in front of us, and your task is to cross that river.  The problem is, we have in front the city of Luding, which is in the hands of the local pro-KMT Warlord Liu Wenhui.  I see the chains bridge over the Dadu River is on fire, but our long march can't be stopped!  Go ahead soldier!
zh: 再次欢迎你，指挥官。我们已从井冈山突围，踏上北上的长征。今天大渡河横在我们面前，你的任务是渡过这条河。问题是，我们前方是泸定城，它掌握在亲国民党的当地军阀刘文辉手中。我看到大渡河上的铁索桥正在燃烧，但我们的长征不能停下！前进吧，士兵！

en: Our battle against the ancient landlords of oppression has been suddenly stopped... now we must again dress ourselves as peasants to avoid being captured by the enemy.
zh: 我们对古老压迫地主的战斗突然被制止了...现在我们只得再次装扮成农民，以免被敌人俘获。

en: Victory!   We have crossed that damned bridge and many comrades have died, but their lives were not lost, they have contributed to the success of our retreat to save the Revolution.  Congratulations for your actions.
zh: 胜利！我们已跨过那座该死的桥，许多同志牺牲了，但他们的生命没有白费，他们为我们撤退以挽救革命的胜利作出了贡献。祝贺你的行动。

en: Victory!   We have crossed that damned bridge and many comrades have died, but their lives were not lost, they have contributed to the success of our retreat to save the Revolution.  Congratulations for your actions.
zh: 胜利！我们已跨过那座该死的桥，许多同志牺牲了，但他们的生命没有白费，他们为我们撤退以挽救革命的胜利作出了贡献。祝贺你的行动。

en: Wan shan!  All the mission objectives were achieved before the Japanese could send reinforcements to this area.  Now your task is to hide your guerrillas and wait for new orders.
zh: 万岁！在日军能向这一地区派出增援之前，所有任务目标都已达成。现在你的任务是隐藏你的游击队，等待新的命令。

en: Again, the central committee of the ChCP has agreed to launch another guerrilla assault on the Japanese rearguard in co-operation with our Kuomingtan ''allies''.  Comrade Mao dislikes this attack, but China is calling for Chinese action against the invaders, and that's what we are going to carry out.  The main objectives must be the capture of enemy resources present in your area: the coal mines and factories.  Your battle plan includes some cities and don't forget to cut all enemy lines of communication.
zh: 中共中央再次同意与我们的国民党"盟友"配合，对日军后方发动一次游击突击。毛泽东同志不喜欢这次进攻，但中国在呼吁中国人对侵略者采取行动，我们要做的就是这个。主要目标必须是夺取你所在区域内的敌方资源：煤矿和工厂。你的作战计划包括一些城市，别忘了切断敌人所有的交通线。

en: Act as quick as possible, the Japanese are going to use all available means to defeat any try to stop their penetration into China.
zh: 行动要尽可能迅速，日军将动用一切可用手段来挫败任何阻止其深入中国的企图。

en: Wan shan!  All the mission objectives were achieved before the Japanese could send reinforcements to this area.  Now your task is to hide your guerrillas and wait for new orders.
zh: 万岁！在日军能向这一地区派出增援之前，所有任务目标都已达成。现在你的任务是隐藏你的游击队，等待新的命令。

en: Wan shan!  All the mission objectives were achieved before the Japanese could send reinforcements to this area.  Now your task is to hide your guerrillas and wait for new orders.
zh: 万岁！在日军能向这一地区派出增援之前，所有任务目标都已达成。现在你的任务是隐藏你的游击队，等待新的命令。

en: Tong gan ku!  The dirty Japanese invaders got a lesson in good old ancient Chinese tactics.  The enemy division is completely scattered and our troops can continue to harass them.
zh: 同甘苦！肮脏的日本侵略者领教了中国古老的好战术。敌师已被彻底打散，我们的部队可以继续袭扰他们了。

en: 25-9-1937, Pingxingguan Pass, near Datong, Northern China.
zh: 1937年9月25日，中国北方大同附近的平型关。

en: As you know, we have signed an alliance with our former enemies, the nationalists.  Now, the enemy is the foreign imperialist invader, it's time to forget our quarrel with the KMT for a while.  We are united with them against a common enemy: the Japanese Empire.  While the KMT troops are dealing with the Japanese armies in other parts of China, our guerrillas have been surrounded by the enemy advance in Manchuria and other many places in Northern China, and you (yes, you), a veteran ChCP commander will show the dirty invaders a bit of the people's revolution power.  We must harass the Japanese rearguard as much as possible without taking too many losses.  I'm sure the current KMT-ChCP alliance will not long too much longer.
zh: 如你所知，我们已同从前的敌人国民政府结盟。如今敌人是外国帝国主义侵略者，是时候暂时放下与国民党的争执了。我们与他们联合起来对抗共同的敌人：日本帝国。当国民党军队在中国其他地区对付日军时，我们的游击队在满洲和中国北方许多地方已被敌人推进所包围，而你（对，就是你），一位老练的中共指挥员，要让肮脏的侵略者见识一下人民革命的力量。我们必须尽可能袭扰日军后方，同时不要遭受太大损失。我相信目前的国共联盟不会维持太久。

en: This is your duty commander; the 5th Japanese division is driving south towards the Pingxingguan Pass. You must block their path, and then, annihilate all the Japanese, using your famous guerrilla tactics.
zh: 这是你的职责，指挥官；日军第5师团正向南直扑平型关。你必须挡住他们的去路，然后用你著名的游击战术歼灭全部日军。

en: I can't understand your failure commander.  It seems our estimation of your skills were wrong... the central ChCP commission has demoted you to a private for the remainder of the fighting.  This should erase any capitalist bad manners that you may have acquired.
zh: 我无法理解你的失败，指挥官。看来我们对你的能力评估错了...中共中央委员会已把你降为列兵，直到战斗结束。这应当能洗掉你可能沾染上的资本主义坏习气。

en: Tong gan ku!  The dirty Japanese invaders got a lesson in good old ancient Chinese tactics.  The enemy division is completely scattered and our troops can continue to harass them.
zh: 同甘苦！肮脏的日本侵略者领教了中国古老的好战术。敌师已被彻底打散，我们的部队可以继续袭扰他们了。

en: Tong gan ku!  The dirty Japanese invaders got a lesson in good old ancient Chinese tactics.  The enemy division is completely scattered and our troops can continue to harass them.
zh: 同甘苦！肮脏的日本侵略者领教了中国古老的好战术。敌师已被彻底打散，我们的部队可以继续袭扰他们了。

en: Wan Shan!  We have saved a lot of our men from the Kuomingtan onslaught.  We must hope to counterstrike the dirty nationalists as soon as we receive some Soviet aid through Manchuria.
zh: 万岁！我们已从国民党的猛攻中救出了许多人员。我们必须寄望于一旦通过满洲获得一些苏联援助，就立即反击那些肮脏的国民政府军。

en: Nice to see you again... I hope the lessons you have reciently taken in the USSR about the modern warfare will be useful for us now. Well, please sit down, I have some information to bring you about the current situation.
zh: 很高兴再次见到你...我希望你最近在苏联学到的现代战争课程现在对我们有用。好，请坐，我有一些关于当前局势的情报要告诉你。

en: As you know, the Soviet victory agaisnt the Japanese in Manchuria the past year has opened the gate of the regular support of hardware and weapons to us. Now, the ChCP troops are better equipped and trained. The Soviets have given us some Japanese captured equipment from Manchuria, like tanks and artillery and the Japanese prisoners are training our brave men. They had no choice: work in Siberia or work with us!.
zh: 如你所知，去年苏联在满洲对日本的胜利为我们打开了获得硬件和武器正规支援的大门。现在，中共部队装备和训练都更好了。苏联人把从满洲缴获的一些日军装备给了我们，比如坦克和大炮，日军战俘正在训练我们的勇士。他们别无选择：要么去西伯利亚干活，要么跟我们干！

en: However, it's still soon to enjoy our new training and equipment... the bad news?, well the mission of the US general George Marshall to pacificate China and reach an agreement between us and the KMT is a clear failure. The Kuomingtan have taken advantage of the time just to rearm their units, and now they are clearly taking positions around our areas, probably to anihilate us like in the 30's. In case of the outbreak of the war... your mission is to drive your units in Wuhan to the West, to join the central ChCP units in Central China.
zh: 不过，现在享受我们的新训练和新装备还为时过早...坏消息呢？美国将军乔治·马歇尔促成中国和平、让我们与国民党达成协议的使命已明显失败。国民党利用这段时间重整了他们的部队，现在他们显然正在我们的区域周围占据阵地，很可能想像30年代那样消灭我们。一旦战争爆发...你的任务是把你在武汉的部队向西开进，去与华中的中共中央部队会合。

en: I can't understand your failure commander.  It seems our estimation of your skills were wrong... the central ChCP commission has demoted you to a private for the remainder of the fighting.  This should erase any capitalist bad manners that you may have acquired.
zh: 我无法理解你的失败，指挥官。看来我们对你的能力评估错了...中共中央委员会已把你降为列兵，直到战斗结束。这应当能洗掉你可能沾染上的资本主义坏习气。

en: Wan Shan!  We have saved a lot of our men from the Kuomingtan onslaught.  We must hope to counterstrike the dirty nationalists as soon as we receive some Soviet aid through Manchuria.
zh: 万岁！我们已从国民党的猛攻中救出了许多人员。我们必须寄望于一旦通过满洲获得一些苏联援助，就立即反击那些肮脏的国民政府军。

en: Wan Shan!  We have saved a lot of our men from the Kuomingtan onslaught.  We must hope to counterstrike the dirty nationalists as soon as we receive some Soviet aid through Manchuria.
zh: 万岁！我们已从国民党的猛攻中救出了许多人员。我们必须寄望于一旦通过满洲获得一些苏联援助，就立即反击那些肮脏的国民政府军。

en: Thanks to your good work, our base at Linjiang is now safe.  In addition, we are now in a good position to attack Changchun, Jilin and Siping during the next summer offensive.  We will wait for good weather to arrive in Manchuria.
zh: 多亏你出色的工作，我们的临江基地现在安全了。此外，我们现在处于有利地位，可以在下一次夏季攻势中进攻长春、吉林和四平。我们将等待满洲好天气的到来。

en: Congratulations on your promotion to commander of our reciently created People's Liberation Army!. Your actions were enough to support your upgrade decided in the ChCP council... Mao Zedong it's also pleased with you as PLA's general.
zh: 祝贺你晋升为我们新近组建的中国人民解放军指挥员！你的表现足以支撑中共中央委员会决定给你这次提拔...毛泽东对作为解放军将领的你也很满意。

en: Your first assignment as PLA's commander will be in the Jilin province, our base there is placed at Linjiang. The situation in Manchuria is complex. We need Manchuria for some reasons, first, it's border is close with the USSR and the support we are receiving from the Soviets, and second, Manchuria is the most industrialised area in the whole China, we need the resources from here, and we need to avoid the profits the Kuomingtang can get from here.
zh: 你作为解放军指挥员的第一项任务将在吉林省，我们在那里的基地设在临江。满洲的局势很复杂。我们需要满洲有几个原因：第一，它的边界靠近苏联，也靠近我们正从苏联获得的支援；第二，满洲是全中国工业化程度最高的地区，我们需要这里的资源，也需要防止国民党从中获利。

en: General, deploy your forces along the front lines we have reached in the past months. Be careful, the lines are not safe; althought we are near to Jilin, Changchun and Siping, the KMT forces still keep a strong attack axis near to our base at Linjiang. The mission will be a complete success if you can besiege Changchun and Jilin, and stop the KMT's assault on Linjiang, GRU spies reports our enemies will also try to recapture the section of the Beijing-Changchun railroad, which is also now our main supply line, protect it at any costs!
zh: 将军，把你的部队部署在我们过去几个月抵达的前线上。小心，这些战线并不安全；尽管我们已接近吉林、长春和四平，国民党军队仍在我们的临江基地附近保持着一条强大的进攻轴线。如果你能围困长春和吉林，并阻止国民党对临江的进攻，这次任务就会完全成功，格鲁乌间谍报告说，我们的敌人还会试图夺回北平-长春铁路的路段，那现在也是我们的主要补给线，不惜一切代价保住它！

en: I can't understand your failure commander.  It seems our estimation of your skills were wrong... the central ChCP commission has demoted you to a private for the remainder of the fighting.  This should erase any capitalist bad manners that you may have acquired.
zh: 我无法理解你的失败，指挥官。看来我们对你的能力评估错了...中共中央委员会已把你降为列兵，直到战斗结束。这应当能洗掉你可能沾染上的资本主义坏习气。

en: Thanks to your good work, our base at Linjiang is now safe.  In addition, we are now in a good position to attack Changchun, Jilin and Siping during the next summer offensive.  We will wait for good weather to arrive in Manchuria.
zh: 多亏你出色的工作，我们的临江基地现在安全了。此外，我们现在处于有利地位，可以在下一次夏季攻势中进攻长春、吉林和四平。我们将等待满洲好天气的到来。

en: Thanks to your good work, our base at Linjiang is now safe.  In addition, we are now in a good position to attack Changchun, Jilin and Siping during the next summer offensive.  We will wait for good weather to arrive in Manchuria.
zh: 多亏你出色的工作，我们的临江基地现在安全了。此外，我们现在处于有利地位，可以在下一次夏季攻势中进攻长春、吉林和四平。我们将等待满洲好天气的到来。

en: Congratulations!, Changchun, Jilin and Siping have been captured. This will be a big problem for the Nationalists, since their communications by train or by road from Manchuria to Beijing are now stopped.
zh: 祝贺！长春、吉林和四平已被攻占。这对国民政府将是个大麻烦，因为他们从满洲到北平的铁路和公路交通现在已被切断。

en: Orders from the central ChCP comitte: it's time to capture Changchun, Siping, and Jilin to complete the conquest of Manchuria. The success on this offensive is extremely important, because it would allow us to undertake further penetrations on to Beijing and Nanjing in the next months.
zh: 中共中央委员会的命令：是时候夺取长春、四平和吉林，以完成对满洲的征服了。这次攻势的成功极其重要，因为它将使我们能在接下来几个月进一步向北平、南京推进。

en: It won't be easy, the nationalists still have good units with good equipment, but we count on your elite units to deal with the Kuomingtan troops. The planned Summer Offensive must be victorious.
zh: 这不会容易，国民政府仍拥有装备精良的精锐部队，但我们指望用你的精锐部队来对付国民党军队。计划中的夏季攻势必须获胜。

en: I can't understand your failure commander.  It seems our estimation of your skills were wrong... the central ChCP commission has demoted you to a private for the remainder of the fighting.  This should erase any capitalist bad manners that you may have acquired.
zh: 我无法理解你的失败，指挥官。看来我们对你的能力评估错了...中共中央委员会已把你降为列兵，直到战斗结束。这应当能洗掉你可能沾染上的资本主义坏习气。

en: Congratulations!, Changchun, Jilin and Siping have been captured. This will be a big problem for the Nationalists, since their communications by train or by road from Manchuria to Beijing are now stopped.
zh: 祝贺！长春、吉林和四平已被攻占。这对国民政府将是个大麻烦，因为他们从满洲到北平的铁路和公路交通现在已被切断。

en: Congratulations!, Changchun, Jilin and Siping have been captured. This will be a big problem for the Nationalists, since their communications by train or by road from Manchuria to Beijing are now stopped.
zh: 祝贺！长春、吉林和四平已被攻占。这对国民政府将是个大麻烦，因为他们从满洲到北平的铁路和公路交通现在已被切断。

en: Wan shan!  The KMT have suffered a great defeat.  I'm sure we will be celebrating our victory over Chiang Kai Shek's troops during the coming year of 1948.
zh: 万岁！国民党遭到了一场大败。我相信在即将到来的1948年，我们将庆祝对蒋介石部队的胜利。

en: The KMT troops are badly wounded.  Our victories at Changchun and Siping have decimated their men, commander, and you must put an end to the nationalist resistance in Manchuria.  Your mission is to secure the communications between our base at Siping and our groups in the South, near to Shenyang.  Then you must take Shenyang.  It is the historical Manchurian capital and is both an important industrial and political center.  The capture of Shenyang will open the way to Beijing and Nanjing.
zh: 国民党军队已遭重创。我们在长春和四平的胜利使他们的兵力大减，指挥官，你必须终结国民政府军在满洲的抵抗。你的任务是确保我们四平基地与我们在南方沈阳附近各部队之间的交通线。然后你必须夺取沈阳。它是满洲的历史首府，既是重要的工业中心，也是政治中心。夺取沈阳将打开通往北平与南京的道路。

en: I don't think the snow and the bad weather conditions of the Manchurian Winter will be a major problem for you.
zh: 我认为满洲冬季的大雪和恶劣天气不会成为你的主要问题。

en: I can't understand your failure commander.  It seems our estimation of your skills were wrong... the central ChCP commission has demoted you to a private for the remainder of the fighting.  This should erase any capitalist bad manners that you have acquired.
zh: 我无法理解你的失败，指挥官。看来我们对你的能力评估错了...中共中央委员会已把你降为列兵，直到战斗结束。这应当能洗掉你沾染上的资本主义坏习气。

zh: 万岁！国民党遭到了一场大败。我相信在即将到来的1948年，我们将庆祝对蒋介石部队的胜利。
