zh: 万岁！国民党遭到了一场大败。我相信在即将到来的1948年，我们将庆祝对蒋介石部队的胜利。
乌斯季霍皮奥尔斯卡亚

en: Instead of sending your divisions to Paulus we have decided to send you to this part of the Roumanian sector. Though the Roumanians are tough fighters they do not have any Anti tank capability. You are to secure their positions by integrating your panzerjaeger regiments into their defensive positions.
zh: 我们没有把你的师派往保卢斯那里，而是决定把你派到罗马尼亚防区的这一地段。罗马尼亚人虽然作战顽强，却毫无反坦克能力。你要把你的反坦克歼击团编入他们的防御阵地，以稳固其阵地。
国防军最高统帅部公告：

en: The entire blame for the encicrlement of 6th army is on the general of the 22nd Pz division.
zh: 第6集团军被围的全部责任都在第22装甲师师长身上。

en: We have a disastrous situation on our hands and where it not for you, sixth army would be all but finished now. East of Serafimovitch two Russian corps have broken through the Romanian lines, destroyed three Roumanian divisions, and routed three divisions of Sixth Army. South of Stalingrad the Roumanian fourth army has been annihalated. Though it still holds Kalach, sixth army is surrounded in a perimeter west of Stalingrad, and in a disastrous position.
zh: 我们手上是一个灾难性的局面，要不是你，第6集团军现在几乎就完了。在谢拉菲莫维奇以东，两个俄国军突破了罗马尼亚人的防线，歼灭了三个罗马尼亚师，并击溃了第6集团军的三个师。在斯大林格勒以南，罗马尼亚第4集团军已被全歼。第6集团军虽然仍据守卡拉奇，却已被围在斯大林格勒以西的一个环形阵地中，处境极为不利。

en: We now expect the Russians to poor in troops in order to march on the Chir, be ready for an attack from the east.
zh: 我们现在预计俄国人会大量投入兵力，以便向奇尔河推进，要做好从东面遭到进攻的准备。
乌斯季霍皮奥尔斯卡亚

en: I am glad to hear that you have reshuffeled your positions in order to close the gap in our front. It now runs along an imaginairy line from Serafimovitch to Nizhne Chirskaya and so far, it looks alright with remains of the 1st Roumanian Pz supporting Axis troops holding the southern part.
zh: 很高兴得知你已调整了阵地，封住了我们正面的缺口。这条战线现在沿着从谢拉菲莫维奇到下奇尔斯卡亚的一条假想线延伸，目前看来还不错，罗马尼亚第1装甲师残部协同轴心国部队守住了南段。

en: We have however indications from General Richthofen that large formations, probably the Soviet first guard corps are on their way east to your sector. So, be on your guard against an attack from the east as well as a renewed attack from the north !
zh: 不过，我们从里希特霍芬将军那里得到迹象表明，庞大的编队——很可能是苏联近卫第1军——正向东开往你的战区。因此，你要警惕来自东面的进攻，也要警惕北面再次发起的进攻！

en: It is with great sadness that I must tell you the commander of the 22 nd Pz has died
zh: 我非常悲痛地必须告诉您，第22装甲师师长已经阵亡

en: You have again stopped very powerfull forces attempting to conquer your positions ! Meanwhile, Manstein has moved up troops and armoured divisions to launch a counterattack that will decide the fait of sixth army and with it the future of our empire.
zh: 您再次挡住了试图攻占您阵地的强大敌军！与此同时，曼施坦因已调上部队与装甲师，即将发动一场反攻，此战将决定第六集团军的命运，也决定我们帝国的未来。

en: We thought it sensible to let your battered troops stay put for a few days. After that you will have to move to the Italian sector of the front to stand in for the armoured division that participates in our counteroffensive
zh: 我们认为让您疲惫的部队原地休整数日是明智之举。此后您必须转移到意军防区，去接替那支参加我军反攻的装甲师

en: Thanks to your heroic resistance we were able to reach Kalach. We have started a huge evacuation of Stalingrad and initiated the retreat of the Caucasus army.
zh: 多亏您的英勇抵抗，我们才得以抵达卡拉奇。我们已开始大规模撤离斯大林格勒，并着手让高加索集团军后撤。

en: 1942 has been a bad year for our campaign. Clearly the Russians have suffered greater losses than we did, but we did not achieve the strategic victory we need. Where it not for you and your brave men however, we would have suffered a strategic defeat.
zh: 1942年对我们的战局而言是糟糕的一年。俄军的损失显然比我军更大，但我们并未取得所需的战略性胜利。然而若不是您和您勇敢的部下，我们早已遭受一场战略失败。

en: We have tranferred you to the quiet Italian part of the front. Your assignment is the same as you had with the Roumanians; providing them with the anti-tank capability they lack. We have sent the Italians lots of Bohler guns that are obsolete, but may be better than nothing.
zh: 我们已将您调往意军驻守的平静地段。您的任务与在罗马尼亚军那里时相同：为他们提供所缺乏的反坦克能力。我们已给意大利人送去大量过时的博勒火炮，但聊胜于无。

en: The fuehrer is furious with you, I suggest you hide yourself
zh: 元首对您极为震怒，我建议您躲起来

en: Sadly sixth army and the Caucasus army were not able to hold on to the eastern Don bend. Mussolini will be glad that you saved his obsolete 8th army, but for the strategic situation this won't matter:
zh: 遗憾的是第六集团军与高加索集团军未能守住顿河河曲东部。墨索里尼会为您救下他过时的第八集团军而高兴，但对战略态势而言这无关紧要：

en: Unfortunately, to the north of your forces, the Russians have broken through the lines and destroyed the Hungarian second army. We have no choice but to retreat to the Donetz.
zh: 不幸的是，在您部队以北，俄军已突破防线并歼灭了匈牙利第二集团军。我们别无选择，只能退往顿涅茨。

en: You seem to be very talented in working with our allies. You will go to Bucharest and Rome to pick up some medals, your troops will go to Italy to assure us of Italian loyalty, and to prepare its defence.
zh: 您似乎很擅长与我们的盟友打交道。您将前往布加勒斯特和罗马领取几枚勋章，您的部队将开赴意大利，以确保意大利的忠诚并筹备其防务。
第75团/第97反坦克营/3月2日师

en: It's a shame that not all of your divisions where send to Sicily straight away. Now fortifications are not as good as they could have been, but I hope they will help somewhat. Reports indicate a large invasion is taking place, in view of our supply situation you are to attack as soon as possible.
zh: 遗憾的是并非您所有师都立即被派往西西里。如今工事不如本可建成的那样坚固，但我希望它们多少能派上用场。报告显示一场大规模登陆正在进行，鉴于我方补给状况，您须尽快发起进攻。

en: The fuehrer is furious with you, I suggest you hide yourself
zh: 元首对您极为震怒，我建议您躲起来
三号突击炮F/H型/赫尔曼·戈林师

en: With 8th army crushed we now only have three American bridgeheads left on Sicily. Two of these have linked up. So far we have been able to contain these by retreating to hills out of range of the naval artillery barrage.
zh: 第八集团军既已被击溃，我们在西西里如今只剩三个美军桥头堡。其中两个已连成一片。迄今为止我们退守到海军舰炮射程之外的山地，得以将其遏制。

en: With your support we should now be able to attack and crush the Americans. If you are victorious the threat of a new allied invasion of Italy will be gone for at least half a year, meaning we can redeploy your troops elsewhere.
zh: 有了您的支援，我们现在应当能够进攻并击溃美军。若您获胜，盟军再次入侵意大利的威胁将至少在半年内消失，这意味着我们可以把您的部队调往他处。

en: The fuehrer is furious with you, I suggest you hide yourself
zh: 元首对您极为震怒，我建议您躲起来

en: The main part of the American 7 th army is destroyed, and already messages are coming in that they are evacuating their last bridgehead near Licata. In a few weeks the whole strategic situation in the Mediterrenean has changed beyond recognition. We will now change Sicily into an inassailabe fortress.
zh: 美军第七集团军主力已被歼灭，而且已有消息传来，他们正在撤离利卡塔附近的最后一个桥头堡。数周之内，地中海的整体战略态势将变得面目全非。我们现在要把西西里变成一座无法攻克的堡垒。

en: On the political side this victory has stabilised Mussolini's regime a bit, but we are looking for a more competent replacement in the facsist movement. However, real power in Italy is in our hands now. In a few weeks we will take charge of militairy production and rearmement in Italy, meaning Italian industry will produce German arms. Paralel to the rearmement of the Italian army a few thousand advisors will retrain the army.
zh: 在政治层面上，这场胜利稍稍稳住了墨索里尼的政权，但我们正在法西斯运动中物色一个更能干的替代者。不过，意大利的实权如今已掌握在我们手中。数周之内我们将接管意大利的军事生产与重整军备，这意味着意大利工业将生产德国武器。在意大利军队重整军备的同时，数千名顾问将重新训练这支军队。
克拉斯诺阿尔梅伊斯克

en: From the beginning their were a lot of doubts about operation Zitadelle. At first we delayed it for a few weeks in order to solve some of the mechanical problems our new tanks suffered. Then we heard of the great success of our forces in Sicily and decided to call the operation off, and decided to send some of the Panzer divisions against the offensive the Russians started in the south on July 17.
zh: 从一开始，人们对"堡垒"行动就疑虑重重。起初我们为排除新式坦克的某些机械故障而将其推迟了数周。随后我们得知我军在西西里大获成功，于是决定取消该行动，并决定抽调部分装甲师去对付俄军7月17日在南线发起的攻势。

en: Now the Russians have started a great offensive of their own to capture Belgorod. We are forced to commit our Panzers there. The Soviets also started a smaller offenisive to the east of Charkov. Your XXII Pz div is to stop this at all costs.
zh: 现在俄军已发起他们自己的大规模攻势，企图夺取别尔哥罗德。我们被迫把装甲部队投入那里。苏军还在哈尔科夫以东发动了一场规模较小的攻势。您的第22装甲师须不惜一切代价阻止它。

en: At first we thought the invasion of Crete was a goal in itself. Only meant to secure mediterrenean shipping, and to establish an airbase for bombarding Ploesti. Clearly this was not the case: it seems the western allies feel they are not strong enough yet to invade France and have therefore choosen first to gain a foothold in the Balkans that will tie up some of our forces and secure their influence there.
zh: 起初我们以为入侵克里特岛本身就是目的，只是为确保地中海航运安全，并为轰炸普洛耶什蒂建立一个空军基地。显然并非如此：看来西方盟国觉得自身还不够强大，尚不足以入侵法国，因此选择先在巴尔干取得立足点，以牵制我们部分兵力并确保其在那里的影响力。

en: Your orders are to throw the landings on the southern Pelloponese back into the sea. However, a massive airlanding near Corinth threatens to cut of your supply lines. I secretly but urgently advise you to give up your positions in the South and to throw everything you have against these paratroopers. An escape to Attica is your best option.
zh: 您的命令是把伯罗奔尼撒半岛南部的登陆部队赶下海去。然而，一场在科林斯附近的大规模机降正威胁切断您的补给线。我私下但紧急地建议您放弃南部阵地，把您手头的一切都投向这些伞兵。撤往阿提卡是您最好的选择。

en: I think it would be good to place an article in the Volkischer Beobachter stating that the general of the XXII Pz division died while commanding his tanks in the front line.
zh: 我认为最好在《人民观察家报》上刊登一篇文章，称第22装甲师师长在前线指挥坦克作战时阵亡。

en: It is only through the direct intervention of Marshall Rommel that the fuehrer did not fire you straight away. He seems to have somehow convinced him that attacking the paratroopers and thus allowing the allies to gain a large bridgehead in the south was your only option. In this way we gained a small victory but lost the Peloponese.
zh: 全凭隆美尔元帅直接出面干预，元首才没有立即将您撤职。他似乎设法让元首相信，进攻伞兵从而让盟军得以在南部取得一个宽阔桥头堡，是您唯一的选择。如此我们赢得了一场小胜，却丢掉了伯罗奔尼撒半岛。

en: Loehr wil now begin to regroup our forces and start a fighting retreat that will probably only end north of Thermopylae. We could off course try to keep the Corinth Canal,but that would expose us to naval gunfire, and be far to dangerous. It is rumoued that your troops, that are not needed in this strategy, will be transferred to France.
zh: 勒尔现在将着手重整我们的部队，开始一场且战且退的撤退，这场撤退大概只会在温泉关以北才告结束。我们当然可以试着守住科林斯运河，但那会使我们暴露在舰炮火力之下，实在太危险。有传言说，这场战略中并不需要的您的部队将被调往法国。

en: Herr General, the enemy is making an attempt to break out of the encirclement in Normandy around the key city of Avranches. Your orders are to move swiftly and prevent this outbreak.
zh: 将军阁下，敌军正试图在诺曼底从阿夫朗什这座关键城市附近的包围圈中突围。您的命令是迅速行动，阻止这次突围。

en: I think it would be good to place an article in the Volkischer Beobachter stating that the general of the XXII Pz division died while commanding his tanks in the front line.
zh: 我认为最好在《人民观察家报》上刊登一篇文章，称第22装甲师师长在前线指挥坦克作战时阵亡。

en: Your 22nd Pz has suceeded, but the 21st Pz has failed, the allies now have an uninterrupted bridgehead from Isigny to the Orne. It is quite clear they had hoped to have Cherbourg as a harbour, but your bold actions have prevented that. However, there is no chance whatsoever that we can drive hem back into the sea now.
zh: 您的第22装甲师成功了，但第21装甲师失败了，盟军如今拥有从伊西尼到奥恩河一线连绵不断的桥头堡。很明显他们本希望把瑟堡作为港口，但您的果敢行动使其未能得逞。然而，我们现在已毫无可能把他们赶下海去。

en: It would be best to retreat across the Seine, but the Fuehrer has ordered that we have to take a stand here as long as possible.
zh: 最好是退过塞纳河，但元首已下令我们必须在此地尽可能长久地坚守。

en: The Americans have launched a full scale offensive across the Vire. You will counterattack, restore the situation and make sure we keep St. Lo.
zh: 美国人已全线发起横渡维尔河的攻势。您将实施反突击，恢复态势，并确保我们守住圣洛。

en: I think it would be good to place an article in the Volkischer Beobachter stating that the general of the XXII Pz division died while commanding his tanks in the front line.
zh: 我认为最好在《人民观察家报》上刊登一篇文章，称第22装甲师师长在前线指挥坦克作战时阵亡。

en: Thank god you managed to restore the situation and kept up the morale.
zh: 谢天谢地，您设法恢复了态势并维持住了士气。

en: The situation is as follows: As you know Hitler has died of a bomb blast in the Wolfsschanze and the army has performed a coup d'etat. General Beck, the old chief of staff has become head of state, marshall Von Witzleben commander in chief, and the parliament of 1933 including the communists has been called back. Becoming chancellor Herr Speer has played an admirable role in the whole affair winning over a lot of officials to the new order.
zh: 情况如下：如您所知，希特勒已在狼穴死于炸弹爆炸，陆军已发动政变。原总参谋长贝克将军已出任国家元首，冯·维茨莱本元帅任总司令，1933年的国会（包括共产党人在内）已被重新召集。出任总理的施佩尔先生在整个事件中表现令人钦佩，为新的秩序争取到了许多官员。

en: We will now run this war in the only sensible way. This means we will retreat to the Seine, and concentrate all efforts on making an honourable peace.
zh: 我们现在将以唯一明智的方式打这场战争。这意味着我们将退往塞纳河，并把全部努力集中于缔结一项体面的和平。

en: Pretty soon we came to the conclusion that the Seine was also not suitable terrain for defense and such terrain will only be found along the Meuse and the Belgian border. We have clear indications that the Americans are planning an offensive in the direction of Nancy. You are to rush to the aid of the defenders there.
zh: 我们很快就得出结论：塞纳河同样不是适合防御的地形，这类地形只有在默兹河与比利时边境一线才能找到。我们有明确迹象表明，美国人正计划向南锡方向发起攻势。您须火速前往支援那里的守军。

en: The defense of Nancy is very important right now. President Beck is desperately trying to make peace with the western allies. In order to attain this he has permitted the Italians, the Bulgarians and the Finns to get out of the war, and has withdrawn from Greece. At this moment secret negotiations are taking place in Spain: though Churchill is still insisting on an unconditional surrender he is the only one receiving our envoy.
zh: 当前保卫南锡至关重要。贝克总统正拼命设法与西方盟国媾和。为此他已允许意大利、保加利亚和芬兰退出战争，并已从希腊撤军。此刻在西班牙正在进行秘密谈判：尽管丘吉尔仍坚持无条件投降，但他是唯一接见我方使者的人。

en: This is probably also the background to the American offensive: The Americans are afraid the English might waver and hope to win before the English get serious about peace.
zh: 这大概也是美军攻势的背景：美国人担心英国人会动摇，希望在英国人认真对待和平之前取胜。

en: I think it would be good to place an article in the Volkischer Beobachter stating that the general of the XXII Pz division died while commanding his tanks in the front line.
zh: 我认为最好在《人民观察家报》上刊登一篇文章，称第22装甲师师长在前线指挥坦克作战时阵亡。

en: This is a very important victory, though we lost further south, and your position has thus become untennable, we are giving the allies the impression that the road to Germany is still very long. The downside of things is that in the east we had to retreat to the Weichsel and the Prut.
zh: 这是一场非常重要的胜利。尽管我们在更南面失利，您的阵地也因此变得无法坚守，但我们正让盟国产生这样的印象：通往德国的道路依然十分漫长。不利的一面是，在东线我们不得不退往维斯瓦河和普鲁特河。

en: Meanwhile it has become quite clear that England is no longer a great power. They are bound hand and feet to the Americans, that still insist on an unconditional surrender.
zh: 与此同时，已经十分清楚的是，英国不再是一个大国。它已被美国人牢牢捆住手脚，而美国人仍坚持无条件投降。

en: The Americans are quite hard-headed; after their bloody nose at Nancy they are probably planning an assault on our fortress city of Metz. You are to stop them at all costs.
zh: 美国人相当顽固；在南锡碰得头破血流之后，他们大概正计划进攻我们的要塞城市梅斯。您须不惜一切代价阻止他们。

en: The British however seem more and more inclined to peace after their defeat at Arnhem.......
zh: 不过英国人在阿纳姆战败之后，似乎越来越倾向于和平……

en: I think it would be good to place an article in the FAZ stating that the general of the XXII Pz division died while commanding his tanks in the front line.
zh: 我认为最好在《法兰克福汇报》上刊登一篇文章，称第22装甲师师长在前线指挥坦克作战时阵亡。

en: You have again dealt a blow to the Americans, but they still refuse to receive our envoy. We have however been able to influence the American press to write about our peace offer, and a debate has started in America.
zh: 您再次给美国人以重击，但他们仍拒绝接见我方的使者。不过我们已能影响美国报界刊登我方的和平提议，美国国内也掀起了一场辩论。

en: Also while you were busy, a revolt has broken out in Warschau. Clearly the goal is to establish an independent state before the Soviets enter Warschau. We will see what the English think of it.
zh: 另外，就在您忙于作战之时，华沙爆发了起义。其目标显然是在苏军进入华沙之前建立一个独立国家。我们就看英国人对此作何想法。

en: And the English are thinking a lot: The fact the we agreed that Romania may break our alliance, but that the Soviets refuse peace with Romania and insist on the occupation of Romania has brought Soviet-allied relations to the point of rupture. We have allready noticed a big decline in English bombers over Germany.
zh: 而英国人确实想了很多：我们同意罗马尼亚可以退出我们的同盟，但苏军拒绝与罗马尼亚媾和并坚持占领罗马尼亚，这一事实已使苏联与盟国的关系濒临破裂。我们已注意到英格兰轰炸机飞临德国的数量大幅下降。

en: We are taking measures to make the American public sick of this war. We started a big offensive towards Liege and get in the back of the American 1st and 9th armies near Aachen.
zh: 我们正在设法让美国公众对这场战争感到厌倦。我们已向列日方向发起一场大规模攻势，插到亚琛附近美国第1、第9集团军的后方。

en: Now that the Americans are off-balance, you are to attack in Alsace, conquer Strassbourg and generally inflict heavy casualties on the Americans. The 17th SS has already moved from Metz and is also at your disposal.
zh: 既然美国人已乱了阵脚，您就要在阿尔萨斯发起进攻，攻占斯特拉斯堡，并大量杀伤美军。党卫军第17师已从梅斯调出，也归您指挥。

en: Though it cost us some of our last reserves, we have inflicted two considerable defeats on the Americans. Now political opponents of Rooseveld, sustained by the anti-communist movement, have forced the American government to receive our envoy!
zh: 尽管这消耗了我们最后一部分预备队，我们已让美国人遭受了两次相当重大的失败。如今罗斯福的政治对手在反共运动的支持下，已迫使美国政府接见我方的使者！

en: Also we got our peace-offer: the 1937 borders, public in the US press, and announced that, as a sign of good will, we will immediately retreat from Belgium and France. We might still have a chance to split the coalition apart....
zh: 而且我们的和平提议：1937年的边界，已刊登在美国报端，我们还宣布，作为善意的表示，我们将立即从比利时和法国撤退。我们或许仍有机会拆散这个联盟……

en: You are now to retreat from Alsace and go to the east.
zh: 您现在要从阿尔萨斯撤退，向东转移。
杜克尔斯基山口（杜克拉山口）
第2捷克斯洛伐克伞兵旅

en: Next to the open debate about the continuation of the war in the House of Commons, the public debate in the American press about the need to continue the war has become very intense since the Italian press sighted Rommel and an American diplomat on lake Garda.
zh: 除了下议院关于是否继续战争的公开辩论之外，自从意大利报界在加尔达湖拍到隆美尔与一名美国外交官之后，美国报界关于是否有必要继续这场战争的公开辩论也变得十分激烈。

en: The Soviets now have serious suspisions that we are talking to the Americans. We therefore expect the Soviets to make an all out effort to capture terrain before we can make peace in the west.
zh: 苏联人现在严重怀疑我们正在与美国人谈判。因此我们预计，苏军将全力以赴，力求在我们与西方缔结和平之前夺取更多地盘。

en: The Dukla pass is one of the few roads into Slowakia. You are to defend it at all costs.
zh: 杜克拉山口是通往斯洛伐克的少数几条道路之一。您须不惜一切代价守住它。

en: I think it would be good to place an article in the FAZ stating that the general of the XXII Pz division died while commanding his tanks in the front line.
zh: 我认为最好在《法兰克福汇报》上刊登一篇文章，称第22装甲师师长在前线指挥坦克作战时阵亡。

en: You valliantly kept your positions, but on the Weichsel and the Prut we were beaten, Soviet troops are streaming into Romania, and have attacked Bulgaria.
zh: 您英勇地守住了阵地，但在维斯瓦河和普鲁特河一线我们被打败了，苏军正涌入罗马尼亚，并已进攻保加利亚。

en: The attack on neutral Bulgaria proved a blessing for us: The Bulgarian government invited the English in and on the outskirts of Sofia these violently clashed with the Soviet troops. This was all the incident Churchill needed: the case of Bulgaria was blown up in the Anglo-American press, and thus came about the cease-fire with the western allies you undoubtedly heard of.
zh: 对中立国保加利亚的进攻结果反倒成了我们的幸事：保加利亚政府把英国人请了进来，在索菲亚近郊他们与苏军发生了激烈冲突。这正是丘吉尔所需要的事件：保加利亚事件在英美报界被大肆渲染，于是便有了您无疑已听说过的与西方盟国的停火。

en: You will now hurry to Berlin to prepare the final battle
zh: 您现在要赶往柏林，准备最后一场战斗

en: For a moment we succeeded in stopping the Soviets here, at the Lodz line. However, the Soviets have broken through north and south of you.
zh: 我们曾一度在这里，即罗兹一线挡住了苏军。然而，苏军已在您南北两翼突破。

en: Thus a pocket could soon be formed around your troops. You are to take your corps, brake out of Lodz and stop the Russians at the Warta river, which will be or next temporary line of defense before the Posen line. By the way: It would be wise to move along the railroad to Sieradz because the Russians from the northern pincer may soon swing around Lodz.
zh: 这样，一个包围圈很快就会在您部队周围形成。您须率您的军从罗兹突围，并在瓦尔塔河阻止俄军，那将是我们继波兹南防线之前的下一道临时防线。顺便说一句：沿着铁路向谢拉兹移动是明智之举，因为北面那支俄军钳形部队可能很快就会绕过罗兹。

en: It is very sad, but may be we can win the war without him..
zh: 这非常令人悲痛，但也许我们没有他也能赢得这场战争……

en: You restored some semblance of order, but still further south the situation is disastrous, you will now withdraw along the Warta to Frankfurt a/d Oder as soon as possible. Maybe we can still stop the Soviets with our troops arriving from the west.
zh: 您恢复了一些秩序，但更南面的局势仍是灾难性的，您现在要沿瓦尔塔河尽快撤往奥得河畔法兰克福。也许我们还能靠从西面赶来的部队挡住苏军。

en: There is also a ray of hope: since our cease-fire with the west the synthetic oil production has picked up surprisingly fast, and more and more new jet plains are batteling for the skies over Silesia.
zh: 还有一线希望：自从我们与西方停火以来，合成油产量回升得出奇地快，越来越多的新式喷气式飞机正在西里西亚上空争夺制空权。

en: The Russians position can be characterised as a big wedge with Pommerania to the north of it, and Silesia south of it. You are to start a slow attack on the head of it. In the mean time we will transfer large formations of new panzers to Silesia and Pommerania. These wil then march on the besieged city of Posen, and trap the Whiterussian front.
zh: 俄军的态势可以形容为一个巨大的楔子，其北面是波美拉尼亚，南面是西里西亚。您要对这个楔子的头部发起缓慢进攻。与此同时，我们将把大批新式装甲部队调往西里西亚和波美拉尼亚。它们随后将向被围的波兹南城进军，并合围白俄罗斯方面军。

en: It is very sad, but may be we can win the war without him..
zh: 这非常令人悲痛，但也许我们没有他也能赢得这场战争……

en: It worked! While your attack across the Oder sucked away Russian forces, several panzer corps have marched on Posen and encircled Zjoekov's White Russian front with half a million soldiers!
zh: 成功了！当您横渡奥得河的进攻吸走俄军兵力之时，数个装甲军已向波兹南进军，将朱可夫的白俄罗斯方面军连同五十万士兵一起包围了！

en: The Russians have agreed to an armistice.

zh: 恭喜！敌军守备部队已被您光荣的部队击溃。如今达尔文将成为我们在这个国家的滩头阵地。请做好准备，继续向南挺进。

en: Welcome to the Gohoku region.  The big allied base on this country must be removed if we want to secure our Empire.  Although our reports inform us that the area of Darwin is fortified, the surrounding areas are a desert; it seems the Australians have evacuated the population and some facilities to the inner part of the country.  With your troops clear Darwin and establish a beach head to allow further penetrations into Australia.
zh: 欢迎来到濠北地区。若要确保帝国安全，就必须拔除盟军在这个国家的大型基地。尽管我方情报显示达尔文一带筑有工事，但周边地区都是荒漠；看来澳大利亚人已把居民和部分设施撤往内陆。请率部肃清达尔文，建立一个滩头阵地，以便进一步向澳大利亚内陆挺进。

en: Fantastic!  The Australians have been defeated, and now, our Co-prosperity Sphere will cover all the islands of the South Pacific!  Oh, excuse me.  This is my friend, Kenosuke Sato, the new governor of Australia.  I know he is the ruler the Australians need... [malefic laugh again]
zh: 太棒了！澳大利亚人已被打败，如今我们的大东亚共荣圈将覆盖整个南太平洋的岛屿！哦，失礼了。这位是我的朋友佐藤健之助，新任澳大利亚总督。我知道他正是澳大利亚人所需要的统治者……[再次发出恶毒的笑声]
澳大利亚攻略战 - 阿德莱德

en: We have crossed Australia, without any significant resistance, just some kangaroos in the dirty roads of this country hahaha!  Well, now we think the Australians are planning to use the majority of their troops to protect their southeast corner where their major important cities and bases are located:  Adelaide, Sidney, Brisbane or Canberra for example.  Your mission is to get Adelaide.  This will completely cut Australia in two.  Meanwhile, disembark some troops from the sea against Brisbane and Sidney to keep the remainder of Australian troops busy.  Our brave navy will also be here in the Adelaide sector to help you deal with the enemy.
zh: 我们已横穿澳大利亚，没有遇到任何像样的抵抗，只有这国家泥泞道路上的几只袋鼠，哈哈哈！好，现在我们认为澳大利亚人正打算用其大部分兵力保卫他们东南角，那里有他们最重要的城市和基地：例如阿德莱德、悉尼、布里斯班或堪培拉。您的任务是攻取阿德莱德。这将把澳大利亚彻底切成两半。同时，从海上派兵登陆布里斯班和悉尼，以牵制澳大利亚其余部队。我们英勇的海军也将出现在阿德莱德方向，协助您对付敌人。

en: Nice, really nice general.  The communist troops have been completely defeated by your quick action.  I hope the problems with the guerrillas of the ChCP are finished for a long time.  Congratulations! You have been awarded with the Order of the Golden Kite 1st class.
zh: 好，真的很好，将军。共军已被您的迅速行动彻底击败。我希望中国共产党游击队的麻烦在很长一段时间内已经了结。恭喜！您已被授予一等金鵄勋章。

en: Excuse me, General.  I was talking with the commander from our garrison in Shouzhou.  He was calling for help.  By the looks of it, the communist Chinese guerrillas have begun a coordinated offensive in the North of China.  It is against some important industrial centers, communication lines, and of course, against the coal mines present on this sector.  Your mission is to advance to Shouzhou and save the garrison.  Unfortunately, the garrison at Datong, an important crossroads and railroad center in the North, has lost control of that town.  It is now being controlled by the guerrillas.  Retake Datong and you will be able to use the train to deploy more troops.  Then clear the area of enemy guerrillas.  The intelligence reports indicate that the enemy troops are mainly the units from the communist ''8th Route Army'', from Mao and his boys.
zh: 失礼了，将军。我刚才在和我们朔州守备队的指挥官通话。他在求援。看来中国共产党游击队已在中国北方发起一场协同攻势。其目标是一些重要的工业中心、交通线，当然还有本地区的煤矿。您的任务是向朔州推进，救出守备队。遗憾的是，北方一处重要交通枢纽和铁路中心大同的守备队已失去对该城的控制。该城现由游击队控制。夺回大同，您就能利用铁路投送更多部队。然后肃清该地区的敌军游击队。情报报告显示，敌军部队主要是来自毛及其部下的中国共产党"八路军"。

en: So, CLEAR this area of any Chinese soldiers and General, I'm starting to hate the Chinese!
zh: 所以，把这地区的中国士兵都肃清掉，将军，我开始讨厌中国人了！

Congratulations!  You have been awarded with the Order of the Golden Kite 3rd class, it is not a high decoration, but Congratulations anyway.
zh: 好，真的很好，将军。共军已被您的迅速行动彻底击败。我希望中国共产党游击队的麻烦在很长一段时间内已经了结。恭喜！您已被授予三等金鵄勋章，这不是很高的勋赏，但还是要恭喜您。

Since our devastating attack on Pearl Harbour the United Kingdom has declared war on us.  The presence of their two european outposts - the portuguese Macao and british Hong Kong are a problem. Up to now, our main objective here is to crush the chinese resistance, just attack the european positions if you are able to do it, otherwise, focus your efforts on the chinese troops only.
zh: 欢迎您，并祝贺您出任本战区的新任指挥官。请允许我说明当前形势。我们正从北方压迫中国军队，并在广州拥有稳固的基地。自从我们对珍珠港发动毁灭性袭击以来，英国已向我们宣战。他们的两处欧洲前哨——葡属澳门和英属香港——的存在是个麻烦。到目前为止，我们在此的主要目标是粉碎中国的抵抗，只有在您有能力时才进攻欧洲人的阵地，否则就只把力量集中在中国军队身上。

en: We need to solve it quickly, otherwise the enemy will have a possible beach head  in our backyard.
zh: 我们必须迅速解决此事，否则敌人就可能在我们的后院获得一个登陆场。

en: General, your troops must quickly defeat our enemies!
zh: 将军，您的部队必须迅速击败我们的敌人！

en: Hong Kong and Macao are in our hands and the chinese armies deployed around our base of Canton have been defeated.  The chinese and their the allies will no longer be a problem to our continued advance into Asia.
zh: 香港和澳门已落入我们手中，部署在我们广州基地周围的中国军队也已被击败。中国及其盟国将不再是我们继续向亚洲推进的障碍。

en: Hong Kong and Macao are in our hands and the chinese armies deployed around our base of Canton have been defeated.  The chinese and their the allies will no longer be a problem to our continued advance into Asia.
zh: 香港和澳门已落入我们手中，部署在我们广州基地周围的中国军队也已被击败。中国及其盟国将不再是我们继续向亚洲推进的障碍。

en: Migoto!!!  The Chinese forces have suffered a decisive defeat; thousands of enemy units are surrendering to us!  They haven't another choice since their rearguard is blocked by our troops.  Only some pockets of resistance remain in the middle of China, but all their communications with the allies have been cut.
zh: 漂亮！！！中国军队已遭受决定性失败；成千上万的敌军部队正向我们投降！他们别无选择，因为他们的后方已被我军封锁。中国腹地只剩下少数几处抵抗据点，但他们与盟国的一切联系都已被切断。

en: After the fall of Burma, the British will be busy for a long time! hahaha.  The Burma Road will no longer be the life line for our old Chinese enemies.  The Chinese supplies are running out quickly and now it's time to begin the end for the Chinese campaign at once.  We should take advantage of this opportunity!  Your mission is to capture Kunming, one of the latest supply depots the Chinese still hold.  This won't be easy because the mountain terrain will allow the dirty Chinese to ambush us every step of the way, but we count on you once again to complete this mission.
zh: 缅甸陷落之后，英国人将有很长时间忙不过来！哈哈哈。滇缅公路将不再是我们这些中国老对手的生命线。中国的补给正迅速耗尽，现在是立刻着手结束中国战役的时候了。我们应当利用这个机会！您的任务是夺取昆明，那是中国仍然掌握的最后几个补给基地之一。这不会容易，因为山地地形会让卑鄙的中国人一路伏击我们，但我们再次指望您来完成这项任务。

en: Migoto!!!  The Chinese forces have suffered a decisive defeat; thousands of enemy units are surrendering to us!  They haven't another choice since their rearguard is blocked by our troops.  Only some pockets of resistance remain in the middle of China, but all their communications with the allies have been cut.
zh: 漂亮！！！中国军队已遭受决定性失败；成千上万的敌军部队正向我们投降！他们别无选择，因为他们的后方已被我军封锁。中国腹地只剩下少数几处抵抗据点，但他们与盟国的一切联系都已被切断。

en: Migoto!!!   The Chinese forces have suffered a decisive defeat; thousands of enemy units are surrendering to us!  They haven't another choice since their rearguard is blocked by our troops.  Only some pockets of resistance remain in the middle of China, but all their communications with the allies have been cut.
zh: 漂亮！！！中国军队已遭受决定性失败；成千上万的敌军部队正向我们投降！他们别无选择，因为他们的后方已被我军封锁。中国腹地只剩下少数几处抵抗据点，但他们与盟国的一切联系都已被切断。

en: General, your actions have been decisive!  A huge number of enemy units have been trapped, and the enemy resistance is being defeated in all sectors.  Our surprise and surgical strikes have given the Chinese what they deserved, Defeat!
zh: 将军，您的行动起到了决定性作用！大量敌军部队陷入重围，敌军在各处的抵抗正被逐一粉碎。我们的奇袭与精准打击让中国人得到了他们应得的东西——失败！

en: You are again needed for and important mission; you are our best general here in China. The Burmese front remains quiet, and we need your leadership on this mission.  The morale of our men is really low in China, the constant retreats, and attacks have had a negative effect, and we need a decisive victory.  Your task is to seize the city of Changteh.  If we can get all our goals in this ambitious operation, we will be able to do further penetrations into the Chinese heartland, and possibly to end the war in China...
zh: 又有一项重要任务需要您出马；您是我们在中国最好的将军。缅甸战线依旧平静，我们需要您来领导这次任务。我们在中国的部队士气十分低落，不断的撤退与进攻带来了消极影响，我们需要一场决定性的胜利。您的任务是夺取常德城。如果这次雄心勃勃的作战能达成全部目标，我们就能进一步向中国腹地渗透，甚至可能结束在中国的战事……

en: Kuso!, we couldn't stop the chinese retreat, and our troops are not in any condition to continue pursuing them.
zh: 可恶！我们没能阻止中国人的撤退，我军也已无力继续追击。

en: General, your actions have been decisive!  A huge number of enemy units have been trapped, and the enemy resistance is being defeated in all sectors.  Our surprise and surgical strikes have given the Chinese what they deserved, Defeat!
zh: 将军，您的行动起到了决定性作用！大量敌军部队陷入重围，敌军在各处的抵抗正被逐一粉碎。我们的奇袭与精准打击让中国人得到了他们应得的东西——失败！

en: General, your actions have been decisive!  A huge number of enemy units have been trapped, and the enemy resistance is being defeated in all sectors.  Our surprise and surgical strikes have given the Chinese what they deserved, Defeat!
zh: 将军，您的行动起到了决定性作用！大量敌军部队陷入重围，敌军在各处的抵抗正被逐一粉碎。我们的奇袭与精准打击让中国人得到了他们应得的东西——失败！

en: After these 7 long years of war, our long awaited objective is now near; the complete conquest of China, and the unconditional surrender of all the Chinese forces.  Although we eliminated their supply lines some time ago, their new capital, Chongqing is still resisting our assaults.  Your mission is simply to take the enemy capital, without taking into account the losses; we must defeat the Chinese at all costs!
zh: 经过这漫长的七年战争，我们期盼已久的目标如今近在眼前：彻底征服中国，迫使中国所有军队无条件投降。虽然我们此前已切断了他们的补给线，但其新首都重庆仍在抵抗我们的进攻。您的任务很简单，就是拿下敌军首都，不必计较损失；我们必须不惜一切代价打败中国人！

en: General, you have achieved our highest goal; the unconditional surrender of Chiang-Kai-Shek!   Seven years of bloody battles have come at an enormous price.  All the resources and other supplies from China will be now included in the Co-Prosperity Sphere!  Omedetogozaimasu!
zh: 将军，您实现了我们的最高目标：蒋介石无条件投降！七年血战付出了极其惨重的代价。中国的全部资源与其他物资如今都将纳入共荣圈！恭喜！

en: General, you have achieved our highest goal; the unconditional surrender of Chiang-Kai-Shek!   Seven years of bloody battles have come at an enormous price.  All the resources and other supplies from China will be now included in the Co-Prosperity Sphere!  Omedetogozaimasu!
zh: 将军，您实现了我们的最高目标：蒋介石无条件投降！七年血战付出了极其惨重的代价。中国的全部资源与其他物资如今都将纳入共荣圈！恭喜！
哈伊拉斯廷河（哈伊拉斯廷河）

en: Welcome to Manchukuo commander. The Kwantung army high command has requested to Tokyo your presence here, since you are the best officer to face the Soviets due to your past experience at Korea.
zh: 欢迎来到满洲国，指挥官。关东军高层已向东京请求调您来此，因为您过去在朝鲜的经历使您成为对付苏联人的最佳人选。

en: We are involved at the Mongol-Manchu border into a fierce fight agaisnt Soviet and Mongol troops since March, as the Soviets continues refusing to recognise the true boundaries of Jap... err of our Manchukuoan allies. The Soviets have massed an enormous force at the West bank of the Khalkhin Gol river to retake the vicitinies of the Nomonhan village. What the Kwantung army wants from you, is to deploy your command there, and face the Soviets. Your skills, probably will be the solution for this new... incident.
zh: 自3月以来，我们与苏联和蒙古军队在满蒙边境陷入了激战，因为苏联人始终拒绝承认日……呃，承认我们满洲国盟友的真正边界。苏联人已在哈拉哈河（哈拉哈河）西岸集结了庞大兵力，企图夺回诺门罕村的失地。关东军希望您做的，就是把您的部队部署到那里，去面对苏联人。您的本领，或许正是解决这场新……事件的办法。

en: The soviet horde has been destroyed, and now our manchukoan allies can sleep well, without the red menace from the West. Emperor Pu-Yi sends you his congrats.
zh: 苏联大军已被消灭，如今我们的满洲国盟友可以安睡了，不必再担心来自西方的红色威胁。溥仪皇帝向您致以祝贺。

en: The soviet horde has been destroyed, and now our manchukoan allies can sleep well, without the red menace from the West. Emperor Pu-Yi sends you his congrats.
zh: 苏联大军已被消灭，如今我们的满洲国盟友可以安睡了，不必再担心来自西方的红色威胁。溥仪皇帝向您致以祝贺。

en: Just flawless execution!  Our main landing forces in the North can count on your secured airport.  Mission accomplished!
zh: 执行得毫无瑕疵！我们在北方的主力登陆部队可以依靠您夺取的机场了。任务完成！

en: OIL!  That's what we need, and we can get it from the Dutch colonies.  Our supplies of oil are running out, and the high command thinks we desperately need that resource.  We must secure it at all costs to maintain our war against the western powers.
zh: 石油！这正是我们需要的，而我们可以从荷兰殖民地得到它。我们的石油储备即将耗尽，高层认为我们迫切需要这一资源。为了维持对西方列强的战争，我们必须不惜一切代价夺取它。

en: To begin the conquest of the Dutch East Indies, your first mission is to seize the island of Tarakan and its supply of rich oil fields.  Do it quickly, we will soon need your services to clear other sectors.
zh: 作为征服荷属东印度的第一步，您的首要任务是夺取打拉根岛及其丰富的油田。要快，我们很快还需要您去肃清其他地区。

en: Just flawless execution!  Our main landing forces in the North can count on your secured airport.  Mission accomplished!
zh: 执行得毫无瑕疵！我们在北方的主力登陆部队可以依靠您夺取的机场了。任务完成！

en: Just flawless execution!  Our main landing forces in the North can count on your secured airport.  Mission accomplished!
zh: 执行得毫无瑕疵！我们在北方的主力登陆部队可以依靠您夺取的机场了。任务完成！

en: The Dutch forces have suffered a stinging defeat.  This means the outcome is a technical victory in this campaign.  The enemy is still holding some critical positions in other sectors, we must clear them.
zh: 荷兰军队遭受了惨重失败。这意味着本次战役的结局已可算作技术性胜利。敌军仍在其他地区死守一些关键阵地，我们必须将其肃清。

en: To continue our assault on the Dutch positions, you should strike a decisive blow to the ''KNIL'', the Dutch colonial forces.  The main ports and air bases are in the Balikpapan sector, what we need is to capture that sector.  This will allow us to complete this campaign.  Select carefully where you are going to disembark.  The area has plenty of sea mines and some coastal defenses.  Use your navy and air units to eliminate this threat.
zh: 为继续对荷军阵地发起攻势，您应当对“荷印陆军”——荷兰殖民军——施以致命一击。主要港口与空军基地都在巴厘巴板地区，我们需要的就是夺取该地区。这将使我们得以完成本次战役。请谨慎选择登陆地点。该海域布有大量水雷，并有一些海岸防御工事。动用您的海军与航空部队消除这一威胁。

en: The Dutch forces have suffered a stinging defeat.  This means the outcome is a technical victory in this campaign.  The enemy is still holding some critical positions in other sectors, we must clear them.
zh: 荷兰军队遭受了惨重失败。这意味着本次战役的结局已可算作技术性胜利。敌军仍在其他地区死守一些关键阵地，我们必须将其肃清。

en: The Dutch forces have suffered a stinging defeat.  This means the outcome is a technical victory in this campaign.  The enemy is still holding some critical positions in other sectors, we must clear them.
zh: 荷兰军队遭受了惨重失败。这意味着本次战役的结局已可算作技术性胜利。敌军仍在其他地区死守一些关键阵地，我们必须将其肃清。

en: The Dutch forces have suffered a total defeat, Java is free!!!
zh: 荷兰军队彻底失败，爪哇自由了！！！

en: The Dutch have resisted in this jungle area since January General.  Bogor and other nearby places are the last bases which the enemy still holds on this island. Your command will be split in two groups; your task is to clear the jungle of enemy elements and to seize all other objectives.  Select carefully the jungle paths for your troops.  I think the jungle will be our worst enemy here.
zh: 将军，自1月以来荷兰人一直在这片丛林地区顽抗。茂物及附近其他地点是敌军仍在该岛据守的最后基地。您的部队将分为两路；您的任务是肃清丛林中的敌军，并夺取所有其他目标。请为部队谨慎选择穿越丛林的路线。我想丛林将是我们在这里最大的敌人。

en: The Dutch forces have suffered a total defeat, Java is free!!!
zh: 荷兰军队彻底失败，爪哇自由了！！！

en: The Dutch forces have suffered a total defeat, Java is free!!!
zh: 荷兰军队彻底失败，爪哇自由了！！！

en: To the Philippines and the Pacific.
You have decided to continue the war with our assault on the Philippines.  Get ready for the planned invasion on that US colony.
zh: 您已决定以进攻菲律宾来继续战争。请为这场针对美国殖民地的既定入侵做好准备。

en: Good morning General, what do you think of today's surprise attack on Pearl Harbor?  The Yankees were completely surprised and there fleet was severely damaged!   We will receive the war declaration from the USA in the next few hours...
zh: 早上好，将军，您对今天偷袭珍珠港有何看法？美国佬完全被打了个措手不及，他们的舰队遭受重创！接下来几小时内我们就会收到美国的宣战……

en: You can decide your next destination; the emperor has given you this golden opportunity.  By taking the Wake Island flag, your next destination will be the attack on the US base in the Philippines.  On the other hand, if you take the Hong Kong flag, your next destination will be the South of China, with Hong Kong and Macao as your main objectives. Taking the Dutch flag, you will go to fight in the Dutch East Indies.
zh: 您可以决定下一个目的地；天皇把这个千载难逢的机会交给了您。夺取威克岛的旗帜，您的下一个目标就是进攻美国在菲律宾的基地。另一方面，如果您夺取香港的旗帜，您的下一个目标就是华南，以香港和澳门为主要目标。夺取荷兰国旗，您将前往荷属东印度作战。

en: Please, go back and select Hong Kong, the Philippines or the Dutch East Indies.
zh: 请返回并选择香港、菲律宾或荷属东印度。

en: You have decided to continue with the war in the Dutch East Indies.
zh: 您已决定在荷属东印度继续战争。

en: You have decided to continue the war in China, and onto the Asian mainland.
zh: 您已决定在中国、进而在亚洲大陆继续战争。

en: Please, go back, and select your destination.
zh: 请返回并选择您的目的地。

en: The emperor again wants to give you the opportunity to select your next destination. By taking the Australian flag, you will go to New Guinea.  If you decide instead to take the British flag, your troops will be deployed in our coming campaign in Burma. Where will you go?
zh: 天皇再次希望给您选择下一个目的地的机会。夺取澳大利亚国旗，您将前往新几内亚。如果您改为夺取英国国旗，您的部队将被部署到我们即将展开的缅甸战役中。您要去哪里？

en: You have decided to take part in the Burma campaign.
zh: 您已决定参加缅甸战役。

en: You have decided to fight in New Guinea.
zh: 您已决定在新几内亚作战。

en: Kochira-koso!!!, all the enemies were eliminated, the battle was a bloodbath, the sands of Iwo Jima are painted in dark red, but the Rising Sun flag it's still on the Mount Suribachi. Your next mission will be in Okinawa, we think the americans are planning to strike there.
zh: 岂敢岂敢！！！，敌人已被全部消灭，这场战斗是一场血战，硫磺岛的沙土被染成深红，但旭日旗依然飘扬在折钵山上。您的下一个任务将在冲绳，我们认为美国人正打算在那里发动进攻。

en: Konichiwa. I have heard about your actions in the Pacific, but your task here will be completely different. As you know, Iwo Jima is our most important base in the Bonin Islands, and nowadays this volcanic island is currently threatened by the proximity of the enemy fleets. This time, you can't leave the island, the Emperor expects the best from you if finally the enemy disembarks here. Eliminate them, or, otherwise, die as the samurai you are, that's your mission. Think on our valiant kamikazes, their mission is to get a glorious death striking the enemy!.
zh: 你好。我已听闻您的太平洋战绩，但您在这里的任务将截然不同。如您所知，硫磺岛是我们在小笠原群岛最重要的基地，而如今这座火山岛正因敌军舰队的逼近而受到威胁。这一次，您不能离开该岛，如果敌人最终在此登陆，天皇对您寄予厚望。消灭他们，否则就像您身为武士那样战死，这就是您的任务。想想我们英勇的神风特攻队，他们的使命就是撞击敌舰、光荣牺牲！

en: Prepare a line in the North, and then, try to counterattack the enemy forces, and don't forget to protect the volcano! (Mount Suribachi).
zh: 在北方构筑一条防线，然后设法对敌军发起反击，别忘了保护火山！（折钵山）。

en: Kochira-koso!!!, all the enemies were eliminated, the battle was a bloodbath, the sands of Iwo Jima are painted in dark red, but the Rising Sun flag it's still on the Mount Suribachi. Your next mission will be in Okinawa, we think the americans are planning to strike there.
zh: 岂敢岂敢！！！，敌人已被全部消灭，这场战斗是一场血战，硫磺岛的沙土被染成深红，但旭日旗依然飘扬在折钵山上。您的下一个任务将在冲绳，我们认为美国人正打算在那里发动进攻。

en: Kochira-koso!!!, all the enemies were eliminated, the battle was a bloodbath, the sands of Iwo Jima are painted in dark red, but the Rising Sun flag it's still on the Mount Suribachi. Your next mission will be in Okinawa, we think the americans are planning to strike there.
zh: 岂敢岂敢！！！，敌人已被全部消灭，这场战斗是一场血战，硫磺岛的沙土被染成深红，但旭日旗依然飘扬在折钵山上。您的下一个任务将在冲绳，我们认为美国人正打算在那里发动进攻。

en: Excellent!!!. Again a horrible massacre, but we have won the battle, anyway we expect another assault soon. Your services have been requested from Tokyo...
zh: 太棒了！！！又是一场惨烈的屠杀，但无论如何我们赢得了这场战斗，我们预计敌人很快会再次发起进攻。东京方面已要求调用您的部队……

en: After your success at Iwo Jima we hope you can also stop the enemies here, in Okinawa. The High Command have planned the defence of the island in this way; our most important facilities are positioned in the South corner of the island, including some airstrips and the important Naha naval base. The main objective is to protect that part, focusing your efforts in holding the lines agaisnt the enemy strikes and landings using the hills and cities present there.
zh: 在硫磺岛取得成功之后，我们希望您也能在此地，在冲绳，挡住敌人。高层对岛屿防御作了如下部署：我们最重要的设施都位于该岛南部，包括几条简易机场跑道以及重要的那霸海军基地。主要目标是保护该地区，集中力量守住防线，抵御敌军的突击与登陆，利用当地的山丘与城镇。

en: We have recruited an special division in Okinawa, (the ''boeitai'') plus some auxiliary units too. Also, the Yamato group is coming from Japan with fuel for just one way, to aid you with smashing the enemy fleet. Make good use of your brave kamikaze warriors, they can inflict severe casualities upon the enemy warships.
zh: 我们在冲绳征募了一个特别师团（“防卫队”），还有一些辅助部队。此外，大和部队正从日本驶来，所携燃料只够单程，前来协助您粉碎敌军舰队。好好使用您勇敢的神风特攻勇士，他们能对敌军战舰造成严重伤亡。

en: The Riukiu islands must not fall into the enemy hands!.
zh: 琉球群岛绝不能落入敌手！

en: A horrible massacre... this time the high command has decided to avoid your sepukku, since your services have been requested from Tokyo...
zh: 一场惨烈的屠杀……这一次高层决定免您切腹，因为东京方面已要求调用您的部队……

en: Excellent!!!. Again a horrible massacre, but we have won the battle, anyway we expect another assault soon. Your services have been requested from Tokyo...
zh: 太棒了！！！又是一场惨烈的屠杀，但无论如何我们赢得了这场战斗，我们预计敌人很快会再次发起进攻。东京方面已要求调用您的部队……

en: Excellent!!!. Again a horrible massacre, but we have won the battle, anyway we expect another assault soon. Your services have been requested from Tokyo...
zh: 太棒了！！！又是一场惨烈的屠杀，但无论如何我们赢得了这场战斗，我们预计敌人很快会再次发起进攻。东京方面已要求调用您的部队……

en: Excellent!, we have defeated the Americans!. They couldn't afford the bloodbath they have suffered in the battle. Now, we can negotiate a good peace treaty for us. Congratulations for your work!.
zh: 太棒了，我们打败了美国人！他们承受不起在这场战斗中遭受的血腥屠杀。现在，我们可以为我们谈成一项有利的和平条约了。祝贺您的工作！

en: General, you have been promoted to C-I-C of the defense of Tokyo, it's an enormous honor to protect the Imperial capital... isn't it?. Let me inform you about the reports we have about the enemy movements. We know they are going to disembark in two main fronts, one southwards from Tokyo, and another one in the East. According to our sources, the Americans have assembled a huge mass of Assault ships, supported by carriers and many warships.
zh: 将军，您已被晋升为东京防御总司令，保卫帝国首都是一项无上荣耀……不是吗？请允许我向您通报我们掌握的敌军动向情报。我们知道他们将主要在两条战线上登陆，一条在东京以南，另一条在东面。据我们的情报来源，美国人已集结了庞大的登陆舰群，并有航母与众多战舰支援。

en: Your task is ''easy'', stop the americans, and kick them out from the Tokyo sector. Our special air attack units (tokko), and our land attack units recruited from the population will attack in first wave... they are deployed in the beaches, and we are sure they will act like true samurais, then, use your units to counterattack... This is the last battle of the war, we must get the victory to save the Japanese Empire, or die.
zh: 您的任务很“轻松”：挡住美国人，把他们赶出东京地区。我们的特别航空攻击队（特攻）以及从民众中征募的陆上攻击队将作为第一波发起攻击……他们部署在海滩上，我们相信他们会像真正的武士那样作战，随后，用您的部队发起反击……这是战争的最后一战，我们必须取胜以拯救日本帝国，否则就只有死。

en: ''Our troops have entered the Imperial Palace yesterday. Hirohito and some of his advisors have been found dead, after committing seppuku, like the most of the Imperial Army after the fall of the japanese capital. Hundred of civillians have been killed during the bloody battle. President Truman hopes that... (continues page 2)''
zh: “我军已于昨日进入皇居。裕仁及其部分顾问被发现已经身亡，他们是在日本首都陷落后切腹自尽的，帝国陆军的大多数人也是如此。数百名平民在这场血腥的战斗中丧生。杜鲁门总统希望……（续第2版）”

en: Excellent!, we have defeated the Americans!. They couldn't afford the bloodbath they have suffered in the battle. Now, we can negotiate a good peace treaty for us. Congratulations for your work!.
zh: 太棒了，我们打败了美国人！他们承受不起在这场战斗中遭受的血腥屠杀。现在，我们可以为我们谈成一项有利的和平条约了。祝贺您的工作！

en: Congratulations General.  The enemy commander, Percival is now at the negotiation table but the only choice he has is "unconditional surrender!"
zh: 恭喜您，将军。敌军指挥官帕西瓦尔如今坐到了谈判桌前，但他唯一的选择就是“无条件投降！”

en: You have been awarded with the Order of the Rising Sun 3rd Class.
zh: 您已被授予三等旭日章。

en: After your great success at Hong Kong and Macao, the high command wants you to assault the Malayan peninsula.  The last British stronghold in Asia is just at the end of the Malayan peninsula, Singapore!  That city-fortress is still an important base for the Royal Navy, and a menace to our shipping along Asia.  The British have deployed Malayan, Indian and Australian troops to defend their positions; however, thanks to the ''collaboration'' of the king of Thailand... we will attack from our Thai bases striking the peninsula from the North.  We will then expect the surrender from the British Commander hahaha!
zh: 在您于香港和澳门取得重大胜利之后，高层希望您进攻马来半岛。英国在亚洲的最后据点就在马来半岛的尽头——新加坡！那座城塞至今仍是皇家海军的重要基地，也是我们亚洲航线的一大威胁。英国人已部署马来亚、印度与澳大利亚部队守卫阵地；不过，多亏了泰国国王的“合作”……我们将从我们的泰国基地出击，自北面打击该半岛。之后我们就等着英国指挥官投降吧，哈哈哈！

en: Navy warships will arrive to deal with the Royal Navy.  Good Luck and Banzai!!!!!
zh: 海军战舰将前来对付皇家海军。祝好运，万岁！！！！！

en: Irashaimase!  Our Empire is secure in the Pacific.  Now, the Americans will pay for the years of humiliations against our glorious imperial nation... the high command has special plans for them...
zh: 欢迎光临！我们的帝国在太平洋已安然无虞。现在，美国人将为他们多年来对我们光荣帝国的羞辱付出代价……高层对他们另有特别的安排……

en: The quick defeat of Australia will allow us to continue the conquest of the South Pacific. Now it's New Zealand's turn, where some Australian and American troops have escaped to.  They must not have another base here, New Zealand is like a big carrier, and it eventually could support an allied invasion of our new possessions in Australia.  From Tokyo, your orders are to assault the Auckland sector from two sides.  Special Naval Landing Forces (2nd and 3rd Yokosuka with paratrooper training) will support your mission.  Also seize the key island of Waiheke and its airstrip.   Like other battles we must capture all the enemy airbases because they have relative air superiority.   At the beginning of this battle I advice you to keep your air units in a defensive role.
zh: 澳大利亚的迅速溃败使我们得以继续征服南太平洋。现在轮到新西兰了，一些澳大利亚和美国部队逃到了那里。他们绝不能在那里再拥有基地，新西兰就像一艘巨大的航母，最终可能支撑盟军对我们新占领的澳大利亚领土发起反攻。来自东京的命令是：从两个方向进攻奥克兰地区。特别海军陆战队（接受伞兵训练的第2、第3横须贺部队）将支援您的行动。同时夺取关键的怀赫科岛及其简易机场。与以往其他战斗一样，我们必须夺取敌军所有空军基地，因为他们拥有相对的空中优势。战斗开始时，我建议您让航空部队采取防御姿态。

en: Irashaimase!  Our Empire is secure in the Pacific.  Now, the Americans will pay for the years of humiliations against our glorious imperial nation... the high command has special plans for them...
zh: 欢迎光临！我们的帝国在太平洋已安然无虞。现在，美国人将为他们多年来对我们光荣帝国的羞辱付出代价……高层对他们另有特别的安排……

en: Great!. The allies have been fully defeated at the gates of Rangoon. Now, we can send some units to protect other more important fronts.
zh: 太好了！盟军在仰光城下被彻底击败。现在，我们可以抽调一些部队去保护其他更重要的战线了。

en: With the renewed allied offensive, the enemy and the front lines have finally reached the sector where your troops are deployed. As you know, most of our units here in Burma have been destroyed. This is our last stand to stop the allied advance, before to hurry up and go back into Thailand, and that is a plan which won't like to the Emperor.
zh: 随着盟军重新发起攻势，敌军与战线终于推进到了您部队驻守的地区。如您所知，我们在缅甸的大部分部队已被歼灭。这是我们阻止盟军推进的最后抵抗，否则我们就得赶紧退回泰国，而那个方案天皇是不会喜欢的。

en: The allies have been barely stopped at the gates of Rangoon. Anyway, now, we can send some units to protect other more important fronts.
zh: 盟军在仰光城下勉强被挡住了。不管怎样，现在我们可以抽调一些部队去保护其他更重要的战线了。

en: The allies have been stopped at the gates of Rangoon. Now, we can send some units to protect other more important fronts.
zh: 盟军在仰光城下被挡住了。现在，我们可以抽调一些部队去保护其他更重要的战线了。
第86野战炮兵营（菲律宾侦察队）

en: Congratulations General. Our beach heads in the northern islands of the Philippines are secured, and the Rising Sun flag will rise in Manila soon. Those Philippinos and Americans are no match for our brave soldiers.
zh: 恭喜您，将军。我们在菲律宾北部诸岛的滩头阵地已稳固，旭日旗很快将升上马尼拉。那些菲律宾人和美国人根本不是我们勇敢士兵的对手。

en: Konichiwa General. I just want to wish you good luck for this new mission. The puny occidentals have held these islands for too long, and now we are going to clean another Asian place more from the foreign presence.
zh: 你好，将军。我只想祝您这项新任务好运。那些微不足道的西方人占据这些岛屿太久了，现在我们又要从一处亚洲土地上清除外国势力的存在。

en: I have visited the Philippines in the past, and I can say the Lingayen Gulf offers good beachs to disembark your troops, select carefully where you are going to deploy your men, and the victory will be easy and swift. Also, I should say the high command has decided to land some of your troops nothwards from here, so, some of your command will come from the North.
zh: 我过去曾访问过菲律宾，我可以说林加延湾提供了良好的海滩供您的部队登陆，请谨慎选择部署您部下的地点，胜利就会轻松而迅速。另外，我应当说明，高层已决定让您的部分部队在此以北登陆，因此，您的一部分部队将从北方赶来。

en: Congratulations General. Our beach heads in the northern islands of the Philippines are secured, and the Rising Sun flag will rise in Manila soon. Those Philippinos and Americans are no match for our brave soldiers.
zh: 恭喜您，将军。我们在菲律宾北部诸岛的滩头阵地已稳固，旭日旗很快将升上马尼拉。那些菲律宾人和美国人根本不是我们勇敢士兵的对手。

en: Kochira koso!, we now control the most important enemy bases. The Americans are trapped hopelessly in the Bataan peninsula, we need only to annihilate them!.
zh: 岂敢岂敢！如今我们已控制敌军最重要的基地。美国人绝望地被困在巴丹半岛，我们只需将他们歼灭！

en: Kochira koso!, we now control the most important enemy bases. The Americans are trapped hopelessly in the Bataan peninsula, we need only to annihilate them!.
zh: 岂敢岂敢！如今我们已控制敌军最重要的基地。美国人绝望地被困在巴丹半岛，我们只需将他们歼灭！

en: Kochira koso!, we now control the most important enemy bases. The Americans are trapped hopelessly in the Bataan peninsula, we need only to annihilate them!.
zh: 岂敢岂敢！如今我们已控制敌军最重要的基地。美国人绝望地被困在巴丹半岛，我们只需将他们歼灭！

en: Congratulations General. The enemy officers hidden in the Malinta tunnel in Corregidor have been taken as prisoners, and the American presence on the Philippines will no longer be a threat.
zh: 恭喜您，将军。藏身于科雷希多马林塔隧道中的敌军军官已被俘，美国在菲律宾的存在将不再是威胁。

en: After our assault on the Philippines in December of the past year, the enemy forces have been defeated, and these islands are clearly into our hands, however, there are still some pockets of enemy resistance. The most of the enemy troops are entretched on the Bataan peninsula, where they are desperately trying to resist our assaults...
zh: 在去年12月我们对菲律宾发起进攻之后，敌军已被击败，这些岛屿显然已落入我们手中，不过仍有若干敌军抵抗的孤立据点。敌军大部分部队据守巴丹半岛，拼命抵抗我们的进攻……

en: Deploy your troops around our lines in the North of Bataan, and kick out the enemy from this part of the Philippines. The annihilation of the allied troops here, means the end of the campaign in the Philippines. Also, our information reveals that the enemy officers are hidden in the Malinta Tunnel, located on the Corregidor Island. Take that island on the South.
zh: 在巴丹北面我们防线周围部署您的部队，把敌人从菲律宾的这一部分赶出去。歼灭此地的盟军部队，就意味着菲律宾战役的结束。此外，我们的情报显示，敌军军官藏匿在科雷希多岛上的马林塔隧道中。夺取南面的那座岛。

en: The enemy officers hidden in the Malinta tunnel in Corregidor have been taken as prisoners, and the American presence on the Philippines will no longer be a threat.
zh: 藏身于科雷希多马林塔隧道中的敌军军官已被俘，美国在菲律宾的存在将不再是威胁。

en: The enemy officers hidden in the Malinta tunnel in Corregidor have been taken as prisoners, and the American presence on the Philippines will no longer be a threat.
zh: 藏身于科雷希多马林塔隧道中的敌军军官已被俘，美国在菲律宾的存在将不再是威胁。

en: The war is OVER!, this is our victory day in Asia, the Primuski Republic is now dealing his independence with Moscow while Stalin is begging for the armistice with Germany!. China, Burma and India are now also included in the Co-Prosperity Sphere. We have liberated Asia from the Europeans, but, who will free Asia from us? HAHAHA!. Your name is now included in the japanese history as one of the heroes of our sacred nation.
zh: 战争结束了！今天是我们在亚洲的胜利日，滨海共和国正与莫斯科谈判其独立，而斯大林正在乞求与德国停战！中国、缅甸和印度如今也纳入了共荣圈。我们把亚洲从欧洲人手中解放了出来，可是，谁又能把亚洲从我们手中解放出来？哈哈哈！您的名字如今已作为我们神圣民族的英雄之一载入日本史册。

en: Will you assist to the big ceremony at the Yasukuni Temple in Tokyo?...
zh: 您会出席东京靖国神社的盛大典礼吗？……

en: Fabulous!   Your lightning strike on the other side of the river has avoided any quick soviet counterattack.  Now the hills and other strategic locations are in our hands.  Maybe in the future Vladivostok could be the next target in this area.  Congratulations for your promotion to General of the Imperial Army!
zh: 太出色了！您对河对岸的闪电突击使苏联人来不及迅速发起反击。如今各高地及其他战略要点都在我们手中。也许今后这一地区的下一个目标就是符拉迪沃斯托克。祝贺您晋升为帝国陆军将军！

en: Too bloody commander, too bloody.  The high command thinks you are taking too many loses.  Anyway, the hills and the other strategic points are now in our hands.  By the way, Congratulations for your promotion as General of the Imperial Army.
zh: 太惨烈了，指挥官，太惨烈了。高层认为您的损失过大。不过，各高地及其他战略要点如今都在我们手中。顺便说一句，祝贺您晋升为帝国陆军将军。

en: The soviets sent a lot of troops; however you and your brave soldiers have reached all the operation goals with the desired final result.  Now the hills and other strategic locations are in our hands.  Maybe in the future Vladivostok could be the next target in this area. Congratulations for your promotion to General of the Imperial Army!
zh: 苏联人派来了大量部队；不过，您和您勇敢的士兵们还是以理想的最终结果达成了作战的全部目标。如今各高地及其他战略要点都在我们手中。也许今后这一地区的下一个目标就是符拉迪沃斯托克。祝贺您晋升为帝国陆军将军！
彼得罗巴甫洛夫斯科耶湖

en: Finally, those officers from Tokyo will be happy knowing we are going to strike the Soviets in Far East Siberia.  Your command, as well as some troops from Manchukuo, will take part in the Vladivostok operation.  The plan is to cut the Trans-Siberian Railway and any surrounding communications to isolate the port city of Vladivostok.  Then your units will drive to the South towards Vladivostok.
zh: 终于，东京的那些军官会很高兴得知我们将要在远东西伯利亚打击苏联人了。您的部队，以及一些来自满洲国的部队，将参加符拉迪沃斯托克作战。计划是切断西伯利亚大铁路及周边一切通信，以孤立港口城市符拉迪沃斯托克。随后您的部队将向南推进，直取符拉迪沃斯托克。

en: As you know, since you have some experience against the soviets in 1938, they will be a rough enemy.  Their use of heavy artillery units will again be a major problem.
zh: 如您所知，既然您在1938年与苏联人交过手，他们将是难缠的敌人。他们使用重型炮兵部队将再次成为大麻烦。

en: We also hope to find anti-soviet elements in the population of the conquered areas or even in the enemy army units.  Our plan is to set up of an anti-soviet ''independent'' republic there, the Primurski Republic, like in the 20s.
zh: 我们还希望在所征服地区的民众乃至敌军部队中找到反苏分子。我们的计划是在那里建立一个反苏的“独立”共和国——滨海共和国，就像20年代那样。
通往符拉迪沃斯托克之路
（内务人民委员部符拉迪沃斯托克）
（内务人民委员部符拉迪沃斯托克）

en: Rippa-na!, the bolsheviks are stoped in the Xingkai lake, and for the moment they won't be a threat... the High Command of the Kwantung Army has a new mission for you.
zh: 太棒了！布尔什维克被挡在兴凯湖，眼下他们不再构成威胁……关东军高层为您准备了新任务。

en: Nani?, doshita you have retreated your units before the arranged time!!!??, all the operation plans have been destroyed, and now many units have been overrun by the bolsheviks!... Well, you have achieved the honour of committing seppukku...
zh: 什么？怎么回事，您在约定时间之前就撤走了部队！！！？？所有作战计划都被打乱了，如今许多部队已被布尔什维克击溃！……好吧，您赢得了切腹的荣誉……

en: After your success in the Xingkai lake, the Kwantung army wants you to manage the retreat from the Karafuto island, the bolsheviks have invaded that island with strong units, and for the moment we can't mantain our positions there while our fleets are fighting the americans on the Pacific.
zh: 在兴凯湖取得成功之后，关东军希望您来负责库页岛的撤退事宜，布尔什维克已派出强大部队入侵该岛，而眼下我们的舰队正在太平洋上与美国人对峙，我们无法在那里维持阵地。

en: Establish defensive positions, and stop the soviets while other sectors are completing the retreat, then, drive your units to the evacuation point. One more thing, commander. Many of the people living on the North, have abandoned their houses fearing the soviet invasion. Now, you are responsible for the refugees and their lives on your sector, all of them must survive since the High Command would not accept to lost any of the refugee groups. Due to the refugees matter, all the room on the evacuation fleet it's full. Don't loose any of the transports, or the High Command will relief you.
zh: 构筑防御阵地，在其他地区完成撤退时挡住苏联人，然后把您的部队开往撤离点。还有一件事，指挥官。北面许多居民因害怕苏联入侵已舍弃了家园。如今，您要对您辖区内难民及其生命负责，他们所有人都必须存活，因为高层不会接受损失任何一个难民群体。由于难民问题，撤离舰队的所有舱位都已满员。不要损失任何一艘运输船，否则高层将解除您的职务。

en: Omedetogozaimasu!, the operation has been a complete success, now you can embark your units...
zh: 恭喜！行动取得了圆满成功，现在您可以登船撤离部队了……

en: Good morning general.  The enemy National Guard and those rookie soldiers weren't a problem for your elite warriors.  But now, we should take care, the Americans will send a lot of units to this sector with the aim of erasing us from US soil, we shall see.  Your mission is to capture San Francisco from the ground, and also seize San Jose.  We expect a direct attack on our beach head at Monterey and the arrival of the US navy, which will surely try to set a blockade... it, will be funny when the world biggest warship, our glorious battleship Yamato, arrives to deal with their vessels.
zh: 早上好，将军。 敌方的国民警卫队和那些新兵蛋子根本不是你们这些精锐武士的对手。 但现在我们得当心了，美国人会向这一地区投入大量部队，企图把我们彻底从美国本土上抹掉，走着瞧吧。 你的任务是从陆上夺取旧金山，同时占领圣何塞。 我们预计敌人会直接进攻我们在蒙特雷的滩头阵地，美国海军也会到来，他们肯定会试图实施封锁……等到世界上最大的战舰、我们光荣的大和号战列舰前来收拾他们的舰船时，那可就有意思了。

en: Defeat them at the sea, and stop their counterattack, we will then celebrate our victory at the negotiation tables of San Francisco!
zh: 在海上击败他们，阻止他们的反攻，然后我们就能在旧金山的谈判桌上庆祝胜利了！

en: With the prestige you've gained, you can now equip your new units and make upgrades.
zh: 凭借您所获得的声望，现在可以装备新部队并进行升级了。

en: After the defeat at Tobruk, Rommel had pressured the High Command to plan to take Malta, because for the intended advance to Egypt, they needed to have a secured route of supplies.
zh: 托布鲁克战败之后，隆美尔向最高统帅部施压，要求策划夺取马耳他，因为要按计划向埃及推进，就必须拥有一条安全的补给路线。

en: Mission: The chosen plan is to use two companies of Brandenburger and a battalion of San Marco to infiltrate in the coast of Malta, meanwhile the Raemcke Brigade and Folgore division will fall on the coast, after that, two infantry divisions will arrive by sea.
zh: 任务：选定的方案是用两连勃兰登堡部队和一个圣马可营渗透马耳他海岸，同时拉姆克旅和福尔戈雷师将在海岸实施空降，此后两个步兵师将经海路抵达。

en: Note: You will be compensated with prestige if you are successful, and you can have more chances to invade Egypt.
zh: 注：如果成功，您将获得声望作为补偿，并且能有更多机会入侵埃及。

en: Your failure in the invasion on Malta will drive you to a most historic path in the Alamein sector, where prestige will be lacking.
zh: 您在马耳他登陆的失败将把您引向阿拉曼地区最具历史意义的一条道路，在那里声望将会匮乏。

en: Finally, after the complete defeat of the main British army at El Alamein, we can assault the strongly important port of Alexandria. Unfortunately, some enemy units have escaped from the El Alamein area, and now they are trying to set up defences in and around Alexandria. Air Recon reports show that the Royal Navy has come to protect the port, our Italian friends will send the Regia Marina to help us in the assault, and to face the Royal Navy.
zh: 终于，在阿拉曼彻底击败英国主力军队之后，我们可以突击极为重要的亚历山大港了。遗憾的是，一些敌军部队已从阿拉曼地区逃脱，现在他们正试图在亚历山大城内及周边构筑防御。空中侦察报告显示皇家海军已前来保护该港，我们的意大利盟友将派出皇家海军前来协助我们突击，并对抗英国皇家海军。

en: All the main ports of the Mediterranean Sea are now under our control! Only the Suez Canal remains under British domination... We shall see how many time they can use the Canal!
zh: 地中海所有主要港口现在都在我们控制之下！只有苏伊士运河仍在英国统治下……我们倒要看看他们还能使用运河多久！
第1国王属龙骑兵卫队团

en: Kongratulieren! Our elite paratroopers have showed their skills again. The entrance to the Canal is secured and the British won't be able to use it again to resupply their units in Egypt and the Middle East.
zh: 恭喜！我们的精锐伞兵再次展示了他们的本领。运河入口已安全，英国人再也无法利用它为其在埃及和中东的部队提供补给了。

en: El Cairo is in front of us, after more than one year of battles in Africa we are starting the final assault on the British stronghold of Egypt.
zh: 开罗就在我们面前，在非洲一年多的战斗之后，我们正开始对英国在埃及的据点发起最后突击。

en: The coast of Egypt is closed, Alexandria and Port Said are under our control, however the British have not accepted our offer of surrender. Now we must assault the city to end the British control over North Africa.
zh: 埃及海岸已被封锁，亚历山大和塞得港都在我们控制之下，然而英国人并未接受我们的投降提议。现在我们必须突入该城，以终结英国对北非的控制。

en: El Cairo has been cleared. Now, the next aim is to complete the conquest of the Suez Canal.
zh: 开罗已被肃清。下一个目标是完成对苏伊士运河的征服。

en: After the fall of El Cairo and Port Said, the last point of British resistance in Egypt is the Suez Canal. The enemy have regrouped some units around Suez as a last chance to stop us. Intelligence reports say that the Americans are preparing an invasion of Nort Africa soon so you must finish with the British as soon as possible, to control the Suez Canal for a possible meeting with the Americans in the coming months.
zh: 在开罗和塞得港陷落之后，英国在埃及抵抗的最后一个据点是苏伊士运河。敌人已在苏伊士周边重整了一些部队，作为阻止我们的最后机会。情报报告称美国人正筹备不久后入侵北非，所以您必须尽快解决英国人，控制苏伊士运河，以便在今后几个月可能与美国人会师。

en: Kongratulieren! Now the Suez Canal is under German control! This will be a great help also for our Japanese friends.
zh: 恭喜！现在苏伊士运河已在德国控制之下！这对我们的日本盟友也是极大的帮助。

en: You've selected the path towards South Afrika, now you have to recapture the Italian Colonies.

en: BV: This means to select the plan proposed by our Italian friends: the recapturing of Eritrea, Ethiopia, and Somaliland, and then, going towards the South following the Nile river.
zh: BV：这表示选择我们的意大利盟友所提议的方案：夺回厄立特里亚、埃塞俄比亚和索马里兰，然后沿尼罗河向南推进。

en: V or TV: By selecting this path, you will go to ensure the Mediterranean Sea, the oil paths and the chance to open a second front in the Caucasus, piercing into Persia.
zh: V 或 TV：选择这条路线，您将前往确保地中海、石油通道以及在高加索开辟第二战场、突入波斯的机会。

en: The fate of Afrika is in your hands.

zh: 您尚未选择一条路线，请重试。

zh: 您已选择了确保经由叙利亚、伊拉克和波斯的石油路线这条路线。

zh: 埃及已在我们手中，现在需要确保地中海沿岸的安全，快速行动！

en: We've crossed the Channel, and now we are going to the Mediterranean coast, but even now there are the remnants of the 8th British Army and a complete Egyptian division, so you have to destroy them. Our Intelligence report says that anti-British Palestinian groups will be
zh: 我们已渡过海峡，现在正向地中海沿岸前进，但即便现在那里仍有英国第8集团军的残部和一支完整的埃及师，所以您必须消灭他们。我们的情报报告称，反英的巴勒斯坦团体将

zh: 如今海岸已安全，我们可以向内陆的油田进发了。

en: We are nearing the land where the very first people loved by Hitler originated (kiddin'). High Command says that there are many Jewish Militia units across the whole territory, after the conquest we will send the SS in to "silence" the sector.

en: Be as quick as you can and close the Mediterranean's coast to avoid enemy reinforcements.
zh: 尽可能快速行动并封锁地中海沿岸，以阻止敌军增援。

en: This is the French's last bastion, the zone isn't the best for tanks, so beware.

zh: 我们已抵达伊拉克首都城下，主要障碍是阿拉伯军团和作为增援

en: reinforcements, so do whatever you can and take the needed oil for the Deutsches Reich !
zh: 调来的第10印度师，所以尽您所能，为德意志帝国夺取所需的石油！

en: After the fall of Baghdad, we will never again suffer from the lack of fuel. Only Persia, one of the places with the most petrol reserves in the World, is still not under our control. Please give me a moment to explain to you the Persian situation:-
zh: 在巴格达陷落之后，我们再也不会饱受燃料匮乏之苦。只有波斯——世界上石油储量最多的地方之一——仍不在我们控制之下。请给我一点时间向您说明波斯的局势：

en: In past years, Persia was a pro-German country, however in the first days of 1943 the Soviets, aided by some remaining British units who escaped from other fronts, (mainly of the 8th Army), have invaded the country. The King of Persia, Reza Shah (forced by the invaders) has abdicated. Fortunately for us, some Persian army officers, still loyal to Reza Shah, have contacted us offering their help to kick out the Soviets and the British from Persia. Intelligence reports that the Armed Persian Police, and the weak Persian Air Force will remain under the enemy control, also, a good number of Soviet tanks have been spotted. There is only an airstrip near to Tehran, so you must take it to allow our airforce to be deployed there. Also, Japanese forces have disembarked in Iraq, and have sent us reinforcements.
zh: 过去这些年，波斯是一个亲德国家，然而在 1943年的最初几天，苏联人在一些从其他战线逃脱的英军残部（主要是第8集团军的）协助下入侵了这个国家。波斯国王礼萨汗（在入侵者胁迫下）已经退位。对我们来说幸运的是，一些仍忠于礼萨汗的波斯军官已与我们接触，提出帮助我们赶走波斯的苏联人和英国人。情报显示，武装警察和弱小的波斯空军仍将处于敌人控制之下，此外还发现了数量可观的苏联坦克。德黑兰附近只有一条简易机场跑道，所以您必须夺取它，以便我们的空军能在那里部署。此外，日军已在伊拉克登陆，并向我们派来了增援。

en: Your task is to aid the Persian "rebels" in clearing Tehran. With a success here, Persia surely will be an important ally in the coming years.
zh: 您的任务是协助波斯“叛军”肃清德黑兰。若在此成功，波斯在未来数年必将成为重要的盟友。

en: Kongratulieren! The Soviets have been kicked out of Persia, and the British Armies will no longer disturb us here. The Middle East is under our command as well as the oil resources from these lands. In spite of the failure at Stalingrad, our presence in Persia will put pressure on  the Soviet southern borders. We hope the Kursk offensive will be a decisive victory for the Werhmacht, helped now by our big oil supplies...
zh: 恭喜！苏联人已被逐出波斯，英国军队再也不会在此地骚扰我们。中东以及这些土地上的石油资源都已在我们的掌控之下。尽管在斯大林格勒遭遇失败，我们在波斯的存在将对苏联南部边境施加压力。我们希望库尔斯克攻势将成为国防军的一次决定性胜利，如今有了我们大量的石油供应助力……

en: (You have managed the DAK better than Rommel! Congratulations General!)
zh: （您对非洲军的指挥比隆美尔更出色！恭喜您，将军！）
--- 德意志非洲军 - 拉丁将军 2004 ---

zh: 您已完成这条假设路线。现在不妨去探索游戏中的其他场景……

en: You have passed this first trial, now we are going to Massawa's Port to cut off any supply entry from the Indian Ocean.
zh: 您已通过了第一次考验，现在我们前往马萨瓦港，以切断来自印度洋的一切补给输入。

en: We've started our advance toward the south. We are at Keren's gates, however this city won't give us any trouble the main resistence is in the mountains.
zh: 我们已开始向南推进。我们已抵近克伦城下，然而这座城市不会给我们带来麻烦，主要的抵抗在山地之中。

en: We're on the thresh-hold of conquering all that the Italians had lost, the last resistance point is founded here in Mogadishu. Be careful, don't under-estimate the Royal Navy

en: The campaign has reached its end, your duty was superb and better than the historic one. Congratulations and I thank you for playing.
zh: 战役已到尽头，您的表现极为出色，比历史上的表现更好。恭喜，感谢您的游玩。

en: This is the last strategic point controlled by the British on the African coast, once we will take it, the allies will be unable to counterattack because we will have in our hands all the important ports. The configuration of Mombasa City makes the assault very tough plus the presence of the Royal Navy will push your command to the extreme, but we trust you.
zh: 这是英国人在非洲海岸控制的最后一个战略要点，一旦我们拿下它，盟军将无法反攻，因为所有重要港口都将落入我们手中。蒙巴萨城的布局使这次突击极为艰巨，加之皇家海军的存在将把您的指挥逼到极限，但我们信任您。

en: The Allies have been able to stop you, we couldn't acomplish the proposed goals. We realize that it was really very hard and you had very few units.
zh: 盟军已能阻止您，我们未能完成预定的目标。我们明白这确实非常艰难，而您手上的部队极少。

en: Note: Your duty was better than the historic one, thanks for playing.
zh: 注：您的表现比历史上的表现更好，感谢您的游玩。

zh: 阿尔及尔地区已安全，意大利分遣队将留守，我们要继续势不可挡的推进

en: After you've destroyed the Anglo-American forces in Bone and stop the advance of the 8th army, we are going to chase the survivors of Bone toward Algiers to destroy the second front and take our revenge against the French traitors.
zh: 在您摧毁博讷的英美军队并阻止第8集团军推进之后，我们将把博讷的残部追向阿尔及尔，以摧毁第二战场，并向法国叛徒复仇。

zh: 盟军已能阻止我们的推进！从现在起我们无法再发动任何进攻，因为我们的部队状况不佳。现在将转入防御我们的阵地！

en: We are in an unstoppable advance along the African coasts. Now Oran is the next Allied fortified target, your mission is to clear it as fast as you can, before our enemies can reinforce and makes us an impossible duty to perform.
zh: 我们正沿着非洲海岸势不可挡地推进。现在奥兰是盟军下一个设防目标，您的任务是在敌人得以增援并使这项任务变得不可能完成之前，尽快肃清它。

zh: 把美国人赶出东海岸只差最后一步，开始行动！

en: We've left Algiers and we are in Morocco, your quick advance didn't give our enemies time to defend themselves. You have to advance faster and avoid the mistakes you made in the past.
zh: 我们已离开阿尔及尔，现在身处摩洛哥，您的快速推进没给敌人留下自卫的时间。您必须推进得更快，并避免过去犯下的错误。

en: There is heavy activity in the Atlantic, so be careful.

en: Excellent ! The campaign has reached its end!
Note: your duty was better than the historic one. Congratulations and thanks for playing.
zh: 注：您的表现比历史上的表现更好。恭喜并感谢您的游玩。

en: This is the last battle to complete your campaign in Africa's West, the fortified City of Casablanca! The city is surrounded by mine fields and fortifications, at sea the Anglo-American Navy is imposing and the RAF have deployed all it's forces from the bases in Gibraltar. We trust you and we believe that you'll find a way to avoid all these obstacles in this struggle and kick-out the Allies from this sector of Africa.
zh: 这是完成您非洲西部战役的最后一战——设防的卡萨布兰卡城！该城四周布有雷场和工事，海上英美海军声势逼人，皇家空军也从直布罗陀的基地出动了其全部兵力。我们信任您，相信您能在这场斗争中设法避开所有这些障碍，把盟军赶出非洲的这一地区。

en: The Allies have been able to stop our advance! From now on we cannot carry out any more attacks, because our units are in bad shape. Now will be defending our positions!
zh: 盟军已能阻止我们的推进！从现在起我们无法再发动任何进攻，因为我们的部队状况不佳。现在将转入防御我们的阵地！

en: Very Good! You've demonstrated clearly your superiority, now it's time to advance towards Algeria.
zh: 非常好！您已清楚地证明了自身的优势，现在是向阿尔及利亚推进的时候了。

en: We know that you've recently arrived from El Alamein but the severity of the situation right here demands your services.
zh: 我们知道您刚从阿拉曼赶来，但此地局势的严重性需要您效力。

en: After the Anglo-American's disembark on the African coasts they'll surround us. Due to our lack of forces we be unable to resist in battle.
zh: 英美在非洲海岸登陆后将包围我们。由于兵力不足，我们将无力在战斗中抵抗。

en: Your mission: Show the enemy that we are not defeated, advance quickly towards the interior of Tunisia to create chaos within their armies.
zh: 您的任务：向敌人表明我们并未失败，迅速向突尼斯内陆推进，在他们的军队中制造混乱。

en: You couldn't force the Allies back into Tunisia, so it's impossible to defend Alexandria and Tunisia with the few units we have.
zh: 您未能迫使盟军退回突尼斯，因此凭我们现有的少量部队不可能守住亚历山大和突尼斯。

en: From now on, you will be on the defensive.
zh: 从现在起，您将转入防御。
第104装甲掷弹兵团//第21装甲师/非洲军

en: Excellent!! you've captured the oil reserves found in Tebessa!
zh: 好极了！！您夺取了泰贝萨发现的石油储量！

en: Your next assignment will be enclose the Anglo-American armies that are in Bone.
zh: 您的下一项任务将是围歼位于博讷的英美军队。

en: The Anglo-American forces have disembarked in French territory, and set off at full speed following a route to Tunisia. After your defeat in Egypt, this is the only defendable sector of Africa that we have left.
zh: 英美军队已在法国领土登陆，并沿通往突尼斯的路线全速开进。在你们于埃及战败之后，这是我们在非洲仅剩的可守之地。

en: Due to the inexperience of your rivals, their positions are badly defended, but they outnumber you easily and have more supplies.
zh: 由于你们对手缺乏经验，他们的阵地防御很差，但他们在人数上轻松压过你们，并且补给更充足。

en: Your mission:- Advance at full speed and take Tebessa.
zh: 您的任务：全速推进并夺取泰贝萨。

en: Note: In Tebessa, the Allies have a great oil reserve that once captured will make future offensive operations possible.
zh: 注：在泰贝萨，盟军有一大处石油储备，一旦夺取将使未来的攻势作战成为可能。

en: You couldn't force the Allies back into Tunisia, so it's impossible to defend Alexandria and Tunisia with the few units we have.
zh: 您未能迫使盟军退回突尼斯，因此凭我们现有的少量部队不可能守住亚历山大和突尼斯。

en: From now on, you will be on the defensive.
zh: 从现在起，您将转入防御。

en: Due to your delay, the Allies were able to evacuate their oil reserves from Tebessa.
zh: 由于您的拖延，盟军得以将他们的石油储备从泰贝萨撤走。

en: We cannot continue the offensive, now you must prepare to fall back and defend yourself.
zh: 我们无法继续进攻，现在您必须准备后撤并转入防御。

zh: 英美从背后突袭我们的意图已经失败，现在我们可以集中力量在马雷斯防线对抗蒙蒂了。

en: Thanks to your superb last success, we have the posibility of enclosing the rookie armies reaching to the Tunisian coast, particularly the city of Bone.
zh: 多亏您上一次的出色胜利，我们有机会围歼正在抵达突尼斯海岸的新兵部队，特别是博讷城。

en: If you are successful here they won't have another chance, leaving them no option but to surrender to us.
zh: 如果您在此取胜，他们就不会再有第二次机会，只能向我们投降。

en: You couldn't force the Allies back into Tunisia, so it's impossible to attack with the few units we have.
zh: 您未能迫使盟军退回突尼斯，因此凭我们现有的少量部队不可能发起进攻。

en: From now on, you will be on the defensive.
zh: 从现在起，您将转入防御。

en: Due to your pathetic speed, they have escaped and we cannot chase them because our reports say that Monty is preparing a big offensive in the sector of Mareth Line.
zh: 由于您那可怜的速度，他们逃脱了，而我们无法追击，因为报告称蒙蒂正在马雷斯防线一带准备一场大规模攻势。

zh: 出色！经过这场大胜，第8集团军无法迅速重整，这是我们的机会——夺取先手，我们将把盟军向西追击。

en: After the Western front destruction, you are facing your most difficult duty:- in battle once more against Monty's 8th Army. This is a very difficult mission, but if you are successful you will have stopped the threat of our expulsion from Africa.
zh: 在西线被摧毁之后，您面临最艰难的任务：再次与蒙蒂的第8集团军交战。这是一项非常艰难的任务，但如果您成功，就能阻止我们被逐出非洲的威胁。

en: Only Level Bombers can cause long term suppression.
zh: 只有重型轰炸机才能造成长期压制。

en: Anti Aircraft can move and then fire at air units, if they move into a hex directly below the plane. They don't provide air defense.
zh: 高射炮可以先移动再对空中单位开火，但必须移动到飞机正下方的格。它们不提供防空掩护。

en: Fire support only takes place if the supporting artillery is adjacent to the defender.
zh: 只有当支援炮兵与防御方相邻时，才会发生火力支援。

en: Units mounted in transport will not dismount automatically at the beginning of a new turn.
zh: 搭乘运输工具的部队不会在新回合开始时自动下车。

en: A City, Airfield, or Port that is destroyed cannot be used to deploy or upgrade units until Repaired. Only Level Bombers and Battleships can destroy a hex.
zh: 被摧毁的城市、机场或港口在修复前无法用于部署或升级部队。只有重型轰炸机和战列舰能摧毁格。

en: Only Construction or Sapper units can repair a hex.
zh: 只有建筑或工兵部队能够修复格。

en: A Road that is destroyed slows movement across it.
zh: 被摧毁的公路会减慢通行速度。

en: Paratroopers have a chance of mis-dropping.
Ground condition can cycle through DRY, FROZEN, and MUD, depending on the season, climate, and persistent and prolonged weather patterns, and will affect movement rates accordingly.
zh: 地面状况会在干燥、冻结与泥泞之间循环，取决于季节、气候以及持续而持久的天气模式，并相应影响移动力消耗。

en: Planes use Fuel and must be resupplied at appropriate times.
zh: 飞机会消耗燃料，必须在适当时机补给。

en: Units mounted in transport will not dismount if attacked.
zh: 搭乘运输工具的部队在被攻击时不会下车。

en: Visit http://forum.open-general.com/ to learn more about Open Panzer General and other Mods available for Open General.
zh: 访问 http://forum.open-general.com/ 了解更多关于 Open Panzer General 以及 Open General 其他可用模组的信息。

en: Your recent performance has been superb; unfortunately, the Western Allies' overwhelming quantitative superiority has allowed them to force us back to our borders. Your most recent victory in Southern France combined with your earlier victory in Normandy have proven to us that you have the ability to lead our upcoming counterattack in the Ardennes.
zh: 你近期的表现极为出色；遗憾的是，西线盟军压倒性的数量优势已将我们逼回本土边界。你最近在法国南部的胜利，加上此前在诺曼底的胜利，已向我们证明你有能力指挥我们即将在阿登地区发起的反攻。

en: Once again, we ask you to repel an invasion, but this time Southern France is the allied target. Your job is to hold onto five objectives until after August 28th when we hope to move additional troops to support you. Failing this, you must hold at least two objectives until then.
zh: 我们再次要求你击退一次登陆入侵，但这次盟军的目标是法国南部。你的任务是在 8月28日之后仍守住五个目标，届时我们希望调派更多部队支援你。若无法做到，你至少须在此期限前守住两个目标。

en: Your defense of France was adequate; unfortunately, the Allies have broken out of Normandy and are advancing across France.
zh: 你对法国的防御尚属合格；遗憾的是，盟军已突穿诺曼底，正横越法国推进。

en: Your recent performance has been superb; unfortunately, the Western Allies' overwhelming quantitative superiority has allowed them to force us back to our borders. Your most recent victory in Southern France combined with your earlier victory in Normandy have proven to us that you have the ability to lead our upcoming counterattack in the Ardennes.
zh: 你近期的表现极为出色；遗憾的是，西线盟军压倒性的数量优势已将我们逼回本土边界。你最近在法国南部的胜利，加上此前在诺曼底的胜利，已向我们证明你有能力指挥我们即将在阿登地区发起的反攻。

en: You have done very well on the Italian front.
zh: 你在意大利战线的表现非常出色。

en: The Americans have been preparing to launch a new offensive aimed at taking Rome. You must hold a minimum of four objectives until at least the end of March. If possible, retake and hold Anzio while keeping the Allies from gaining any of the objectives you currently hold.
zh: 美军一直在准备发动一场旨在夺取罗马的新攻势。你至少须守到 3月底，期间保有四个目标。如有可能，夺回并守住安齐奥，同时不让盟军夺取你目前掌握的任何目标。

en: We have been pleased with your performance on the Italian front and it is now time for you to counter the upcoming Allied invasion of France.
zh: 我们对你在意大利战线的表现十分满意，现在该由你应对盟军即将发起的法国登陆了。

en: We have been pleased with your performance on the Italian front and it is now time for you to counter the upcoming Allied invasion of France.
zh: 我们对你在意大利战线的表现十分满意，现在该由你应对盟军即将发起的法国登陆了。

en: Wacht am Rhein is our best chance to seize the initiative and force the Western Allies to make peace with us. It is essential that you capture all of your objectives by December 31st, or the Allies will be able to move overwhelming forces into the Ardennes to stop our offensive. Brussels is your ultimate objective, but capturing and holding a minimum of four objectives by December 31st could also affect the war favorably.
zh: 莱茵守望行动是我们夺取先手、迫使西线盟军与我方媾和的最佳机会。你必须在 12月31日前夺取全部目标，否则盟军将能调集压倒性兵力进入阿登，阻止我们的攻势。布鲁塞尔是你的最终目标，但若能在 12月31日前夺取并守住至少四个目标，也可能使战局朝有利方向发展。

en: Your attack on the Ardennes was a dismal failure. Not only did it fall far short of its ultimate goal of forcing the Allies to sue for peace, but the resources we wasted will no longer be available for the defense of the homeland.
zh: 你对阿登的进攻是一次惨败。它不仅远未达成迫使盟军求和这一最终目标，而且我们为此浪费的资源再也无法用于本土防御。

en: Your attack was quite an achievement considering the odds against you; unfortunately, it fell short of its ultimate aim of forcing the Allies to sue for peace.
zh: 考虑到敌我力量悬殊，你的进攻已是相当可观的战果；遗憾的是，它未能达成迫使盟军求和的最终目标。

en: Your attack was quite an achievement considering the odds against you; unfortunately, it fell short of its ultimate aim of forcing the Allies to sue for peace.
zh: 考虑到敌我力量悬殊，你的进攻已是相当可观的战果；遗憾的是，它未能达成迫使盟军求和的最终目标。

en: Your assault on Yugoslavia and Greece was blitzkrieg in its most powerful sense. Due to your spectacular success, we have decided to appoint you to command a very special operation.
zh: 你对南斯拉夫与希腊的进攻是闪击战最有力的体现。鉴于你取得的辉煌战果，我们决定委任你指挥一次极为特殊的行动。

en: Your next mission is to defeat the Yugoslav and Greek armies and force the British forever from the European mainland. You should capture your objectives by April 30th so that our upcoming invasion of Russia is not delayed. If you are able to complete your mission earlier, we may honor you with the command of our planned airborne assault on Crete.
zh: 你的下一项任务是击败南斯拉夫与希腊军队，把英国人永远逐出欧洲大陆。你应在 4月30日前夺取各项目标，以免我们即将发动的对俄进攻被拖延。若能提前完成任务，我们或将委你指挥计划中的克里特空降突击，以为嘉奖。

en: We were very disappointed with your performance in Yugoslavia and Greece. It is time for you to prove that you are worthy to be a Panzer General.
zh: 你在南斯拉夫与希腊的表现令我们非常失望。现在该由你证明自己配得上装甲元帅这一称号。

en: Your successful assault on Yugoslavia and Greece will allow us to begin an invasion of Russia without fearing an attack on our flank from the Balkans.
zh: 你对南斯拉夫与希腊的成功进攻，使我们得以在不必担心巴尔干方向侧翼受攻击的情况下发动对俄进攻。

en: Your successful assault on Yugoslavia and Greece will allow us to begin an invasion of Russia without fearing an attack on our flank from the Balkans.
zh: 你对南斯拉夫与希腊的成功进攻，使我们得以在不必担心巴尔干方向侧翼受攻击的情况下发动对俄进攻。

If you are able to complete your mission earlier, we may honor you with the command of our planned airborne assault on Crete.
