en: Your successful assault on Yugoslavia and Greece will allow us to begin an invasion of Russia without fearing an attack on our flank from the Balkans.
zh: 你对南斯拉夫与希腊的成功进攻，使我们得以在不必担心巴尔干方向侧翼受攻击的情况下发动对俄进攻。

en: Your smashing success in overrunning the Russian frontier armies and taking Smolensk proves that yet again that you are the premier Panzer General in the world.
zh: 你碾压俄国边境各集团军并夺取斯摩棱斯克的辉煌胜利，再次证明你是世界上最杰出的装甲元帅。

en: The invasion of Russia will be the largest military operation in history. Your army will spearhead Army Group Center's initial thrust into Russia. You must seize all of your objectives, including the main target of Smolensk, by August 6th. An earlier completion of your mission could allow us to begin the attack on Moscow before the onset of the autumn rain and the winter slows our advance. Rapid and decisive success will be the key to the entire War in the East.
zh: 对俄国的入侵将是有史以来规模最大的军事行动。你的集团军将作为中央集团军群首轮突入俄国的先锋。你必须在 8月6日前夺取全部目标，其中包括主要目标斯摩棱斯克。若能提前完成任务，我们就有可能在秋季降雨与冬季迟滞我军推进之前发起对莫斯科的进攻。迅速而决定性的胜利将是整个东线战事的关键。

en: We were pleased with your initial success in driving deep into Russia.
zh: 你初期深入俄国的战果令我们满意。

en: We were pleased with your initial success in driving deep into Russia.
zh: 你初期深入俄国的战果令我们满意。

en: The war in the east has not gone well. The Soviets have proven to be unstoppable, and are now advancing across German soil. You must stop them and push them back along the entire front by taking all objectives, however, if you can hold onto a minimum of six objectives, we may be able to obtain tolerable armistice terms. This is the final battle; you face either death or glory.
zh: 东线战事进展不利。苏军已被证明无法阻挡，如今正越过德国本土推进。你必须夺取全部目标，在全线阻止他们并将其击退；不过，你若能守住至少六个目标，我们或许还能争取到尚可接受的停战条件。这是最后一战；你面临的不是死亡就是荣耀。

en: Your inability to defend Germany has led to our total destruction. Although you fought well in many battles, we have, in the end, lost everything.
zh: 你无力保卫德国，导致我们彻底毁灭。尽管你在许多战斗中打得很好，我们最终还是失去了一切。

en: Things have not gone well in the west. The allies have proven to be unstoppable, and are now advancing across German soil. You must stop them and push them back along the entire front by taking all objectives. If you can hold onto a minimum of six objectives, we may be able to obtain tolerable armistice terms. This is the final battle; you face either death or glory.
zh: 西线形势不利。盟军已被证明无法阻挡，如今正越过德国本土推进。你必须夺取全部目标，在全线阻止他们并将其击退。你若能守住至少六个目标，我们或许还能争取到尚可接受的停战条件。这是最后一战；你面临的不是死亡就是荣耀。

en: Your inability to defend Germany has led to our total destruction. Although you fought well in many battles, we have, in the end, lost everything.
zh: 你无力保卫德国，导致我们彻底毁灭。尽管你在许多战斗中打得很好，我们最终还是失去了一切。

en: Although you were unable to expel the invaders, your defense of Germany was sufficiently resolute to persuade the allies to grant us an armistice, similar to the unpopular one signed in 1918.
zh: 虽然你未能将入侵者逐出，但你对德国的防御足够坚决，使盟军同意给予我们停战，其性质类似 1918年签订的那份不受欢迎的停战协定。

en: Thanks for playing the 1939 campaign for Open Panzer General
zh: 感谢试玩 Open Panzer General 1939 战役

en: Although you were unable to expel the invaders, your defense of Germany was sufficiently resolute to persuade the allies to grant us an armistice, similar to the unpopular one signed in 1918.
zh: 虽然你未能将入侵者逐出，但你对德国的防御足够坚决，使盟军同意给予我们停战，其性质类似 1918年签订的那份不受欢迎的停战协定。

en: Thanks for playing the 1939 campaign for Open Panzer General
zh: 感谢试玩 Open Panzer General 1939 战役

en: Your great victory is reminiscent of your early blitzkriegs through Europe. We have forced the Soviets to make a separate peace with favorable terms. We must now focus our resources on fighting off the American and British armies.
zh: 你的伟大胜利令人想起你早年的欧洲闪击战。我们已迫使苏联以有利条件单独媾和。现在我们必须集中资源抗击美英军队。

en: We have moved your troops into Hungary and it is time for you to lead Operation Waldteufel, the attack to retake Budapest. You must take all of your objectives by March 25th at the latest. However, an earlier completion of your mission is necessary if we are to continue the counteroffensive and drive the Soviets back to Russia.
zh: 我们已将你的部队调入匈牙利，现在该由你指挥「森林魔鬼」行动（Operation Waldteufel），即夺回布达佩斯的进攻。你最迟必须在 3月25日前夺取全部目标。但若我们要继续反攻、把苏联人赶回俄国，就必须更早完成任务。

en: Your defeat has allowed the Russians to continue their advance threatening our very existence.  Your services are no longer needed.
zh: 你的失败使苏军得以继续推进，威胁到我们的生存。你的职务已不再需要。

en: Your victory has helped delay the Russian advance, but it was insufficient to keep them from continuing their attacks.
zh: 你的胜利有助于迟滞苏军的推进，但不足以阻止他们继续进攻。

en: Your victory has helped delay the Russian advance, but it was insufficient to keep them from continuing their attacks.
zh: 你的胜利有助于迟滞苏军的推进，但不足以阻止他们继续进攻。

en: Your outstanding victory near Warsaw defending against the Soviet juggernaut has helped us keep the Soviets at bay for another year.
zh: 你在华沙附近抗击苏联庞然大物的卓越胜利，帮助我们又把苏联人挡住了一年。

en: The Russians are about to unleash a massive attack aimed at the center of our line. It is up to you to fight against overwhelming odds and keep the Russians from taking Warsaw by August 29th. If possible, hold Warsaw and at least two other objectives until after then and we may yet have an opportunity to reverse the tide of this war.
zh: 苏军即将发起一场针对我战线中央的大规模进攻。你要以绝对劣势的兵力迎战，阻止苏军在 8月29日前夺取华沙。如有可能，在此之后仍守住华沙以及至少另外两个目标，我们或许还有机会扭转这场战争的局势。

en: We were very disappointed with your inability to stop their forces, and unfortuately, they continue to push us back and threaten our very existence.  You have been relieved of duty.
zh: 你无力阻止敌军，令我们极为失望；不幸的是，他们继续把我们逼退，威胁到我们的生存。你已被解除职务。

en: Your solid performance near Warsaw against the Soviet juggernaut has helped us keep the Russians at bay for another year.
zh: 你在华沙附近抗击苏联庞然大物的稳健表现，帮助我们又把苏军挡住了一年。

en: Your solid performance near Warsaw against the Soviet juggernaut has helped us keep the Russians at bay for another year.
zh: 你在华沙附近抗击苏联庞然大物的稳健表现，帮助我们又把苏军挡住了一年。

en: An exceptional victory in the Caucasus, but unfortunately, the Soviet winter offensives have forced us back along the entire front, putting us in an extremely difficult position. We must now plan accordingly.
zh: 高加索之战是一次非凡的胜利，但不幸的是，苏军的冬季攻势已迫使我们在全线后退，使我们陷入极其困难的处境。我们现在必须相应调整计划。

en: Thanks in large part to your past success in Africa, you now have an opportunity to deal the Russians a critical blow. You must complete the upcoming campaign by November 26th at the latest. The fate of the war in the east is in your hands.
zh: 很大程度上由于你此前在非洲的战绩，你现在有机会给苏军一次决定性打击。你最迟必须在 11月26日前完成即将展开的战役。东线战争的命运掌握在你手中。

en: Your failure in the Caucasus has put us in an extremely difficult position. The Soviet winter offensives have forced us back all along the front. You are being re-assigned.
zh: 你在高加索的失败使我们陷入极其困难的处境。苏军的冬季攻势已迫使我们在全线后退。你将被调任他职。

en: Despite acheiving a satisfactory outcome in the Caucasus, the Soviet winter offensives have forced us back along the entire front, putting us in an extremely difficult position. We must now plan accordingly.
zh: 尽管在高加索取得了令人满意的战果，苏军的冬季攻势仍迫使我们全线后退，使我们陷入极其困难的处境。我们现在必须相应调整计划。

en: An exceptional victory in the Caucasus, but unfortunately, the Soviet winter offensives have forced us back along the entire front, putting us in an extremely difficult position. We must now plan accordingly.
zh: 高加索之战是一次非凡的胜利，但不幸的是，苏军的冬季攻势已迫使我们在全线后退，使我们陷入极其困难的处境。我们现在必须相应调整计划。

en: We are preparing for operations next year against the British in North Africa as well as against Yugoslavia and Greece. Your performance to date has been outstanding and we will be happy to allow you to choose your next operation for yourself and your army.
zh: 我们正在筹划明年对北非英军以及对南斯拉夫和希腊的作战。你迄今的表现十分出色，我们乐于让你为自己和你的部队选择下一个作战方向。

en: Would you prefer to fight next in North Africa or in the Balkans?
zh: 你愿意接下来在北非作战，还是在巴尔干作战？

en: England now lies open to invasion, ensuring total victory on the western front. The invasion is planned to occur on September 1st, but a debate at the highest level of government is in progress. Some believe that we should invade Spain in order to take Gibraltar and thus free the Italian Navy to assist us against the powerful British Navy. Others believe this to be unnecessary and they are winning the argument. Your opinion could influence the outcome of this key decision. The assistance of the Italian Fleet could be the difference in the upcoming invasion, but it may come at the cost of some of your prestige.
zh: 英格兰现已门户洞开，可实施入侵，从而确保西线的全面胜利。入侵计划于 9月1日发起，但政府最高层正就此展开争论。一些人认为我们应入侵西班牙，夺取直布罗陀，从而使意大利海军腾出手来协助我们对强大的英国海军作战。另一些人认为此举没有必要，而且他们的意见正占上风。你的看法可能影响这一关键决策的结果。意大利舰队的协助可能成为即将到来的入侵中的决定性因素，但也许会以你的一部分声望为代价。

en: Do you want to spend 300 prestige to secure Gibralter and the help of the Italian Navy?
zh: 你是否愿意花费 300 点声望以确保夺取直布罗陀并获得意大利海军的协助？

en: We have reached a critical juncture in our war in Russia. Many generals believe that we should divert your forces to assist Army Group South in its drive to capture Kiev. There does appear to be an opportunity to trap and destroy a large part of the Soviet Army in this area. Other generals believe we should ignore the south and instead send your forces driving directly toward Moscow as soon as supplies can be brought forward, in order to reach there before winter. They believe a move toward Kiev will delay the drive on Moscow and may cause us to fail at the city gates. It appears that high command is leaning toward a drive on Kiev. Your opinion on this matter could sway their decision toward Moscow, but it would surely cost you some of your prestige to voice your opinion regarding such a key decision.
zh: 我们在俄国的战争已到关键时刻。许多将领认为，我们应把你这支部队转用于协助南方集团军群攻取基辅。这一地区看来确实有机会围歼苏军的大部兵力。另一些将领则认为，我们应放弃南线，一俟补给前送就令你的部队直取莫斯科，以求在冬季到来前抵达该城。他们认为转向基辅会迟滞对莫斯科的进攻，可能使我军功败垂成于城下。目前看来，最高统帅部倾向于进攻基辅。你对这一问题的看法可能使他们的决定转向莫斯科，但就如此关键的决策发表意见，必定会使你损失一部分声望。

en: Would you like to spend 300 of your prestige points to convince high command to allow you to avoid an attack on Kiev and instead continue your drive to Moscow?
zh: 你是否愿意花费 300 点声望，说服最高统帅部允许你放弃进攻基辅，转而继续向莫斯科推进？

en: We are preparing for operations next year against the British in North Africa as well as against Yugoslavia and Greece. Your performance to date has been outstanding and we will be happy to allow you to choose your next operation for yourself and your army.
zh: 我们正在筹划明年对北非英军以及对南斯拉夫和希腊的作战。你迄今的表现十分出色，我们乐于让你为自己和你的部队选择下一个作战方向。

en: Would you prefer to fight next in North Africa or in the Balkans?
zh: 你愿意接下来在北非作战，还是在巴尔干作战？

en: Your success last summer in slowing the Allied breakout from Normandy has convinced us that you are the most qualified general to lead our upcoming counterattack in the Ardennes.
zh: 你去年夏天成功迟滞了盟军自诺曼底的突破，这使我们确信，你是率领我们即将在阿登发起反攻的最合适将领。

en: The Allies have now built up their forces and are about to unleash Operation Cobra, their attempt to break out of the Norman hedgerows once and for all. Your mission is to keep the Allies from pushing far into France until after August 18th. To do this, you should hold Rouen, Evreux, Alencon, and Laval, but at a minimum you must maintain control of at least two of these cities.
zh: 盟军现已完成集结，即将发起「眼镜蛇」行动，企图一举突破诺曼底树篱地带。你的任务是阻止盟军在 8月18日之前深入法国腹地。为此，你应守住鲁昂、埃夫勒、阿朗松和拉瓦勒，但至少必须控制其中两座城市。

en: Your defense of France was disappointing, however, due to your previous successes, we have decided to allow you to honorably retire from service.
zh: 你在法国的防御令人失望，但鉴于你此前的战功，我们决定允许你体面地退出现役。

en: Your defense of France was disappointing and has allowed the Allies to race across the countryside. Your leadership must soon improve.
zh: 你在法国的防御令人失望，使盟军得以在乡野间长驱直入。你的指挥很快必须有所改观。

en: Despite your valiant effort in slowing the breakout from Normandy, the Allies continue to race across the countryside.
zh: 尽管你为迟滞诺曼底方向的突破英勇作战，盟军仍在乡野间长驱直入。

en: Your victory on Crete will go down in history as a military masterpiece. Your reputation within the army is unequaled. It is for this reason that we have given the key role in the invasion of Russia and the extra resources merited by your prestige.
zh: 你在克里特的胜利将作为军事杰作载入史册。你在军中的声望无人能及。正因如此，我们把入侵俄国的关键任务以及与你声望相称的额外资源交给了你。

en: The assault on Crete will be the largest airborne drop ever attempted. It is up to you to lead the airborne attack and capture airfields in Crete so that your main forces can aid the invasion by both sea and air to crush the Allies on the island. You must ultimately secure all of the objectives on Crete by June 1st at the latest. In order to ensure that our forces are optimally prepared for the upcoming invasion of Russia, a much earlier success is desirable.
zh: 对克里特的突击将是有史以来规模最大的空降行动。由你指挥这次空降进攻，夺取克里特的机场，以便我主力部队从海空两路支援入侵，粉碎岛上的盟军。你最迟必须在 6月1日前夺取克里特的全部目标。为确保我军能以最佳状态准备即将到来的入侵俄国之战，更早取胜则更为理想。

en: We were very disappointed that you were unable to complete your mission on Crete successfully. You are to report back to Berlin for re-assignment.
zh: 你未能成功完成克里特岛上的任务，我们极为失望。着你回柏林报到，另行分配职务。

en: Your victory on Crete adds yet another successful campaign to your resume. Your next assignment will be critical to your career and to the cause of the war.
zh: 你在克里特的胜利为你的履历再添一次成功的战役。你的下一项任务对你的前程和战争大局都至关重要。

en: Your victory on Crete adds yet another successful campaign to your resume. Your next assignment will be critical to your career and to the cause of the war.
zh: 你在克里特的胜利为你的履历再添一次成功的战役。你的下一项任务对你的前程和战争大局都至关重要。

en: Your defense of Normandy was outstanding.
zh: 你对诺曼底的防御表现出色。

en: Operation Overlord will be the largest amphibious invasion ever seen by man, and you must stop it. You should strive to pin the Allies in Normandy by holding St. Lo, Caen, St. Mere Eglise, and Cherbourg until after July 5th when we hope reinforcements will arrive and throw the Allies back into the sea. At a minimum, hold at least one of these key towns.
zh: 「霸王」行动将是有史以来规模最大的两栖入侵，你必须阻止它。你应尽力把盟军钉在诺曼底，守住圣洛、卡昂、圣梅尔埃格利斯和瑟堡，直至 7月5日之后，届时我们希望增援到达，把盟军赶下海去。最低限度，也要守住其中至少一座要镇。

en: We were disappointed with your poor results in Normandy,  however, due to your previous successes, we have decided to allow you to honorably retire from service.
zh: 你在诺曼底战绩不佳，令我们失望；但鉴于你此前的战功，我们决定允许你体面地退出现役。

en: We were disappointed with your poor results in Normandy. Your performance must improve or the war will soon be lost.
zh: 你在诺曼底战绩不佳，令我们失望。你的表现必须有所改观，否则战争很快就要失败。

en: You put up a good fight in Normandy.
zh: 你在诺曼底打得很顽强。

en: Congratulations on your crushing victory over the Soviets, a triumph most impressive. Russia has surrendered! Now, America must be dealt with.
zh: 祝贺你对苏军取得的压倒性胜利，这是一场极为辉煌的胜利。俄国已经投降！现在必须对付美国。

en: You must take your objectives by no later than November 16th, but in order for us to ensure that we can hold Moscow in the face of a determined counterattack, you should strive to take Moscow several weeks earlier. This will no doubt be our best chance to win the War in the East.
zh: 你必须在11月16日之前夺取全部目标，但为确保我军能在敌军坚决反攻之下守住莫斯科，你应争取提前数周拿下莫斯科。这无疑将是我们赢得东线战争的最佳机会。

en: Your inability to capture your objectives in and around Moscow has led to disaster. The Soviet armies, reinforced by troops from Siberia, have wreaked havoc on our overextended and once-invincible armies. Fierce Soviet counterattacks this winter have pushed back our weary troops all along the front, you are dismissed.
zh: 你未能夺取莫斯科及其周边的目标，已导致灾难性后果。得到西伯利亚部队增援的苏军，对我军战线过长、曾号称无敌的军团造成了毁灭性打击。今冬苏军的猛烈反攻，已将我疲惫的部队全线击退。你被解职了。

en: Your successful capture of Moscow turned out to be short-lived. Soviet reinforcements from Siberia were able to push back our weary troops. Fierce Soviet counterattacks have weakened our once invincible-armies.
zh: 你成功攻占莫斯科的战果未能持久。来自西伯利亚的苏军增援击退了我军疲惫的部队。苏军的猛烈反攻削弱了我军昔日无敌的军团。

en: Your successful capture of Moscow turned out to be short-lived. Soviet reinforcements from Siberia were able to push back our weary troops. Fierce Soviet counterattacks have weakened our once invincible-armies.
zh: 你成功攻占莫斯科的战果未能持久。来自西伯利亚的苏军增援击退了我军疲惫的部队。苏军的猛烈反攻削弱了我军昔日无敌的军团。

en: Your great success in Africa has not gone unnoticed by the high command, but unfortunately,we must now move some of our assets in order to strengthen our hold on Northwest Africa.
zh: 你在非洲的重大胜利已引起最高统帅部的注意，但遗憾的是，我们现在必须抽调部分兵力，以加强我们对西北非的控制。

en: After much ebb and flow, the African front has stabilized at Gazala. It is time for you to seize the initiative and drive the British out of Libya and Egypt. Your goal is to seize Cairo and all other objectives by September 30th. However, given the entry of the Americans in the war, it may be necessary to complete the conquest of Egypt earlier to prevent an American invasion of Northwest Africa.
zh: 经过反复拉锯，非洲前线已在加扎拉稳定下来。现在该由你夺取先手，将英军逐出利比亚和埃及。你的目标是在9月30日前夺取开罗及所有其他目标。但鉴于美国已参战，为阻止美军入侵西北非，可能有必要提前完成对埃及的征服。

en: We were very disappointed by your inability to take Cairo. This has given the Americans the perfect opportunity to invade Northwest Africa. You are being re-assigned.
zh: 你未能夺取开罗，令我们极为失望。这给了美国人入侵西北非的绝佳机会。你将被调任他职。

en: Although you were successful in taking Cairo, we must now move some of our assets in order to strengthen our hold on Northwest Africa.
zh: 尽管你成功夺取了开罗，我们现在仍必须抽调部分兵力，以加强我们对西北非的控制。

en: Although you were successful in taking Cairo, we must now move some of our assets in order to strengthen our hold on Northwest Africa.
zh: 尽管你成功夺取了开罗，我们现在仍必须抽调部分兵力，以加强我们对西北非的控制。

en: Congratulations on your outstanding victory in France. Our humiliation of 1918 is avenged.
zh: 祝贺你在法国取得的卓越胜利。1918年的屈辱已然洗雪。

en: All that stands between us and victory in the west is a quick knock-out blow against the disorganized allied armies in France. Your mission is to break the French 'will to resist' by taking Paris and all other objectives by no later than July 30th. However, due to the difficulties involved in preparing for an invasion of England, it is essential that you end this campaign much sooner if at all possible. Otherwise, the opportunity to invade England this summer will be lost. The upcoming battle for France is the most important campaign you have yet to participate in.
zh: 挡在我们与西线胜利之间的，只有一件事：迅速给法国境内混乱的盟军部队一记致命打击。你的任务是在7月30日之前夺取巴黎及所有其他目标，从而摧毁法国人的抵抗意志。但鉴于入侵英国的战备工作困难重重，你务必尽可能大幅提前结束本战役。否则，今夏入侵英国的机会将会丧失。即将开始的法国战役，是你迄今参与过的最重要的战役。

en: Congratulations on your victory in France. Our humiliation of 1918 is avenged.
zh: 祝贺你在法国取得的胜利。1918年的屈辱已然洗雪。

en: Congratulations on your early success in Italy. Unfortunately, the Allies have been able to fight their way onto the Italian mainland.
zh: 祝贺你在意大利取得的初期战果。遗憾的是，盟军还是杀上了意大利本土。

en: We now expect the Americans and British to launch an attack on Sicily and Southern Italy. At a minimum, you must put up a stubborn defense and hold at least three objectives until after September 8th. Ideally, you will hold at least ten objectives. Good luck, you will need it.
zh: 我们现在预计美英联军将对西西里和意大利南部发起进攻。你至少要顽强防守，将不少于三个目标坚守到9月8日之后。最理想的情况是守住至少十个目标。祝你好运，你会需要它的。

en: Your defense of the Italian mainland was satisfactory. To date, you have done a reasonable job defending Southern Italy, but unfortunately, the Allies have been able to fight their way onto the Italian mainland.
zh: 你对意大利本土的防御尚称合格。迄今为止，你对意大利南部的防守还算可以，但遗憾的是，盟军还是杀上了意大利本土。

en: Congratulations on your excellent defense of the Italian mainland. To date, you have done a good job defending Southern Italy. Unfortunately, the Allies have been able to fight their way onto the Italian mainland.
zh: 祝贺你对意大利本土的出色防御。迄今为止，你对意大利南部的防守做得很好。遗憾的是，盟军还是杀上了意大利本土。

en: Your victory at Kharkov was so quick and decisive that the Soviet forces became hopelessly disorganized. We have been able to keep them on the run ever since.
zh: 你在哈尔科夫的胜利如此迅速而果断，致使苏军陷入无可挽回的混乱。此后我们一直让他们疲于奔命。

en: It is imperative that we regain the initiative by launching a counterattack to retake Kharkov, a city recently taken by advancing Soviet armies. If you are able to retake Kharkov and all other objectives by March 14th, we should be in a position to launch a major offensive aimed at Kursk in the summer. An early victory at Kharkov will make it easier for us to overwhelm the Soviets when the weather turns warm again.
zh: 我们必须发起反攻、夺回哈尔科夫，以重夺先手——该城不久前被推进中的苏军攻占。如果你能在3月14日前夺回哈尔科夫及所有其他目标，我们就能在夏季对库尔斯克发动一场大规模攻势。哈尔科夫的早日胜利，将使我军在天气再度转暖后更容易压倒苏军。

en: Your leadership proved weak and uninspiring at Kharkov, and we were unable to regain the initiative. Another year of senseless fighting in Russia has come and gone.
zh: 你的指挥在哈尔科夫表现得软弱乏力、毫无锐气，我们未能重夺先手。俄国战场上又一年无谓的厮杀就此过去。

en: Your leadership proved weak and uninspiring at Kharkov, and we were unable to regain the initiative. Another year of senseless fighting in Russia has come and gone.
zh: 你的指挥在哈尔科夫表现得软弱乏力、毫无锐气，我们未能重夺先手。俄国战场上又一年无谓的厮杀就此过去。

en: Your victory at Kharkov has allowed us to regain the initiative. We must continue to press our attacks against the Soviets.
zh: 你在哈尔科夫的胜利使我们重夺先手。我们必须继续对苏军施加攻势。

en: Congratulations on your stunning success in the Ukraine. Many Soviet troops have been destroyed or have surrendered.
zh: 祝贺你在乌克兰取得的惊人胜利。大量苏军被歼灭或投降。

en: For weeks our troops have been stopped by Russian forces near Kiev. It is time for you to encircle and destroy their positions. You are hereby ordered to strike south toward Kiev and Lokhvitsa. Army Group South units, temporarily under your command, are to drive north and meet your forces, thus encircling the Russian armies. All of the objectives in your sector must be taken by September 19th in order for us to redeploy your troops in time for an attack on Moscow this year. An earlier completion of this battle can only enhance your prestige, and give you a better chance to obtain the resources you will need to capture Moscow.
zh: 数周以来，我军在基辅附近一直受阻于苏军。现在该由你将其阵地合围并歼灭。兹命令你向南进攻，直取基辅和洛赫维察。暂归你指挥的南方集团军群部队将向北推进，与你部会合，从而对苏军形成合围。你战区内的所有目标必须在9月19日前夺取，以便我们及时重新部署你的部队，用于今年对莫斯科的进攻。提前结束此战只会提升你的声望，并让你更有机会获得攻取莫斯科所需的资源。

en: Your successful conclusion of the battle for Kiev has been noted.
zh: 你成功结束基辅战役一事已记录在案。

en: Your successful conclusion of the battle for Kiev has been noted.
zh: 你成功结束基辅战役一事已记录在案。

en: Although you were able to take all of your objectives, and successfully fight off the Russian counterattack, unfortunately we lost the initiative on the eastern front, and must prepare to fight off the inevitable Soviet offensives that are coming.
zh: 尽管你成功夺取了全部目标，并击退了苏军的反攻，但遗憾的是，我们在东线失去了先手，必须准备迎击即将到来、不可避免的苏军攻势。

en: The time for Operation Citadel has come. You are to attack and destroy the Soviet forces in the Kursk salient. The seizure of several key cities behind the front lines (including Kursk) is the key to this battle. You must capture all of your objectives by July 24th. We must warn you that we expect massive Russian counterattacks in your sector to begin within ten days. If you are unable to take all of your objectives, you must at a minimum hold two objectives.
zh: 堡垒行动的时刻已经到来。你要进攻并歼灭库尔斯克突出部的苏军。夺取前线后方的若干重要城市（包括库尔斯克），是此战的关键。你必须在7月24日前夺取所有目标。必须提醒你，我们预计你所在战区将在十天内遭到苏军的大规模反攻。如果你无法夺取全部目标，至少必须守住两个目标。

en: We have lost the initiative on the eastern front.  Another year of senseless fighting in Russia has come and gone..
zh: 我们在东线失去了先手。俄国战场上又一年无谓的厮杀就此过去。

en: Although you were unable to take all of your objectives, you did successfully fight off the Russian counterattack. Unfortunately we lost the initiative on the eastern front, and another year of senseless fighting in Russia has come and gone.
zh: 尽管你未能夺取全部目标，但你成功击退了苏军的反攻。遗憾的是，我们在东线失去了先手，俄国战场上又一年无谓的厮杀就此过去。

en: Although you were unable to take all of your objectives, you did successfully fight off the Russian counterattack. Unfortunately we lost the initiative on the eastern front, and must now prepare to fight off the inevitable Soviet offensives that are coming.
zh: 尽管你未能夺取全部目标，但你成功击退了苏军的反攻。遗憾的是，我们在东线失去了先手，现在必须准备迎击即将到来、不可避免的苏军攻势。

en: Your blitzkrieg through Belgium was most impressive and has given us a great opportunity to conquer France in time for an assault on England this year.
zh: 你在比利时的闪击战极为出色，为我们及时征服法国、以便在今年进攻英国提供了绝佳机会。

en: We have given you the key role in the invasion of France. You are to annihilate the French, British and Belgian armies located west and north of the Ardennes. In order to ensure their destruction, the early capture of Paris, and the opportunity to invade England this summer,  you must advance to the English Channel and capture all of the objectives no later than June 8th. A swift blow, delivered to the Allied armies as soon as possible, is essential to allow us time for an invasion of England this year.
zh: 我们已把入侵法国的关键任务交给你。你要歼灭驻于阿登以西和以北的法国、英国和比利时军队。为确保将其歼灭、早日夺取巴黎，并获得今夏入侵英国的机会，你必须在6月8日之前推进至英吉利海峡并夺取所有目标。尽快对盟军部队施以迅猛一击，对我们争取时间、在今年内入侵英国至关重要。

en: Congratulations on completing your most recent campaign on schedule.
zh: 祝贺你按期完成了最近这次战役。

en: Congratulations on completing your most recent campaign on schedule.
zh: 祝贺你按期完成了最近这次战役。

en: Your performance in Holland was very good, but unfortunately,  we have still lost any ability to counterattack before the enemy's final assault on Germany.
zh: 你在荷兰的表现非常出色，但遗憾的是，在敌军对德国发动最后攻势之前，我们仍然丧失了任何反攻能力。

en: Your troops, now located in the Arnhem sector of Holland,  are fighting off a massive Allied attack aimed at securing a path across the many rivers and canals leading to the vital crossing of the Rhine at Arnhem. It is essential that you prevent the Allies from completing their plans. If the Allies secure Arnhem, they will be able to force their way into Germany this year before we can mount a strong counterattack.
zh: 你的部队目前位于荷兰阿纳姆地区，正在抗击盟军的大规模进攻。盟军此举意在打通一条穿越众多河流与运河的通路，以夺取阿纳姆的莱茵河关键渡口。你务必阻止盟军完成其计划。一旦盟军拿下阿纳姆，他们就能在我们组织起强大反攻之前，于今年突入德国境内。

en: Your performance in Holland was quite disappointing and because of it, we have lost any ability to counterattack before the enemy's final assault on Germany.
zh: 你在荷兰的表现相当令人失望，正因如此，在敌军对德国发动最后攻势之前，我们已丧失了任何反攻能力。

en: Your performance in Holland was quite disappointing and because of it, we have lost any ability to counterattack before the enemy's final assault on Germany.
zh: 你在荷兰的表现相当令人失望，正因如此，在敌军对德国发动最后攻势之前，我们已丧失了任何反攻能力。

en: Your great triumph in the Middle East has been acclaimed by all Germany.  We are planning a major offensive against Russia in the Caucasus early this summer. Our control of the Middle East will allow us to attack the Caucasus from both west and south.
zh: 你在中东的重大胜利赢得了全德国的赞誉。我们计划今年初夏在高加索方向对俄国发动一场大规模攻势。控制中东将使我们可以从西面和南面两个方向进攻高加索。

en: It is time for us to end British domination over the entire Middle East. If we succeed, we may be able to influence the war in Russia by opening a new invasion route through the Caucasus. Your many objectives in the Middle East must be taken before major British reinforcements are able to arrive this fall, or all gains may be lost. In any event, we expect you to take your objectives by November 15th at the latest.
zh: 现在是我们终结英国对整个中东统治的时候了。若能成功，我们或许可以通过开辟一条穿越高加索的新入侵路线来影响俄国战局。你必须在今年秋季英国大批增援抵达之前夺取中东的众多目标，否则一切战果都可能丧失。无论如何，我们期望你最迟于11月15日夺取各项目标。

en: Your failure in the Middle East has cost us dearly. British counterattacks have forced us to abandon Egypt, therefore we have no choice but to dismiss you.
zh: 你在中东的失败让我们付出了惨重代价。英军反攻迫使我们放弃埃及，因此我们别无选择，只能解除你的职务。

en: Your success to date has been noteworthy. Our control of the Middle East will allow us to attack the Caucasus from both west and south.
zh: 你迄今取得的成功值得称道。控制中东将使我们可以从西面和南面两个方向进攻高加索。

en: Your success to date has been noteworthy. Our control of the Middle East will allow us to attack the Caucasus from both west and south.
zh: 你迄今取得的成功值得称道。控制中东将使我们可以从西面和南面两个方向进攻高加索。

en: Your successful capture of Moscow turned out to be short-lived. Soviet reinforcements from Siberia were able to push back our weary troops. Fierce Soviet counterattacks have weakened our once invincible-armies.
zh: 你对莫斯科的成功占领事实证明只是短暂的。来自西伯利亚的苏军增援得以击退我们疲惫的部队。苏军的猛烈反攻削弱了我们曾经不可战胜的军队。

en: The time has come for the decisive battle of 1941. The Soviets have marshalled their troops to defend Moscow the economic and political key to Russia. It is time for you to hurl your forces at Moscow. You must break through their defenses and take Moscow before the combination of winter weather and Siberian reinforcements can steal the initiative. If Moscow can be taken and held this winter, the Soviets will undoubtedly surrender.
zh: 1941年决定性会战的时刻已经到来。苏军已集结兵力保卫莫斯科，此地是俄国经济与政治的关键所在。现在，该由你把部队投向莫斯科了。你必须突破他们的防御，在冬季天气与西伯利亚增援夺走先手之前拿下莫斯科。若能在这个冬季攻占并守住莫斯科，苏联无疑将会投降。

en: Your inability to capture your objectives in and around Moscow has led to disaster. The Soviet armies, reinforced by troops from Siberia, have wreaked havoc on our overextended and once-invincible armies. Fierce Soviet counterattacks this winter have pushed back our weary troops all along the front, you are dismissed.
zh: 你无力夺取莫斯科城内及周边的目标，已导致灾难。得到西伯利亚部队增援的苏军，对我过度伸展、曾经不可战胜的军队造成了巨大破坏。这个冬季苏军的猛烈反攻将我们疲惫的部队沿整条战线击退，你被解职了。

en: Our quick success in North Africa has allowed us to expel the British from Egypt and secure the Suez Canal.
zh: 我们在北非的迅速胜利使我们得以将英国人逐出埃及，并确保苏伊士运河。

en: It is time for you to teach the British a lesson in desert warfare. You are to take all of your objectives, including Tobruk and Mersah Matruh, and thus clear the road to Cairo by June 30th. Earlier success could prove decisive, as the British presence on Malta is likely to make our supply situation in North Africa increasingly precarious.
zh: 现在是你给英国人上一堂沙漠战课的时候了。你须夺取包括托布鲁克与马特鲁港在内的所有目标，从而在6月30日前打通通往开罗的道路。更早取得成功可能具有决定性意义，因为英军在马耳他的存在很可能使我军在北非的补给状况日益岌岌可危。

en: Although your objectives were taken, RAF squadrons that arrived on Malta during the last half of June have prevented an advance on Cairo.
zh: 尽管各项目标均已夺取，但6月下半月抵达马耳他的皇家空军中队阻止了我军向开罗推进。

en: Our quick success in North Africa has allowed us to expel the British from Egypt and secure the Suez Canal.
zh: 我们在北非的迅速胜利使我们得以将英国人逐出埃及，并确保苏伊士运河。

en: It is time for you to teach the British a lesson in desert warfare. You are to take all of your objectives, including Tobruk and Mersah Matruh, and thus clear the road to Cairo by June 30th. Earlier success could prove decisive, as the British presence on Malta is likely to make our supply situation in North Africa increasingly precarious.
zh: 现在是你给英国人上一堂沙漠战课的时候了。你须夺取包括托布鲁克与马特鲁港在内的所有目标，从而在6月30日前打通通往开罗的道路。更早取得成功可能具有决定性意义，因为英军在马耳他的存在很可能使我军在北非的补给状况日益岌岌可危。

en: Although your objectives were taken, RAF squadrons that arrived on Malta during the last half of June have prevented an advance on Cairo.
zh: 尽管各项目标均已夺取，但6月下半月抵达马耳他的皇家空军中队阻止了我军向开罗推进。

en: The General Staff commends you for your outstanding achievements in Norway.
zh: 总参谋部对你在挪威的卓越成就予以嘉奖。

en: For your excellent leadership, you have been appointed as the commander of our combined land, naval, and air assault on Norway, code named Operation Weserubung. Your goal is to capture all objectives in southern and central Norway by May 3rd. Your forces must be free to redeploy for the upcoming campaign in France which is slated to begin May 10th. You should complete your mission as early as you can. This will allow us a greater chance to rest, refit and upgrade your troops prior to the invasion of France.
zh: 鉴于你出色的领导才能，你已被任命为对挪威陆海空联合突击的指挥官，此次行动代号威悉演习行动。你的目标是在5月3日前夺取挪威南部与中部的所有目标。你的部队必须能够自由重新部署，以参加定于5月10日开始的法国战役。你应尽早完成任务。这将使我们有更大机会在入侵法国之前让部队休整、整补与升级。

en: We are disappointed with your failure to take your objectives in Norway. However, due to your previous success we are willing to overlook your mistakes in Norway and give you another chance to prove you are worthy of command.
zh: 我们对你在挪威未能夺取目标感到失望。不过，鉴于你此前的功绩，我们愿意不计较你在挪威的失误，再给你一次机会，以证明你无愧于指挥之职。

en: Congratulations on meeting your objectives in Norway.
zh: 祝贺你完成了在挪威的各项目标。

en: Congratulations on meeting your objectives in Norway.
zh: 祝贺你完成了在挪威的各项目标。

en: Your success in phase one of the attack on Poland was outstanding. Due to your rapid advance, their defenses have been thrown into disarray, leaving the road to Warsaw wide open.
zh: 你在进攻波兰第一阶段的表现极为出色。由于你推进迅速，敌军防御已陷入混乱，通往华沙的道路已完全敞开。

en: Your first mission in Operation Fall Weiss, the conquest of Poland, is to capture the key cities of Kutno and Lodz by September 10th. This keeps open the possibility of conquering Poland before the French and British can launch an attack on Germany. If these objectives are taken before September 10th, additional forces may be available to you for the assault on Warsaw.
zh: 你在征服波兰的白色方案行动中的首个任务，是在9月10日前夺取库特诺与罗兹这两座重要城市。这使我们在法国与英国对德国发动进攻之前征服波兰的可能性依然存在。若能在9月10日前夺取这些目标，可能会有更多部队可供你用于进攻华沙。

en: Congratulations on completing your mission satisfactorily.
zh: 祝贺你令人满意地完成了任务。

en: Congratulations on completing your mission satisfactorily.
zh: 祝贺你令人满意地完成了任务。

en: Congratulations on your stunning victory. England has surrendered and the war in the west is now over. Now, the war in the east will begin. While you and your army rested, we conquered Yugoslavia and Greece. You should now be ready to play a key role in Barbarossa, the assault on Russia.
zh: 祝贺你取得这场辉煌的胜利。英国已经投降，西线战事至此结束。现在，东线的战争即将开始。在你和你的部队休整期间，我们已征服南斯拉夫与希腊。你现在应当准备好，在进攻俄国的巴巴罗萨行动中发挥关键作用。

en: Your next mission is to invade England. You must seize London and all other objectives in England before our limited shipping and the storms in the English Channel force us to withdraw our invasion forces. High command has given you until September 30th to complete your mission, but we fear that you must succeed sooner or we will see the invasion falter before the British surrender. Operation Sealion is about to begin. Good Luck!
zh: 你的下一个任务是入侵英国。你必须在我们的有限海运能力与英吉利海峡的风暴迫使我们撤回入侵部队之前，夺取伦敦以及英格兰境内的所有其他目标。最高统帅部给了你到9月30日的时间完成任务，但我们担心你必须更早取胜，否则入侵行动会在英国投降之前便难以为继。海狮行动即将开始。祝你好运！

en: Congratulations on your stunning victory. England has surrendered and the war in the west is now over. Now, the war in the east will begin. While you and your army rested, we conquered Yugoslavia and Greece. You should now be ready to play a key role in Barbarossa, the assault on Russia.
zh: 祝贺你取得这场辉煌的胜利。英格兰已经投降，西线战事至此结束。接下来，东线的战争即将开始。在你和你的部队休整期间，我们已征服了南斯拉夫和希腊。现在你应当准备好，在巴巴罗萨——对俄国的进攻——中发挥关键作用。

en: Gibraltar has been taken and the Italian Fleet has sailed toward England. Your mission is to take London and the Industrial Heart of England before our limited shipping and storms in the English Channel force us to withdraw our invasion. High command has given you until September 30th to complete your mission, but we fear that you must succeed sooner or we will see the invasion falter before the British surrender. Operation Sealion is about to begin. Good Luck!
zh: 直布罗陀已被攻占，意大利舰队已驶向英格兰。你的任务是夺取伦敦以及英格兰的工业心脏地带，必须在我们有限的航运能力与英吉利海峡的风暴迫使我们撤出入侵部队之前完成。统帅部给你完成任务的期限是9月30日，但我们担心你必须更早取胜，否则入侵将在英国人投降之前便告夭折。海狮行动即将开始。祝好运！

en: Your storming of Sevastopol will be recognized as one of history's greatest assaults against a fortress.
zh: 你对塞瓦斯托波尔的强攻，将被公认为历史上最伟大的要塞攻坚作战之一。

en: Sevastopol, home of the Soviet Black Sea Fleet, must be taken so that we can begin our upcoming campaign in the Ukraine and the Caucasus without a major enemy fortress threatening our right flank. Sevastopol has been under siege and has been pounded by air and artillery for 5 straight days, but you should expect the entrenchments and forts you attack to be the toughest you have ever faced in the war. You must take Sevastopol and the surrounding objectives by no later than June 23rd or our offensive in the south will be compromised. An earlier completion of your mission will only make it easier to prevail over the Soviets later this year.
zh: 塞瓦斯托波尔是苏联黑海舰队的基地，必须将其攻占，我们才能在没有敌军大型要塞威胁右翼的情况下，展开即将在乌克兰和高加索进行的战役。塞瓦斯托波尔已被围困，并连续5天遭受空中与炮火的打击，但你应当预料到，你所攻击的工事与要塞将是这场战争中你面对过的最坚固的防御。你必须在6月23日之前夺取塞瓦斯托波尔及周边目标，否则我们在南方的攻势将受到牵制。任务越早完成，今年晚些时候压制苏联人就越容易。

en: Your capture of Sevastopol on schedule deserves praise for a job well done.
zh: 你按期攻克塞瓦斯托波尔，任务完成出色，值得嘉奖。

en: Your capture of Sevastopol on schedule deserves praise for a job well done.
zh: 你按期攻克塞瓦斯托波尔，任务完成出色，值得嘉奖。

zh: 你按期攻克塞瓦斯托波尔，任务完成出色，值得嘉奖。

en: An exceptional victory at Stalingrad, but unfortunately, the Soviet winter offensives have forced us back along the entire front, putting us in an extremely difficult position. We must now plan accordingly.
zh: 斯大林格勒一役取得了非凡的胜利，但遗憾的是，苏联人的冬季攻势已迫使我们在整条战线上后退，使我方陷入极为困难的境地。我们现在必须据此重新筹划。

en: You must complete the upcoming campaign by November 26th at the latest. The fate of the war in the east is in your hands.
zh: 你必须在11月26日之前完成即将展开的战役。东线战事的命运掌握在你手中。

en: Although you were able to capture Stalingrad, the Soviet winter offensives have forced us back along the entire front.
zh: 尽管你得以攻克斯大林格勒，但苏联人的冬季攻势已迫使我们在整条战线上后退。

en: Although you were able to capture Stalingrad, the Soviet winter offensives have forced us back along the entire front.
zh: 尽管你得以攻克斯大林格勒，但苏联人的冬季攻势已迫使我们在整条战线上后退。

en: Your success holding back the Allied invasion force was an inspiration to the Wehrmacht. Unfortunately, we were unable to stop their final reoccupation of Africa.
zh: 你成功遏止盟军入侵部队，令国防军深受鼓舞。遗憾的是，我们未能阻止他们最终重新占领非洲。

en: You must help defend Tunisia so that we can maintain a position in North West Africa. If you can hold Tunis and at least two other objectives until well into March, will almost certainly cause a delay in future Allied operations.
zh: 你必须协助防守突尼斯，以便我们在西北非保持一个立足点。如果你能守住突尼斯城以及至少另外两个目标直到3月过半，几乎肯定会使盟军日后的行动受到拖延。

en: Your successful delaying action in Africa was helpful in slowing the Allies. Unfortunately, we were unable to stop their final reoccupation.
zh: 你在非洲卓有成效的迟滞作战有助于延缓盟军的推进。遗憾的是，我们未能阻止他们最终的重新占领。

en: Your successful delaying action in Africa was helpful in slowing the Allies. Unfortunately, we were unable to stop their final reoccupation.
zh: 你在非洲卓有成效的迟滞作战有助于延缓盟军的推进。遗憾的是，我们未能阻止他们最终的重新占领。

en: Your success in Poland has impressed the General Staff.
zh: 你在波兰的胜利给总参谋部留下了深刻印象。

en: Your next assignment is to take Warsaw and several nearby Polish cities by no later than September 30th. Intelligence warns us that the French and British are preparing for an attack towards the Rhine within 2-3 weeks, so it is important to take all of your objectives as soon as possible.
zh: 你的下一个任务是夺取华沙以及附近数座波兰城市，期限不得晚于9月30日。情报部门警告我们，法国和英国正准备在2至3周内向莱茵河方向发动进攻，因此尽快夺取全部目标至关重要。

en: The General Staff is pleased by your success in Poland.
zh: 总参谋部对你的波兰战果感到满意。

en: The General Staff is pleased by your success in Poland.
zh: 总参谋部对你的波兰战果感到满意。

en: Your early capture of Washington has forced the surrender of the United States before they could successfully test an atomic bomb. North America and Europe have been successfully united under common leadership and all the other nations of the world are courting German favor. The world is at peace.Your brilliant leadership throughout this war ranks you among the greatest generals that have ever lived, and you will be remembered as the greatest Panzer General in history.
zh: 你提前攻占华盛顿，迫使美国在其成功试爆原子弹之前投降。北美与欧洲已在共同领导之下成功统一，世界其余各国纷纷向德国示好。世界恢复了和平。你在这场战争全程中展现的卓越指挥，使你跻身有史以来最伟大的将领之列，人们将铭记你是历史上最伟大的装甲元帅。

en: Thanks for playing the 1939 campaign for Open Panzer General
zh: 感谢游玩 Open Panzer General 的 1939年战役

en: Dateline Berlin - August 15, 1945. The war is over. A peace agreement between the United States and Germany is signed. Our armed forces failure to capture Washington, D.C., and the use by the United States on August 6th of an atomic bomb are the reasons cited for the peace accord. We are pleased peace has come but are sorry to report that the commander of the invasion forces is confirmed killed alongside his troops in the atomic explosion. He will long be remembered as one of history's greatest military minds in the hearts of our people for his contribution to peace.
zh: 柏林电——1945年8月15日。战争结束了。美国与德国签署和平协定。据称，和约的达成，缘于我军未能攻占华盛顿特区，以及美国于8月6日使用了原子弹。和平降临，我们感到欣慰，但遗憾地报告：入侵部队司令已确认与他的部队一同殒命于原子爆炸之中。为了他对和平的贡献，我们的民众将长久铭记他是历史上最伟大的军事英才之一。

en: Your capture of Washington has allowed us to negotiate a favorable peace treaty with the Americans. But, their ability to create and test an atomic bomb has kept us from uniting North America and Europe. Your brilliant leadership throughout this war will long be remembered in the coming years of peace.
zh: 你攻占华盛顿，使我们得以与美国人谈判达成一项有利的和约。但是，他们制造并试爆原子弹的能力，使我们未能把北美与欧洲统一起来。你在这场战争全程中展现的卓越指挥，将在未来的和平岁月里长久为人们所铭记。

en: Europe is now united under German leadership. You have achieved the success that Napoleon only dreamed of. Now it is time for you to end the war. The Americans have long thought themselves secure because of the vastness of the oceans washing their shores. But, your initial landings in Delaware and Maryland have shaken popular confidence. They have mustered their forces to defend their capital and you must crush the defenders and seize all your objectives in and around Washington, D.C. by August 15th at the latest. Confidentially, we have reports that the US is constructing a super weapon that could totally reverse the course of this war. This weapon may be available as early as mid-July so it is imperative that you force an American surrender as early as possible.
zh: 欧洲现已在德国领导下统一。你取得了拿破仑当年只能梦想的成就。现在，该由你来结束这场战争了。美国人一向自恃两洋浩瀚、海水环抱其海岸而高枕无忧。但是，你在特拉华和马里兰的初期登陆已经动摇了民众的信心。他们已集结兵力保卫首都，你必须击溃守军，至迟于8月15日夺取华盛顿特区城内及周边的全部目标。据机密报告，美国正在研制一种可能彻底扭转战局的超级武器。这种武器最早可能在7月中旬投入使用，因此你必须尽早迫使美国投降。

en: The game is designed to be played with 250% Prestige on both sides and the manual House Rules below:-
zh: 本游戏设定为双方均以 250% 声望值进行，并遵循以下手工房规：

en: Russians Production: Limited to only 2 of the same type of any Russian unit on the map at any one time except for unlimited normal Regular Infanty. (Automatically added Reinforcements dont count).
zh: 俄军生产：地图上同一时间，任意型号的俄军单位最多只能有 2 个，普通正规步兵不受此限。（自动加入的增援不计入）。

en: Germans Production: Limited to only 1 of the same type of any German unit on the map at any one time except for unlimited normal Regular Infantry.(Automatically added Reinforcements dont count).
zh: 德军生产：地图上同一时间，任意型号的德军单位最多只能有 1 个，普通正规步兵不受此限。（自动加入的增援不计入）。

en: Deployment Speed:   Limited to deploying only 1 ground unit from each Supply Hex owned per turn. Air units have unlimited deployment per turn from Airfields as per normal.
zh: 部署速度：   每回合每座己方补给格仅可部署 1 个地面单位。空中单位照常可从机场无限次部署。

en: 4/ The 4 Corner Supply Hexes: Become deactivated immediately once the nearest Victory Hex (NW-Dropov Airfield/NE-Rostoff Town Hall/SW-Partisan Base/SE-Oil Depot Alpha) to the corresponsing Supply Hex is taken by any enemy unit. Can be reactivated immediately if Victory Hex recaptured.
zh: 4/ 四角补给格：一旦与该补给格对应的最近胜利格（西北-德罗波夫机场／东北-罗斯托夫市政厅／西南-游击队基地／东南-阿尔法油库）被任一敌方单位占领，便立即失效。若该胜利格被夺回，则可立即恢复。

en: NOTE:- GERMAN 1ST TURN ONLY DEPOLYMENT OF PLANES OVER AIRFIELD HEXES IS ALLOWED!  (no movement/attacks or production!).
zh: 注意：德军第 1 回合仅允许在机场格上部署飞机！  （不得移动／攻击或生产！）

en: The game should be played back to back with the victory hexes held after each game added to the mirrored game to find the total victory hex score accumulated and hence the overall winner of the Grand Battle!!
zh: 双方应连续对局，将每局结束后所占据的胜利格计入镜像对局，以此求出累计的胜利格总分，从而决出大会战的最终胜者！！

en: This Scenario is a long, complex, fantasy, micro-managed, houseruled, prestige heavy Giant but hopefully everybody will have fun with its endless possiblities, humour, epic gameplay and serious challenge that it contains. This is a mini game within a game, with my main aim for it to become the default scenario test to find out who is the no.1 Open General Player out there LOL.
zh: “本场景是一场漫长、复杂、架空、需精细微操、带自订房规、声望丰厚的庞然大物，但但愿人人都能从其无尽的可能、幽默、史诗级玩法以及它所蕴含的严峻挑战中获得乐趣。这是一场游戏中的游戏，我的主要目标，是让它成为那套默认的场景测试，以找出天下第一的 Open General 玩家，哈哈。”
